class CapabilityNegotiator: 
109class CapabilityNegotiator:
110    """
111    Evaluates a ProductSpec against HowlFrame toolchain and runtime capabilities.
112    """
113
114    def __init__(self, registry: Optional[HowlFrameCapabilityRegistry] = None):
115        self.registry = registry or HowlFrameCapabilityRegistry()
116
117    def negotiate(self, spec: ProductSpec) -> NegotiationResult:
118        """
119        Performs fail-closed negotiation of product specification against
120        HowlFrame language and runtime capabilities.
121        """
122        gaps: List[FrameworkGap] = []
123        supported_ifaces: List[str] = []
124        supported_behaviors: List[str] = []
125        unsupported_behaviors: List[str] = []
126        granted_caps: List[str] = []
127
128        # 1. Evaluate Interfaces
129        for iface in spec.interfaces:
130            if iface in ("browser_ui", "http_api", "cli"):
131                supported_ifaces.append(iface)
132            else:
133                gaps.append(FrameworkGap(
134                    code="HF_UNSUPPORTED_INTERFACE",
135                    required_behavior=f"Interface '{iface}'",
136                    current_support="Only 'browser_ui', 'http_api', and 'cli' are supported.",
137                    suggested_enhancement=f"Add compiler/backend support for interface '{iface}'.",
138                    blocking=True,
139                ))
140
141        # 2. Evaluate Persistence
142        p_type = spec.persistence.type
143        if p_type == "local_store":
144            if not spec.persistence.storage_path.startswith("file://") and not spec.persistence.storage_path.endswith(".json"):
145                # Normalizable to file://
146                pass
147            granted_caps.extend(["database", "filesystem"])
148        elif p_type == "memory_store":
149            granted_caps.append("database")
150        elif p_type == "none":
151            pass
152        else:
153            gaps.append(FrameworkGap(
154                code="HF_UNSUPPORTED_PERSISTENCE",
155                required_behavior=f"Persistence type '{p_type}'",
156                current_support="Only 'local_store' (file://*.json) and 'memory_store' (memory://) are supported.",
157                suggested_enhancement="Extend native store adapter for requested persistence engine.",
158                blocking=True,
159            ))
160
161        if "http_api" in spec.interfaces or "browser_ui" in spec.interfaces:
162            granted_caps.append("network")
163
164        # 3. Evaluate Behaviors & Entities for Known Limitations
165        desc_lower = (spec.description + " " + " ".join(b.description for b in spec.behaviors)).lower()
166
167        gap_rules = [
168            (
169                lambda s: "atomic" in s and ("counter" in s or "increment" in s or "mutation" in s),
170                "atomic_shared_counter",
171                "HF_GAP_ATOMIC_MUTATION",
172                "Atomic shared counter mutation across concurrent requests",
173            ),
174            (
175                lambda s: any(k in s for k in ("websocket", "socket.io", "real-time stream")),
176                "raw_websocket_server",
177                "HF_GAP_WEBSOCKET",
178                "Raw WebSocket streaming server",
179            ),
180            (
181                lambda s: any(k in s for k in ("postgres", "mysql", "redis cluster", "mongodb", "distributed sql")),
182                "distributed_database",
183                "HF_GAP_DISTRIBUTED_DB",
184                "External distributed database connection",
185            ),
186            (
187                lambda s: any(k in s for k in ("background thread", "celery", "async worker")),
188                "multi_threaded_background_worker",
189                "HF_GAP_ASYNC_WORKER",
190                "Multi-threaded asynchronous background worker",
191            ),
192        ]
193        for matcher, reg_key, code, required_behavior in gap_rules:
194            if matcher(desc_lower):
195                cur, sugg = self.registry.KNOWN_LIMITATIONS[reg_key]
196                gaps.append(FrameworkGap(
197                    code=code,
198                    required_behavior=required_behavior,
199                    current_support=cur,
200                    suggested_enhancement=sugg,
201                    blocking=True,
202                ))
203
204        # Classify behaviors
205        for b in spec.behaviors:
206            if any(g.blocking and (b.name in g.required_behavior.lower() or b.description in g.required_behavior) for g in gaps):
207                unsupported_behaviors.append(b.name)
208            else:
209                supported_behaviors.append(b.name)
210
211        # Classify Overall Feasibility
212        blocking_gaps = [g for g in gaps if g.blocking]
213        if blocking_gaps:
214            status = FeasibilityStatus.INFEASIBLE
215        elif gaps:
216            status = FeasibilityStatus.PARTIALLY_FEASIBLE
217        else:
218            status = FeasibilityStatus.FEASIBLE
219
220        # Recommended Architecture
221        arch: Dict[str, Any] = {
222            "root_form": "http_server" if ("http_api" in spec.interfaces or "browser_ui" in spec.interfaces) else "cli_app",
223            "frontend_form": "web_app" if "browser_ui" in spec.interfaces else None,
224            "target": "bytecode",
225            "persistence_scheme": "file://" if spec.persistence.type == "local_store" else "memory://",
226            "required_capabilities": sorted(list(set(granted_caps + spec.capabilities_required))),
227            "port": spec.default_port,
228        }
229
230        return NegotiationResult(
231            status=status,
232            product_name=spec.name,
233            granted_capabilities=arch["required_capabilities"],
234            supported_interfaces=supported_ifaces,
235            supported_behaviors=supported_behaviors,
236            unsupported_behaviors=unsupported_behaviors,
237            framework_gaps=gaps,
238            recommended_target="bytecode",
239            recommended_architecture=arch,
240        )

Evaluates a ProductSpec against HowlFrame toolchain and runtime capabilities.

@dataclass

149@dataclass
150class DurableCampaignState(DataClassSerializationMixin):
151    """
152    Durable, serializable state of an autonomous dogfooding campaign.
153    Persisted outside ephemeral task journals to allow reliable resume and audit.
154    """
155
156    campaign_id: str
157    started_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
158    updated_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
159    north_star_objective: str = "Prompt -> Create -> Verify/Repair -> Usable Product"
160    active_benchmark: Optional[str] = None
161    active_engineering_task: Optional[str] = None
162    # Persisted benchmark/task scope this campaign was actually asked to run.
163    # `ai dogfood --resume <id>` restores exactly this scope rather than
164    # silently expanding to the full default benchmark suite (#58 Phase 1).
165    requested_benchmarks: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
166    scope_extensions: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
167    # Local (quota-free) model participation state (#58 Phase 15).
168    local_model: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
169    benchmark_history: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
170    provider_states: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
171    provider_invocations: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
172    # Per-role invocation counts recorded only where an AgentExecutionResult
173    # actually exists (#59.1 Phase 8): {provider: {implementation|remediation|
174    # review: n}}. A provider merely *mapped* to a reviewer role is never
175    # counted here -- assignment is not execution.
176    provider_role_invocations: Dict[str, Dict[str, int]] = field(default_factory=dict)
177    completed_tasks: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
178    failed_tasks: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
179    # Ordered per-provider attempt history for governed engineering tasks.
180    engineering_attempts: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
181    framework_gaps: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
182    # Cross-provider falsification rounds and their verdicts, plus failures
183    # attributed to a provider rather than to the framework (#59.1 Phase 5).
184    gap_falsifications: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
185    provider_specific_failures: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
186    git_records: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
187    reviewer_diversity_records: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
188    # Reasoning strategy dogfooding artifacts (#60A): durable references to
189    # trajectories and experiments, not the full payloads.
190    trajectory_ids: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
191    reasoning_experiments: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
192    trajectory_observations: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
193    repair_cycles_total: int = 0
194    # Delegated overnight authority (#59). `authority_envelope` is the
195    # serialized AuthorityEnvelope this campaign was bound to at creation or
196    # explicit resume-reauthorization; the envelope file itself remains the
197    # tamper-evident source of truth (see authority_envelope.py) -- this
198    # copy is for display/audit only and is never re-verified from here.
199    authority_envelope: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
200    parked_tasks: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
201    pending_human_decisions: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
202    merges_this_campaign: int = 0
203    stop_reason: str = "in_progress"
204    next_action: str = "continue_benchmarks"
205    total_duration_seconds: float = 0.0
206    iterations_attempted: int = 0
207    iterations_succeeded: int = 0
208    iterations_failed: int = 0
209    schema: str = CAMPAIGN_STATE_SCHEMA_VERSION
210
211    def update_timestamp(self) -> None:
212        self.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
213
214    def ensure_local_model_defaults(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
215        """Lazily populates `local_model` for campaigns created before #58."""
216        if not self.local_model:
217            self.local_model = default_local_model_state()
218        return self.local_model
219
220    def extend_benchmark_scope(self, additional_benchmarks: List[str]) -> List[str]:
221        """
222        Explicitly adds benchmarks to the persisted campaign scope. Returns the
223        list of benchmarks actually added (already-present ones are no-ops).
224        Recorded as a distinct scope-extension event so it's clear this was an
225        explicit operator widening rather than an implicit resume expansion.
226        """
227        added = [b for b in additional_benchmarks if b not in self.requested_benchmarks]
228        if added:
229            self.requested_benchmarks = self.requested_benchmarks + added
230            self.scope_extensions.append({
231                "added": added,
232                "at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
233            })
234            self.update_timestamp()
235        return added
236
237    def record_trajectory(self, trajectory_id: str) -> None:
238        if trajectory_id and trajectory_id not in self.trajectory_ids:
239            self.trajectory_ids.append(trajectory_id)
240        self.update_timestamp()
241
242    def record_reasoning_experiment(self, experiment_dict: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
243        experiment_id = experiment_dict.get("experiment_id")
244        for index, existing in enumerate(self.reasoning_experiments):
245            if experiment_id and existing.get("experiment_id") == experiment_id:
246                if existing.get("prediction_digest") != experiment_dict.get("prediction_digest"):
247                    raise ValueError(
248                        "Reasoning experiment ID cannot be reassigned to a new definition."
249                    )
250                if existing.get("completed_at") and existing != experiment_dict:
251                    raise ValueError("Completed reasoning experiment accounting is immutable.")
252                self.reasoning_experiments[index] = dict(experiment_dict)
253                self.update_timestamp()
254                return
255        self.reasoning_experiments.append(dict(experiment_dict))
256        self.update_timestamp()
257
258    def record_trajectory_observation(self, observation_dict: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
259        # Deduplicate by fingerprint
260        fingerprint = observation_dict.get("fingerprint")
261        if fingerprint and any(o.get("fingerprint") == fingerprint for o in self.trajectory_observations):
262            return
263        self.trajectory_observations.append(observation_dict)
264        self.update_timestamp()
265
266    def record_local_success(self, ram_gib: Optional[float] = None) -> None:
267        lm = self.ensure_local_model_defaults()
268        lm["success_count"] = lm.get("success_count", 0) + 1
269        if ram_gib is not None:
270            lm["last_available_ram_gib"] = ram_gib
271        self.update_timestamp()
272
273    def record_local_failure(self, ram_gib: Optional[float] = None) -> None:
274        lm = self.ensure_local_model_defaults()
275        lm["failure_count"] = lm.get("failure_count", 0) + 1
276        if ram_gib is not None:
277            lm["last_available_ram_gib"] = ram_gib
278        self.update_timestamp()
279
280    def record_local_escalation(self) -> None:
281        lm = self.ensure_local_model_defaults()
282        lm["escalations"] = lm.get("escalations", 0) + 1
283        self.update_timestamp()
284
285    def increment_local_only_iteration(self) -> int:
286        """Increments and returns the consecutive local-only continuation counter."""
287        lm = self.ensure_local_model_defaults()
288        lm["local_only_iterations"] = lm.get("local_only_iterations", 0) + 1
289        self.update_timestamp()
290        return lm["local_only_iterations"]
291
292    def reset_local_only_iterations(self) -> None:
293        """Resets the counter once cloud capacity is available again (not on local success)."""
294        lm = self.ensure_local_model_defaults()
295        lm["local_only_iterations"] = 0
296        self.update_timestamp()
297
298    def local_only_budget_reached(self) -> bool:
299        lm = self.ensure_local_model_defaults()
300        return lm.get("local_only_iterations", 0) >= lm.get("local_only_iteration_limit", DEFAULT_LOCAL_ONLY_ITERATION_LIMIT)
301
302    def record_provider_invocation(self, agent_id: str, role: str = "implementation") -> None:
303        """
304        Records one *actual* provider execution. `role` is one of
305        "implementation", "remediation", or "review" (#59.1 Phase 8). Callers
306        must only reach here when a real AgentExecutionResult was produced --
307        never merely because a role mapping named this provider.
308        """
309        self.provider_invocations[agent_id] = self.provider_invocations.get(agent_id, 0) + 1
310        by_role = self.provider_role_invocations.setdefault(agent_id, {})
311        by_role[role] = by_role.get(role, 0) + 1
312        self.update_timestamp()
313
314    def record_engineering_attempt(self, attempt: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
315        """
316        Appends one provider attempt at a governed engineering task. Attempts
317        are append-only and persisted immediately by the caller so the history
318        survives a crash or restart mid-failover (#59.1 Phase 2/4).
319        """
320        self.engineering_attempts.append(attempt)
321        self.update_timestamp()
322
323    def attempts_for_task(self, task_id: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
324        return [a for a in self.engineering_attempts if a.get("task_id") == task_id]
325
326    def record_benchmark_result(self, result_dict: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
327        self.benchmark_history.append(result_dict)
328        self.iterations_attempted = len(self.benchmark_history)
329        self.iterations_succeeded = sum(1 for r in self.benchmark_history if r.get("success", False))
330        self.iterations_failed = self.iterations_attempted - self.iterations_succeeded
331        self.repair_cycles_total += result_dict.get("repair_cycles", 0)
332        self.update_timestamp()
333
334    def record_task_completed(self, task_dict: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
335        self.completed_tasks.append(task_dict)
336        self.update_timestamp()
337
338    def record_task_failed(self, task_dict: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
339        self.failed_tasks.append(task_dict)
340        self.update_timestamp()
341
342    def record_gap_falsification(self, record: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
343        """
344        Records one cross-provider falsification round for an ambiguous
345        synthesis failure (#59.1 Phase 5), whatever its verdict. Kept even
346        when the verdict was "not a framework gap" -- that negative result is
347        the evidence that HowlPlane correctly declined to modify itself.
348        """
349        self.gap_falsifications.append(record)
350        self.update_timestamp()
351
352    def record_provider_specific_failure(self, record: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
353        """
354        Records a synthesis failure attributed to a provider rather than to
355        the framework. Deliberately NOT a framework gap: nothing here opens a
356        governed self-improvement task.
357        """
358        self.provider_specific_failures.append(record)
359        self.update_timestamp()
360
361    def record_framework_gap(self, gap_dict: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
362        # Avoid duplicate gaps by code
363        code = gap_dict.get("code")
364        if not any(g.get("code") == code for g in self.framework_gaps):
365            self.framework_gaps.append(gap_dict)
366            self.update_timestamp()
367
368    def record_git_integration(self, git_rec: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
369        """
370        Records/updates a task's GitIntegrationRecord. Deduplicates by
371        task_id: a task's git integration record is progressively updated
372        as real steps complete (#59 Phase 2/22), so a later call for the
373        same task_id replaces the prior entry rather than appending a
374        duplicate.
375        """
376        task_id = git_rec.get("task_id")
377        self.git_records = [g for g in self.git_records if g.get("task_id") != task_id]
378        self.git_records.append(git_rec)
379        self.update_timestamp()
380
381    def record_park(self, parked_record: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
382        """Records a task parked awaiting human authority (#59 Phase 12)."""
383        task_id = parked_record.get("task_id")
384        if not any(p.get("task_id") == task_id for p in self.parked_tasks):
385            self.parked_tasks.append(parked_record)
386        self.pending_human_decisions = list(self.parked_tasks)
387        self.update_timestamp()
388
389    def is_task_parked(self, task_id: str) -> bool:
390        return any(p.get("task_id") == task_id for p in self.parked_tasks)
391
392    def increment_merge_count(self) -> int:
393        self.merges_this_campaign += 1
394        self.update_timestamp()
395        return self.merges_this_campaign
396
397    def merge_budget_reached(self, envelope: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> bool:
398        env = envelope or self.authority_envelope
399        max_merges = env.get("max_merges", 0) if env else 0
400        return self.merges_this_campaign >= max_merges
401
402    def save(self, run_dir: Union[str, Path]) -> Path:
403        """Atomically saves campaign state and markdown report to directory."""
404        target_dir = Path(run_dir).resolve()
405        target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
406        self.update_timestamp()
407        state_file = target_dir / "campaign_state.json"
408        atomic_write_json(state_file, self.to_dict())
409        summary_file = target_dir / "campaign_summary.md"
410        atomic_write_text(summary_file, self.render_markdown())
411        return state_file
412
413    @classmethod
414    def load(cls, run_dir: Union[str, Path]) -> "DurableCampaignState":
415        target_dir = Path(run_dir).resolve()
416        state_file = target_dir / "campaign_state.json"
417        if not state_file.is_file():
418            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Campaign state file not found at {state_file}")
419        data = safe_load_json(state_file)
420        return cls.from_dict(data)
421
422    def render_markdown(self) -> str:
423        lines = [
424            f"# HowlPlane Marathon Dogfooding Report: `{self.campaign_id}`",
425            "",
426            f"- **Schema:** `{self.schema}`",
427            f"- **Started At:** `{self.started_at}`",
428            f"- **Updated At:** `{self.updated_at}`",
429            f"- **Stop Reason:** `{self.stop_reason}`",
430            f"- **Total Duration:** `{self.total_duration_seconds}s`",
431            f"- **Iterations:** {self.iterations_succeeded}/{self.iterations_attempted} succeeded ({self.iterations_failed} failed)",
432            f"- **Total Repair Cycles:** {self.repair_cycles_total}",
433            f"- **Next Action:** `{self.next_action}`",
434            f"- **Requested Benchmark Scope:** `{', '.join(self.requested_benchmarks) or 'N/A'}`",
435            "",
436            "## Provider Status & Invocations",
437            "",
438            "| Provider | Live State | Invocations |",
439            "| --- | --- | --- |",
440        ]
441        all_providers = sorted(set(list(self.provider_states.keys()) + list(self.provider_invocations.keys())))
442        for p in all_providers:
443            st = self.provider_states.get(p, "UNKNOWN")
444            inv = self.provider_invocations.get(p, 0)
445            lines.append(f"| `{p}` | `{st}` | {inv} |")
446
447        lines.extend([
448            "",
449            "## Benchmarks & Products Created",
450            "",
451            "| Benchmark | Product | Success | Checks | Repairs | Duration | Provider | Bundle Path |",
452            "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
453        ])
454        for b in self.benchmark_history:
455            mark = "✓ PASS" if b.get("success") else "✗ FAIL"
456            checks = f"{b.get('passed_checks', 0)}/{b.get('total_checks', 0)}"
457            bpath = b.get("bundle_path") or "N/A"
458            lines.append(
459                f"| {b.get('benchmark_id')} | {b.get('product_name')} | {mark} | {checks} | "
460                f"{b.get('repair_cycles', 0)} | {b.get('duration_seconds', 0)}s | "
461                f"`{b.get('implementing_provider', 'unknown')}` | `{bpath}` |"
462            )
463
464        if self.local_model:
465            lm = self.local_model
466            lines.extend([
467                "",
468                "## Local Model Participation",
469                "",
470                f"- **Provider/Model:** `{lm.get('provider')}` / `{lm.get('model')}`",
471                f"- **Context Length:** {lm.get('context_length')}",
472                f"- **Local Success/Failure:** {lm.get('success_count', 0)}/{lm.get('failure_count', 0)}",
473                f"- **Escalations to Cloud:** {lm.get('escalations', 0)}",
474                f"- **Local-Only Continuation:** {lm.get('local_only_iterations', 0)}/{lm.get('local_only_iteration_limit')}",
475                f"- **Last Observed Available RAM:** {lm.get('last_available_ram_gib')} GiB",
476                f"- **Current Availability:** `{lm.get('current_availability')}`",
477            ])
478
479        if self.framework_gaps:
480            lines.extend([
481                "",
482                "## Framework & Runtime Gaps Discovered",
483                "",
484                "| Gap Code | Target Component | Description | Impact |",
485                "| --- | --- | --- | --- |",
486            ])
487            for g in self.framework_gaps:
488                lines.append(
489                    f"| `{g.get('code')}` | `{g.get('target_component')}` | {g.get('required_behavior')} | `{g.get('impact')}` |"
490                )
491
492        if self.completed_tasks or self.failed_tasks:
493            lines.extend([
494                "",
495                "## Governed Engineering Tasks",
496                "",
497                "| Task ID | Status | Objective | Provider | Remediations |",
498                "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
499            ])
500            for t in self.completed_tasks:
501                lines.append(
502                    f"| `{t.get('task_id')}` | ✓ COMPLETED | {t.get('objective', '')[:50]} | `{t.get('provider')}` | {t.get('remediations', 0)} |"
503                )
504            for t in self.failed_tasks:
505                lines.append(
506                    f"| `{t.get('task_id')}` | ✗ FAILED | {t.get('objective', '')[:50]} | `{t.get('provider')}` | {t.get('error', '')[:30]} |"
507                )
508
509        if self.engineering_attempts:
510            lines.extend([
511                "",
512                "## Engineering Provider Attempts",
513                "",
514                "Why the provider changed, in the order it was tried.",
515                "",
516                "| Task ID | # | Provider | Result | Failure Class | Delta Reconciled | Evidence |",
517                "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
518            ])
519            for a in self.engineering_attempts:
520                reconciled = "yes" if a.get("delta_reconciled") else "no"
521                lines.append(
522                    f"| `{a.get('task_id')}` | {a.get('attempt_index')} | `{a.get('provider')}` | "
523                    f"`{a.get('result')}` | `{a.get('failure_class') or '-'}` | {reconciled} | "
524                    f"{a.get('error_digest', '')[:80]} |"
525                )
526
527        if self.gap_falsifications:
528            lines.extend([
529                "",
530                "## Framework-Gap Evidence",
531                "",
532                "Ambiguous synthesis failures are falsified against an independent",
533                "provider before HowlPlane may modify itself.",
534                "",
535                "| Benchmark | Failure | Failing Provider | Verdict | Confirmations |",
536                "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
537            ])
538            for f in self.gap_falsifications:
539                tried = ", ".join(
540                    f"{a.get('provider')}:{a.get('outcome')}" for a in f.get("attempts", [])
541                ) or "none"
542                lines.append(
543                    f"| {f.get('benchmark')} | `{f.get('gap_type')}` | `{f.get('failing_provider')}` | "
544                    f"`{f.get('evidence')}` | {tried} |"
545                )
546
547        if self.provider_role_invocations:
548            lines.extend([
549                "",
550                "## Provider Invocations by Role",
551                "",
552                "Counted only where a provider actually executed -- a reviewer",
553                "mapping alone never appears here.",
554                "",
555                "| Provider | Implementation | Remediation | Review | Total |",
556                "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
557            ])
558            for provider in sorted(self.provider_role_invocations):
559                roles = self.provider_role_invocations[provider]
560                lines.append(
561                    f"| `{provider}` | {roles.get('implementation', 0)} | {roles.get('remediation', 0)} | "
562                    f"{roles.get('review', 0)} | {self.provider_invocations.get(provider, 0)} |"
563                )
564
565        if self.git_records:
566            lines.extend([
567                "",
568                "## Git Commits, Pull Requests & Merges",
569                "",
570                "| Task ID | Repo | Mode | Branch | Commit SHA | PR | CI Status | Merged |",
571                "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
572            ])
573            for gr in self.git_records:
574                pr_str = f"#{gr.get('pr_number')}" if gr.get("pr_number") else "N/A"
575                merged_str = "✓ MERGED" if gr.get("merged") else "PENDING"
576                commit_sha = gr.get("commit_sha") or ""
577                lines.append(
578                    f"| `{gr.get('task_id')}` | `{gr.get('target_repo')}` | `{gr.get('integration_mode', 'simulated')}` | "
579                    f"`{gr.get('branch') or 'N/A'}` | `{commit_sha[:8]}` | {pr_str} | `{gr.get('ci_status')}` | {merged_str} |"
580                )
581
582        if self.pending_human_decisions:
583            lines.extend([
584                "",
585                "## Pending Human Decisions",
586                "",
587                "| Task ID | Objective | Boundary | Repo | Recommended | Blocks Other Work |",
588                "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
589            ])
590            for pd in self.pending_human_decisions:
591                blocks_str = "⚠ YES" if pd.get("blocks_other_work") else "no"
592                lines.append(
593                    f"| `{pd.get('task_id')}` | {pd.get('objective', '')[:60]} | `{pd.get('boundary_type')}` | "
594                    f"`{pd.get('repository')}` | `{pd.get('recommended_action')}` | {blocks_str} |"
595                )
596
597        if self.reviewer_diversity_records:
598            lines.extend([
599                "",
600                "## Reviewer Diversity Verification",
601                "",
602                "| Task/Product | Implementer | Reviewers | Independent Diversity Achieved |",
603                "| --- | --- | --- | --- |",
604            ])
605            for rd in self.reviewer_diversity_records:
606                div_str = "✓ YES" if rd.get("diversity_achieved") else "⚠ REDUCED (Single Provider)"
607                revs = ", ".join(f"{k}:{v}" for k, v in rd.get("reviewers", {}).items())
608                lines.append(
609                    f"| `{rd.get('target')}` | `{rd.get('implementer')}` | `{revs}` | {div_str} |"
610                )
611
612        lines.extend([
613            "",
614            "## Resume Command",
615            "",
616            "To resume or continue this dogfood campaign with updated quotas:",
617            "```bash",
618            f"ai dogfood --resume {self.campaign_id}",
619            "```",
620            "",
621        ])
622        return "\n".join(lines)

Durable, serializable state of an autonomous dogfooding campaign. Persisted outside ephemeral task journals to allow reliable resume and audit.

def extend_benchmark_scope(self, additional_benchmarks: List[str]) -> List[str]: 
220    def extend_benchmark_scope(self, additional_benchmarks: List[str]) -> List[str]:
221        """
222        Explicitly adds benchmarks to the persisted campaign scope. Returns the
223        list of benchmarks actually added (already-present ones are no-ops).
224        Recorded as a distinct scope-extension event so it's clear this was an
225        explicit operator widening rather than an implicit resume expansion.
226        """
227        added = [b for b in additional_benchmarks if b not in self.requested_benchmarks]
228        if added:
229            self.requested_benchmarks = self.requested_benchmarks + added
230            self.scope_extensions.append({
231                "added": added,
232                "at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
233            })
234            self.update_timestamp()
235        return added

def record_reasoning_experiment(self, experiment_dict: Dict[str, Any]) -> None: 
242    def record_reasoning_experiment(self, experiment_dict: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
243        experiment_id = experiment_dict.get("experiment_id")
244        for index, existing in enumerate(self.reasoning_experiments):
245            if experiment_id and existing.get("experiment_id") == experiment_id:
246                if existing.get("prediction_digest") != experiment_dict.get("prediction_digest"):
247                    raise ValueError(
248                        "Reasoning experiment ID cannot be reassigned to a new definition."
249                    )
250                if existing.get("completed_at") and existing != experiment_dict:
251                    raise ValueError("Completed reasoning experiment accounting is immutable.")
252                self.reasoning_experiments[index] = dict(experiment_dict)
253                self.update_timestamp()
254                return
255        self.reasoning_experiments.append(dict(experiment_dict))
256        self.update_timestamp()

302    def record_provider_invocation(self, agent_id: str, role: str = "implementation") -> None:
303        """
304        Records one *actual* provider execution. `role` is one of
305        "implementation", "remediation", or "review" (#59.1 Phase 8). Callers
306        must only reach here when a real AgentExecutionResult was produced --
307        never merely because a role mapping named this provider.
308        """

312        self.update_timestamp()

369        """
370        Records/updates a task's GitIntegrationRecord. Deduplicates by
371        task_id: a task's git integration record is progressively updated
372        as real steps complete (#59 Phase 2/22), so a later call for the
373        same task_id replaces the prior entry rather than appending a

def save(self, run_dir: Union[str, pathlib.Path]) -> pathlib.Path: 
402    def save(self, run_dir: Union[str, Path]) -> Path:
403        """Atomically saves campaign state and markdown report to directory."""
404        target_dir = Path(run_dir).resolve()
405        target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
406        self.update_timestamp()
407        state_file = target_dir / "campaign_state.json"
408        atomic_write_json(state_file, self.to_dict())
409        summary_file = target_dir / "campaign_summary.md"
410        atomic_write_text(summary_file, self.render_markdown())
411        return state_file

@classmethod
def load( cls, run_dir: Union[str, pathlib.Path]) -> howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.campaign_state.DurableCampaignState:

414    def load(cls, run_dir: Union[str, Path]) -> "DurableCampaignState":

417        if not state_file.is_file():

422    def render_markdown(self) -> str:
423        lines = [
424            f"# HowlPlane Marathon Dogfooding Report: `{self.campaign_id}`",
425            "",
426            f"- **Schema:** `{self.schema}`",
427            f"- **Started At:** `{self.started_at}`",
428            f"- **Updated At:** `{self.updated_at}`",
429            f"- **Stop Reason:** `{self.stop_reason}`",
430            f"- **Total Duration:** `{self.total_duration_seconds}s`",
431            f"- **Iterations:** {self.iterations_succeeded}/{self.iterations_attempted} succeeded ({self.iterations_failed} failed)",
432            f"- **Total Repair Cycles:** {self.repair_cycles_total}",
433            f"- **Next Action:** `{self.next_action}`",
434            f"- **Requested Benchmark Scope:** `{', '.join(self.requested_benchmarks) or 'N/A'}`",
435            "",
436            "## Provider Status & Invocations",
437            "",
438            "| Provider | Live State | Invocations |",
439            "| --- | --- | --- |",
440        ]
441        all_providers = sorted(set(list(self.provider_states.keys()) + list(self.provider_invocations.keys())))
442        for p in all_providers:
443            st = self.provider_states.get(p, "UNKNOWN")
444            inv = self.provider_invocations.get(p, 0)
445            lines.append(f"| `{p}` | `{st}` | {inv} |")
446
447        lines.extend([
448            "",
449            "## Benchmarks & Products Created",
450            "",
451            "| Benchmark | Product | Success | Checks | Repairs | Duration | Provider | Bundle Path |",
452            "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
453        ])
454        for b in self.benchmark_history:
455            mark = "✓ PASS" if b.get("success") else "✗ FAIL"
456            checks = f"{b.get('passed_checks', 0)}/{b.get('total_checks', 0)}"
457            bpath = b.get("bundle_path") or "N/A"
458            lines.append(
459                f"| {b.get('benchmark_id')} | {b.get('product_name')} | {mark} | {checks} | "
460                f"{b.get('repair_cycles', 0)} | {b.get('duration_seconds', 0)}s | "
461                f"`{b.get('implementing_provider', 'unknown')}` | `{bpath}` |"
462            )
463
464        if self.local_model:
465            lm = self.local_model
466            lines.extend([
467                "",
468                "## Local Model Participation",
469                "",
470                f"- **Provider/Model:** `{lm.get('provider')}` / `{lm.get('model')}`",
471                f"- **Context Length:** {lm.get('context_length')}",
472                f"- **Local Success/Failure:** {lm.get('success_count', 0)}/{lm.get('failure_count', 0)}",
473                f"- **Escalations to Cloud:** {lm.get('escalations', 0)}",
474                f"- **Local-Only Continuation:** {lm.get('local_only_iterations', 0)}/{lm.get('local_only_iteration_limit')}",
475                f"- **Last Observed Available RAM:** {lm.get('last_available_ram_gib')} GiB",
476                f"- **Current Availability:** `{lm.get('current_availability')}`",
477            ])
478
479        if self.framework_gaps:
480            lines.extend([
481                "",
482                "## Framework & Runtime Gaps Discovered",
483                "",
484                "| Gap Code | Target Component | Description | Impact |",
485                "| --- | --- | --- | --- |",
486            ])
487            for g in self.framework_gaps:
488                lines.append(
489                    f"| `{g.get('code')}` | `{g.get('target_component')}` | {g.get('required_behavior')} | `{g.get('impact')}` |"
490                )
491
492        if self.completed_tasks or self.failed_tasks:
493            lines.extend([
494                "",
495                "## Governed Engineering Tasks",
496                "",
497                "| Task ID | Status | Objective | Provider | Remediations |",

499            ])
500            for t in self.completed_tasks:
501                lines.append(
502                    f"| `{t.get('task_id')}` | ✓ COMPLETED | {t.get('objective', '')[:50]} | `{t.get('provider')}` | {t.get('remediations', 0)} |"

597        if self.reviewer_diversity_records:
598            lines.extend([
599                "",
600                "## Reviewer Diversity Verification",
601                "",
602                "| Task/Product | Implementer | Reviewers | Independent Diversity Achieved |",
603                "| --- | --- | --- | --- |",
604            ])
605            for rd in self.reviewer_diversity_records:
606                div_str = "✓ YES" if rd.get("diversity_achieved") else "⚠ REDUCED (Single Provider)"
607                revs = ", ".join(f"{k}:{v}" for k, v in rd.get("reviewers", {}).items())
608                lines.append(
609                    f"| `{rd.get('target')}` | `{rd.get('implementer')}` | `{revs}` | {div_str} |"
610                )
611
612        lines.extend([
613            "",
614            "## Resume Command",
615            "",
616            "To resume or continue this dogfood campaign with updated quotas:",
617            "```bash",
618            f"ai dogfood --resume {self.campaign_id}",
619            "```",
620            "",
621        ])
622        return "\n".join(lines)

class GitIntegrationRecord(howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.DataClassSerializationMixin): 
 51@dataclass
 52class GitIntegrationRecord(DataClassSerializationMixin):
 53    """
 54    Tracks a git commit, branch, PR, CI evaluation, and merge for an
 55    engineering task. Fail-closed by design (#59 Phase 1): every field that
 56    represents an observed real-world fact defaults to "nothing has been
 57    observed yet" rather than "assume success". `merged` in particular
 58    defaults to False and must never be set True by any code path except
 59    immediately after independently verifying the merge SHA is reachable
 60    from the remote's main branch -- see is_fully_integrated().
 61    """
 62
 63    task_id: str
 64    target_repo: str
 65    idempotency_key: Optional[str] = None
 66    # "real": actual git/GitHub operations performed and independently
 67    #   verified. "simulated": no real integration was attempted (legacy /
 68    #   non-campaign paths). "test_fake": test-boundary fakes exercised the
 69    #   real production call sequence. Consumers must never treat
 70    #   "simulated" as evidence of a landed change.
 71    integration_mode: str = "simulated"
 72    branch: Optional[str] = None
 73    branch_observed: bool = False
 74    commit_sha: Optional[str] = None
 75    commit_observed: bool = False
 76    commit_message: str = ""
 77    push_observed: bool = False
 78    pr_number: Optional[int] = None
 79    pr_url: Optional[str] = None
 80    pr_observed: bool = False
 81    required_checks: List[Dict[str, str]] = field(default_factory=list)
 82    required_checks_observed: bool = False
 83    required_checks_green: bool = False
 84    ci_status: str = "pending"  # "pending", "passed", "failed", "cancelled", "timed_out", "unavailable"
 85    merge_observed: bool = False
 86    merged: bool = False
 87    merge_sha: Optional[str] = None  # GitHub-produced squash-merge SHA, distinct from commit_sha
 88    merged_at: Optional[str] = None
 89    ci_observed_head_sha: Optional[str] = None
 90    current_pr_head_sha: Optional[str] = None
 91    remote_main_contains_merge: bool = False
 92    local_main_synced: bool = False
 93    provider: Optional[str] = None
 94    failure_reason: Optional[str] = None
 95    schema: str = "howlplane.git_record/v2"
 96
 97    def is_fully_integrated(self) -> bool:
 98        """
 99        The single source of truth for "this task actually landed". No other
100        code path should independently decide a task is integrated.
101        """
102        return (
103            self.branch_observed
104            and self.commit_observed
105            and self.push_observed
106            and self.pr_observed
107            and self.required_checks_green
108            and bool(self.ci_observed_head_sha)
109            and self.ci_observed_head_sha == self.current_pr_head_sha
110            and self.merge_observed
111            and self.remote_main_contains_merge
112        )

class HowlFrameCapabilityRegistry: 
 70class HowlFrameCapabilityRegistry:
 71    """
 72    Authoritative registry of supported HowlFrame constructs, runtime primitives,
 73    interfaces, and persistence mechanisms.
 74    """
 75
 76    # Supported root forms in HowlFrame
 77    SUPPORTED_ROOT_FORMS = {"http_server", "web_app", "cli_app", "module"}
 78
 79    # Supported execution targets
 80    SUPPORTED_TARGETS = {"bytecode", "gogen", "javascript", "wasm"}
 81
 82    # Supported capabilities in HowlFrame VM
 83    SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES = {"network", "database", "filesystem", "process", "environment"}
 84
 85    # Supported persistence schemes
 86    SUPPORTED_STORE_SCHEMES = {"file://", "memory://"}
 87
 88    # Explicitly known unsupported constructs and architectural limitations
 89    KNOWN_LIMITATIONS = {
 90        "atomic_shared_counter": (
 91            "Single-threaded record store does not support lock-free cross-process atomic mutations.",
 92            "Add atomic integer increment opcode (STORE_ATOMIC_INCR) to HowlFrame VM and store runtime.",
 93        ),
 94        "raw_websocket_server": (
 95            "HowlFrame http_server primitive currently supports HTTP 1.1 request/response cycles only.",
 96            "Introduce (websocket_server ...) root form and event loop in internal/backend/gogen and VM.",
 97        ),
 98        "distributed_database": (
 99            "HowlFrame store_open only connects to local JSON file or memory stores.",
100            "Implement native SQL / Postgres store adapter under database capability.",
101        ),
102        "multi_threaded_background_worker": (
103            "HowlFrame execution threads are synchronous within a single VM instance.",
104            "Add actor-based background task scheduler with channel communication.",
105        ),
106    }
