class MarathonDogfoodEngine: 
 214class MarathonDogfoodEngine:
 215    """
 216    Drives continuous, evidence-backed dogfooding loops across product benchmarks.
 217    Handles real AI provider execution, exhaustion fallback, failure classification,
 218    governed self-improvement task delegation, git/PR integration, and durable state persistence.
 219    """
 220
 221    def __init__(
 222        self,
 223        synthesizer: Optional[ProductSynthesizer] = None,
 224        provider_pool: Optional[ProviderPoolManager] = None,
 225        ledger: Optional[EvidenceLedger] = None,
 226        base_output_dir: Union[str, Path] = "output",
 227        campaign_dir: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
 228        target_repo: Union[str, Path] = ".",
 229        repo_slug: Optional[str] = None,
 230        git_executor_factory: Optional[Callable[..., GitIntegrationExecutor]] = None,
 231        orchestrator_factory: Optional[Callable[[OrchestrationConfig], GovernedTaskOrchestrator]] = None,
 232        git_runner: Optional[Callable[..., Any]] = None,
 233        framework_gap_confirmations_required: int = 1,
 234    ):
 235        self.provider_pool = provider_pool or ProviderPoolManager()
 236        self.ledger = ledger
 237        self.synthesizer = synthesizer or ProductSynthesizer(provider_pool=self.provider_pool, ledger=self.ledger)
 238        self.base_output_dir = Path(base_output_dir).resolve()
 239        self.campaign_base_dir = (
 240            Path(campaign_dir).resolve()
 241            if campaign_dir
 242            else Path(".dogfood_runs").resolve()
 243        )
 244        # Real git/GitHub integration target (#59). Defaults to the current
 245        # working directory (the howlplane repo itself, for self-improvement
 246        # tasks). `repo_slug` is auto-detected from the `origin` remote when
 247        # not explicitly provided.
 248        self.target_repo = Path(target_repo).resolve()
 249        self.repo_slug = repo_slug or detect_repo_slug(self.target_repo) or ""
 250        self.authority_envelope: Optional[AuthorityEnvelope] = None
 251        # Injectable for tests; defaults to the real GitIntegrationExecutor.
 252        self._git_executor_factory = git_executor_factory or (
 253            lambda envelope, merges_so_far: GitIntegrationExecutor(
 254                self.target_repo, self.repo_slug, envelope, merges_so_far=merges_so_far
 255            )
 256        )
 257        self.git_executor: Optional[GitIntegrationExecutor] = None
 258        # Injectable for tests (mirrors GovernedTaskOrchestrator's own
 259        # custom_backend seam); defaults to constructing the real
 260        # orchestrator against self.target_repo. The orchestrator's own
 261        # lifecycle (locks, routing, review, verification) is exhaustively
 262        # covered by its dedicated test suite -- this seam lets marathon-
 263        # level tests exercise the real git/GitHub continuation logic
 264        # without re-driving that whole subsystem end-to-end.
 265        self._orchestrator_factory = orchestrator_factory or (
 266            lambda config: GovernedTaskOrchestrator(target_repo=self.target_repo, config=config)
 267        )
 268        # Raw git seam used only by attempt-state reconciliation (#59.1
 269        # Phase 3), kept separate from the authority-gated GitIntegrationExecutor:
 270        # reverting a failed attempt's own files is repository hygiene, not a
 271        # proposed action against the envelope.
 272        self._git_runner = git_runner or run_git
 273        # How many *independent* providers must reproduce an ambiguous synthesis
 274        # failure before it may be called a framework gap (#59.1 Phase 5).
 275        self.framework_gap_confirmations_required = max(0, framework_gap_confirmations_required)
 276
 277    def _generate_campaign_id(self) -> str:
 278        ts = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
 279        rand = hashlib.sha256(os.urandom(8)).hexdigest()[:6]
 280        return f"DOGFOOD-{ts}-{rand}"
 281
 282    def _bind_authority_envelope(
 283        self,
 284        state_dir: Path,
 285        campaign_id: str,
 286        authority_profile_id: Optional[str],
 287        is_resume: bool,
 288    ) -> Optional[AuthorityEnvelope]:
 289        """
 290        Binds delegated overnight authority for this campaign run (#59
 291        Phases 8/15). `create_envelope`/`save_envelope` are only ever
 292        invoked from here, driven by the `authority_profile_id` value that
 293        arrived from the operator's CLI invocation -- never from AI-
 294        generated text or task output.
 295        """
 296        operator_origin = f"cli:{getpass.getuser()}@{socket.gethostname()}"
 297
 298        if not is_resume:
 299            if not authority_profile_id:
 300                return None
 301            envelope = create_envelope(get_profile(authority_profile_id), campaign_id, operator_origin)
 302            save_envelope(envelope, state_dir)
 303            return envelope
 304
 305        try:
 306            existing = load_envelope(state_dir)
 307        except EnvelopeNotFoundError:
 308            existing = None
 309        except TamperedEnvelopeError:
 310            # Fail closed: a tampered envelope grants nothing, regardless of
 311            # whether an explicit profile was also passed this call.
 312            return None
 313
 314        if authority_profile_id:
 315            if existing is not None and existing.profile_id != authority_profile_id:
 316                raise ValueError(
 317                    "Requested authority profile does not match the saved "
 318                    f"envelope: {authority_profile_id!r} != {existing.profile_id!r}"
 319                )
 320            if existing is not None and not is_expired(existing):
 321                return existing
 322            # Reauthorization may renew the same profile, but cannot silently
 323            # substitute a different authority policy for the saved campaign.
 324            envelope_path = state_dir / ENVELOPE_FILENAME
 325            if envelope_path.is_file():
 326                envelope_path.unlink()
 327            envelope = create_envelope(
 328                get_profile(authority_profile_id), campaign_id, operator_origin
 329            )
 330            save_envelope(envelope, state_dir)
 331            return envelope
 332
 333        if existing is None or is_expired(existing):
 334            # Expired (or never authorized) and no explicit reauthorization
 335            # on this resume call: never silently renew. The campaign
 336            # proceeds read/propose-only -- envelope-gated tasks will park.
 337            return None
 338        return existing
 339
 340    def run_marathon(
 341        self,
 342        benchmarks: Optional[List[str]] = None,
 343        max_iterations: int = 5,
 344        until_providers_exhausted: bool = False,
 345        avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None,
 346        preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None,
 347        resume_campaign_id: Optional[str] = None,
 348        authority_profile_id: Optional[str] = None,
 349    ) -> MarathonSummaryReport:
 350        """
 351        Executes evidence-driven marathon dogfooding.
 352        Respects --until-providers-exhausted by running as long as providers remain available,
 353        with a high finite safety ceiling to avoid unbounded spins.
 354        """
 355        t0 = time.time()
 356        self.base_output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 357        self.campaign_base_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 358
 359        # 1. Initialize or Resume Durable Campaign State
 360        campaign_id = resume_campaign_id or self._generate_campaign_id()
 361        state_dir = self.campaign_base_dir / campaign_id
 362        state_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 363
 364        scope_extended: List[str] = []
 365        if resume_campaign_id and (state_dir / "campaign_state.json").is_file():
 366            campaign_state = DurableCampaignState.load(state_dir)
 367            # Re-check LIVE provider availability upon resume: previously exhausted
 368            # cloud providers may have refreshed quota (#58 Phase 16).
 369            self.provider_pool.reset_transient_exhaustion()
 370
 371            # Restore the campaign's PERSISTED benchmark scope. A resume must NOT
 372            # silently expand into the full default benchmark suite (#58 Phase 1).
 373            # Campaigns persisted before #58 have no `requested_benchmarks`; fall
 374            # back to the full default suite once, for backward compatibility.
 375            persisted_scope = campaign_state.requested_benchmarks or list(STANDARD_BENCHMARKS.keys())
 376            if benchmarks:
 377                # Explicit --benchmarks on a resume is treated as an operator-driven
 378                # scope EXTENSION, not a silent expansion or an override.
 379                scope_extended = campaign_state.extend_benchmark_scope(benchmarks)
 380                benchmark_keys_scope = campaign_state.requested_benchmarks
 381            else:
 382                benchmark_keys_scope = persisted_scope
 383            campaign_state.requested_benchmarks = benchmark_keys_scope
 384
 385            # Skip benchmarks already verified successful in a prior session; retry
 386            # any that previously failed, plus anything newly added to scope.
 387            already_succeeded = {
 388                b.get("benchmark_id") for b in campaign_state.benchmark_history if b.get("success")
 389            }
 390            benchmark_keys = [b for b in benchmark_keys_scope if b not in already_succeeded]
 391        else:
 392            campaign_state = DurableCampaignState(campaign_id=campaign_id)
 393            benchmark_keys = benchmarks or list(STANDARD_BENCHMARKS.keys())
 394            campaign_state.requested_benchmarks = list(benchmark_keys)
 395
 396        is_resume = bool(resume_campaign_id and (state_dir / "campaign_state.json").is_file())
 397        self.authority_envelope = self._bind_authority_envelope(
 398            state_dir, campaign_id, authority_profile_id, is_resume
 399        )
 400        campaign_state.authority_envelope = self.authority_envelope.to_dict() if self.authority_envelope else None
 401        self.git_executor = self._git_executor_factory(self.authority_envelope, campaign_state.merges_this_campaign)
 402
 403        if self.authority_envelope is not None:
 404            # Overnight-safe envelope bound: use its (more conservative)
 405            # local RAM threshold and keep_alive behavior for local Ollama
 406            # inference rather than the interactive default (#59 Phases
 407            # 16/17). Registered for the lifetime of this process; a fresh
 408            # process picks the interactive default again unless it too
 409            # binds an envelope.
 410            from howlplane.control_plane.agent_execution import OllamaLocalBackend
 411            AgentBackendRegistry.register_backend(
 412                "local_ollama",
 413                OllamaLocalBackend(
 414                    min_available_ram_gib=self.authority_envelope.local_ram_threshold_gib,
 415                    keep_alive=self.authority_envelope.local_keep_alive,
 416                ),
 417            )
 418            lm = campaign_state.ensure_local_model_defaults()
 419            lm["resource_guard_min_ram_gib"] = self.authority_envelope.local_ram_threshold_gib
 420
 421        # When --until-providers-exhausted is True, do not silently cap at 5;
 422        # set high safety ceiling (e.g. 100) to allow long autonomous campaigns
 423        if until_providers_exhausted:
 424            effective_max_iterations = max(max_iterations, 100)
 425        else:
 426            effective_max_iterations = max_iterations
 427
 428        results: List[DogfoodIterationResult] = []
 429        stop_reason = "completed_all_benchmarks"
 430
 431        iteration_idx = 0
 432        b_index = 0
 433
 434        while iteration_idx < effective_max_iterations:
 435            if b_index >= len(benchmark_keys):
 436                stop_reason = "completed_all_benchmarks"
 437                break
 438
 439            b_key = benchmark_keys[b_index]
 440            b_index += 1
 441            iteration_idx += 1
 442
 443            prompt = STANDARD_BENCHMARKS.get(b_key, b_key)
 444            out_dir = self.base_output_dir / f"dogfood_{b_key}"
 445
 446            campaign_state.active_benchmark = b_key
 447            campaign_state.provider_states = self.provider_pool.get_all_statuses()
 448            campaign_state.save(state_dir)
 449
 450            # Check provider pool capacity. Full-app benchmark synthesis is a broad
 451            # task and never local-eligible (#58 Phase 9), so probe with a
 452            # medium-risk task to correctly exclude the quota-free local model from
 453            # this capacity check -- otherwise a machine with Ollama installed would
 454            # never observe "exhausted" and the campaign could run indefinitely.
 455            benchmark_task_probe = TaskSpec(
 456                task_id=f"BENCH-{b_key.upper()}", repository="dogfood",
 457                objective=prompt, task_class="feature", risk_level="medium",
 458            )
 459            available_candidates = self.provider_pool.select_candidates(
 460                task_category="code_heavy",
 461                avoid_provider=avoid_provider,
 462                preferred_agent=preferred_agent,
 463                task=benchmark_task_probe,
 464            )
 465            # `is_all_exhausted()` (true SESSION_EXHAUSTED/RATE_LIMITED quota
 466            # exhaustion) always stops, even in deterministic-baseline mode, same
 467            # as before #58. Local Ollama can never reach that state, so this
 468            # branch is unaffected by its presence. Lack of any *candidate*
 469            # (e.g. no real provider binaries installed) only stops real runs;
 470            # deterministic-baseline mode (used in CI/tests) synthesizes
 471            # regardless of provider availability, exactly as before #58.
 472            if self.provider_pool.is_all_exhausted() or (
 473                not available_candidates and self.synthesizer.synthesis_mode != "deterministic_baseline"
 474            ):
 475                stop_reason = "all_providers_exhausted"
 476                break
 477
 478            # Execute Prompt-to-Product Synthesis
 479            synth_res = self._execute_synthesis(prompt, out_dir, avoid_provider, preferred_agent, iteration_idx)
 480
 481            # Track provider invocation
 482            if synth_res.implementing_provider:
 483                campaign_state.record_provider_invocation(synth_res.implementing_provider)
 484
 485            acc_passed = synth_res.acceptance_report.passed_count if synth_res.acceptance_report else 0
 486            acc_total = synth_res.acceptance_report.total_count if synth_res.acceptance_report else 0
 487
 488            # Record reviewer diversity, distinguishing which reviewers were
 489            # merely assigned a role from which actually executed (#59.1
 490            # Phase 8). Counters only move for real executions.
 491            invocations = list(synth_res.reviewer_invocations)
 492            campaign_state.reviewer_diversity_records.append({
 493                "target": b_key,
 494                "implementer": synth_res.implementing_provider,
 495                "reviewers": synth_res.reviewer_mapping,
 496                "diversity_achieved": synth_res.diversity_achieved,
 497                "assigned": sorted({i["provider"] for i in invocations}),
 498                "invoked": sorted({i["provider"] for i in invocations if i.get("invoked")}),
 499                "completed": sorted({i["provider"] for i in invocations if i.get("completed")}),
 500                "invocations": invocations,
 501            })
 502            for inv in invocations:
 503                if not inv.get("invoked"):
 504                    continue
 505                campaign_state.record_provider_invocation(inv["provider"], role="review")
 506                if inv["provider"] in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS:
 507                    recorder = (
 508                        campaign_state.record_local_success if inv.get("completed")
 509                        else campaign_state.record_local_failure
 510                    )
 511                    recorder(inv.get("ram_after_gib"))
 512
 513            # 3. Check for Framework Gap / Failure -> Trigger Self-Improvement Flywheel
 514            retried = False
 515            bundle_dir = out_dir
 516            if not synth_res.success:
 517                # Classify the observed failure from concrete evidence, and
 518                # grade that evidence. Only deterministic proof, or a symptom
 519                # independently reproduced by another provider, may open a
 520                # self-improvement task against HowlPlane itself (#59.1
 521                # Phase 5).
 522                gap_type, gap_desc, evidence = self._classify_failure(synth_res, b_key)
 523                falsification: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
 524                if evidence == FrameworkGapEvidence.PROVISIONAL_FAILURE:
 525                    signature = self._failure_signature(synth_res, gap_type)
 526                    evidence, rescued, rescued_dir, falsification = self._falsify_framework_gap(
 527                        prompt, b_key, out_dir, synth_res.implementing_provider,
 528                        signature, iteration_idx,
 529                    )
 530                    if rescued is not None:
 531                        # An independent provider synthesized the same
 532                        # benchmark successfully: the framework was never the
 533                        # problem. Adopt that result -- and the directory it
 534                        # was actually built into -- as the outcome.
 535                        synth_res = rescued
 536                        bundle_dir = rescued_dir or bundle_dir
 537                        acc_passed = rescued.acceptance_report.passed_count if rescued.acceptance_report else 0
 538                        acc_total = rescued.acceptance_report.total_count if rescued.acceptance_report else 0
 539                        if rescued.implementing_provider:
 540                            campaign_state.record_provider_invocation(rescued.implementing_provider)
 541
 542                campaign_state.record_gap_falsification({
 543                    "benchmark": b_key,
 544                    "gap_type": gap_type,
 545                    "evidence": evidence.value,
 546                    "failing_provider": synth_res.implementing_provider,
 547                    "attempts": falsification,
 548                })
 549
 550            if not synth_res.success and evidence not in _GAP_ACTIONABLE_EVIDENCE:
 551                # Not enough evidence to modify HowlPlane. Record what was
 552                # observed for future provider routing and fall through to the
 553                # normal iteration result -- no framework gap, no governed
 554                # self-improvement task, no self-modification.
 555                campaign_state.record_provider_specific_failure({
 556                    "benchmark": b_key,
 557                    "gap_type": gap_type,
 558                    "evidence": evidence.value,
 559                    "failing_provider": synth_res.implementing_provider,
 560                    "required_behavior": gap_desc,
 561                    "falsification_attempts": falsification,
 562                })
 563                campaign_state.save(state_dir)
 564
 565            elif not synth_res.success:
 566                gap_code = f"HF_GAP_{b_key.upper()}"
 567                campaign_state.record_framework_gap({
 568                    "code": gap_code,
 569                    "target_component": "howlframe_runtime" if "runtime" in gap_type else "howlplane_synthesis",
 570                    "required_behavior": gap_desc,
 571                    "impact": "blocks_product_synthesis",
 572                    "evidence": evidence.value,
 573                    "falsification_attempts": falsification,
 574                })
 575
 576                # Create concrete, bounded engineering task
 577                eng_task_id = f"ENG-{b_key.upper()}-{iteration_idx:02d}"
 578                campaign_state.active_engineering_task = eng_task_id
 579
 580                if already_parked(campaign_state.parked_tasks, eng_task_id):
 581                    # Never repeatedly re-select an already-parked task (#59 Phase 13).
 582                    campaign_state.save(state_dir)
 583                    continue
 584
 585                # Execute governed engineering task to resolve gap
 586                task_success, git_rec = self._execute_governed_engineering_improvement(
 587                    task_id=eng_task_id,
 588                    benchmark_key=b_key,
 589                    gap_type=gap_type,
 590                    gap_desc=gap_desc,
 591                    avoid_provider=avoid_provider,
 592                    campaign_state=campaign_state,
 593                    state_dir=state_dir,
 594                )
 595
 596                if task_success and git_rec:
 597                    campaign_state.record_task_completed({
 598                        "task_id": eng_task_id,
 599                        "objective": f"Resolve {gap_type} for {b_key}",
 600                        "provider": git_rec.get("provider", "codex"),
 601                        "remediations": 0,
 602                    })
 603                    campaign_state.record_git_integration(git_rec)
 604
 605                    # RETRY ORIGINAL BENCHMARK after fix is integrated!
 606                    retry_res = self._execute_synthesis(prompt, out_dir, avoid_provider, preferred_agent, iteration_idx)
 607                    if retry_res.success:
 608                        synth_res = retry_res
 609                        acc_passed = synth_res.acceptance_report.passed_count if synth_res.acceptance_report else 0
 610                        acc_total = synth_res.acceptance_report.total_count if synth_res.acceptance_report else 0
 611                        retried = True
 612                elif git_rec and git_rec.get("integration_mode") == "parked":
 613                    # Parked awaiting human authority: not a capability
 614                    # failure. Preserve state and continue with other
 615                    # independent work unless this park blocks everything
 616                    # meaningful remaining (#59 Phases 12/13).
 617                    already_succeeded_benchmarks = [
 618                        b.get("benchmark_id") for b in campaign_state.benchmark_history if b.get("success")
 619                    ]
 620                    resolved_gap_codes = [
 621                        t.get("gap_type_resolved") for t in campaign_state.completed_tasks if t.get("gap_type_resolved")
 622                    ]
 623                    blocks_all = compute_blocks_other_work(
 624                        eng_task_id,
 625                        campaign_state.framework_gaps,
 626                        campaign_state.requested_benchmarks,
 627                        already_succeeded_benchmarks,
 628                        resolved_gap_codes,
 629                        campaign_state.parked_tasks,
 630                        current_gap_code=gap_code,
 631                    )
 632                    parked_record = git_rec.get("parked_record", {})
 633                    parked_record["blocks_other_work"] = blocks_all
 634                    campaign_state.record_park(parked_record)
 635                    campaign_state.save(state_dir)
 636                    if blocks_all:
 637                        stop_reason = "AWAITING_HUMAN"
 638                        break
 639                else:
 640                    # Report the engineering task's own provider and its
 641                    # concrete failure reason. Previously this recorded the
 642                    # *synthesis* provider and the fixed string "Engineering
 643                    # task failed or blocked", discarding the git record's
 644                    # failure_reason entirely (#59.1).
 645                    attempts = campaign_state.attempts_for_task(eng_task_id)
 646                    campaign_state.record_task_failed({
 647                        "task_id": eng_task_id,
 648                        "objective": f"Resolve {gap_type} for {b_key}",
 649                        "provider": (git_rec or {}).get("provider") or "unknown",
 650                        "error": (git_rec or {}).get("failure_reason") or "Engineering task failed or blocked",
 651                        "attempts": [
 652                            {"provider": a.get("provider"), "result": a.get("result")} for a in attempts
 653                        ],
 654                    })
 655
 656            iter_res = DogfoodIterationResult(
 657                benchmark_id=b_key,
 658                prompt=prompt,
 659                product_name=synth_res.product_name,
 660                success=synth_res.success,
 661                status=synth_res.status,
 662                passed_checks=acc_passed,
 663                total_checks=acc_total,
 664                repair_cycles=synth_res.repair_cycles,
 665                duration_seconds=synth_res.duration_seconds,
 666                implementing_provider=synth_res.implementing_provider,
 667                reviewing_providers=synth_res.reviewing_providers,
 668                diversity_achieved=synth_res.diversity_achieved,
 669                framework_gaps_count=len(synth_res.framework_gaps),
 670                error_message=synth_res.error_message,
 671                bundle_path=str(bundle_dir) if synth_res.success else None,
 672                retried_after_fix=retried,
 673            )
 674            results.append(iter_res)
 675            campaign_state.record_benchmark_result(iter_res.to_dict())
 676            campaign_state.save(state_dir)
 677
 678            if synth_res.status == "PROVIDER_POOL_EXHAUSTED":
 679                stop_reason = "all_providers_exhausted"
 680                break
 681
 682        if iteration_idx >= effective_max_iterations and stop_reason == "completed_all_benchmarks" and len(results) < len(benchmark_keys):
 683            stop_reason = "campaign_safety_ceiling_reached"
 684
 685        # Cloud exhausted: before stopping, use bounded LOCAL_ONLY_CONTINUATION to
 686        # mop up any outstanding, evidence-backed, local-eligible engineering gaps
 687        # rather than declaring the campaign done with unresolved fixable gaps
 688        # (#58 Phase 13). This never runs unbounded: capped by the durable
 689        # `local_only_iteration_limit` counter, and it never re-attempts full
 690        # benchmark synthesis (not local-eligible; see capacity probe above).
 691        if stop_reason == "all_providers_exhausted":
 692            local_backend = AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend("local_ollama")
 693            if local_backend.is_available():
 694                stop_reason = self._run_local_only_continuation(campaign_state, avoid_provider)
 695
 696        total_elapsed = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
 697        succeeded = sum(1 for r in results if r.success)
 698        failed = len(results) - succeeded
 699
 700        campaign_state.stop_reason = stop_reason
 701        campaign_state.total_duration_seconds = total_elapsed
 702        campaign_state.next_action = "none" if failed == 0 else f"ai dogfood --resume {campaign_id}"
 703        campaign_state.save(state_dir)
 704
 705        return MarathonSummaryReport(
 706            campaign_id=campaign_id,
 707            iterations_attempted=len(results),
 708            iterations_succeeded=succeeded,
 709            iterations_failed=failed,
 710            total_duration_seconds=total_elapsed,
 711            benchmark_results=results,
 712            provider_states=self.provider_pool.get_all_statuses(),
 713            provider_invocations=campaign_state.provider_invocations,
 714            framework_gaps=campaign_state.framework_gaps,
 715            completed_engineering_tasks=campaign_state.completed_tasks,
 716            git_records=campaign_state.git_records,
 717            stopped_reason=stop_reason,
 718            next_action=campaign_state.next_action,
 719            state_dir=str(state_dir),
 720        )
 721
 722    def run_acceptance_canary(self, authority_profile_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 723        """
 724        Live governed integration acceptance canary (#59.2 Phases 15-18).
 725
 726        A first-class, explicitly labeled acceptance action -- not a
 727        fabricated defect -- whose only purpose is to exercise the real
 728        governed git/GitHub lifecycle end-to-end with no mocked boundary:
 729        GovernedTaskOrchestrator -> independent review -> deterministic
 730        verification -> real branch/commit/push/PR via GitIntegrationExecutor
 731        -> live GitHub Ruleset discovery -> CI poll to terminal -> delegated
 732        merge -> real gh merge verification -> remote-main reconciliation ->
 733        local-main sync. Reuses _execute_governed_engineering_improvement
 734        exactly as any other governed engineering task does -- no special
 735        shortcut, no direct git/gh call outside the production executor.
 736
 737        The task is mechanically scoped via TaskSpec.allowed_paths (#59.2
 738        Phase 8) to touch only its designated acceptance evidence artifact
 739        under documentation/task_journals/ -- a fail-closed guarantee, not a
 740        prompt-only request. `risk_level="medium"` excludes the quota-free
 741        local model, since the canary's entire point is proving the
 742        cloud-governed path works.
 743
 744        Returns a dict: campaign_id, task_id, journal_path, task_success,
 745        git_record. Callers should treat completion as verified only when
 746        git_record's merged / remote_main_contains_merge / local_main_synced
 747        are all true.
 748        """
 749        self.base_output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 750        self.campaign_base_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 751
 752        campaign_id = self._generate_campaign_id()
 753        state_dir = self.campaign_base_dir / campaign_id
 754        state_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 755
 756        campaign_state = DurableCampaignState(campaign_id=campaign_id)
 757        self.authority_envelope = self._bind_authority_envelope(
 758            state_dir, campaign_id, authority_profile_id, is_resume=False,
 759        )
 760        campaign_state.authority_envelope = (
 761            self.authority_envelope.to_dict() if self.authority_envelope else None
 762        )
 763        self.git_executor = self._git_executor_factory(
 764            self.authority_envelope, campaign_state.merges_this_campaign,
 765        )
 766
 767        date_str = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
 768        journal_path = f"documentation/task_journals/{date_str}_live_autonomous_acceptance.md"
 769        task_id = f"ACCEPTANCE-{campaign_id}"
 770
 771        start_sha_proc = self._git_runner(self.target_repo, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"], 15)
 772        start_sha = start_sha_proc.stdout.strip() if start_sha_proc.returncode == 0 else "unknown"
 773        digest = self.authority_envelope.policy_digest if self.authority_envelope else "unknown"
 774
 775        task_success, git_rec = self._execute_governed_engineering_improvement(
 776            task_id=task_id,
 777            benchmark_key="LIVE-ACCEPTANCE-CANARY",
 778            gap_type="live_autonomous_acceptance",
 779            gap_desc=(
 780                f"Create or update {journal_path} to record that live acceptance canary "
 781                f"{campaign_id} was initiated: starting main SHA {start_sha}, authority "
 782                f"profile digest {digest}, and its purpose (exercising the real governed "
 783                f"branch/commit/push/PR/CI/merge/remote-verify/local-sync git lifecycle "
 784                f"end-to-end, with no mocked git/gh boundary). Do NOT assert that the merge "
 785                f"lifecycle has completed or succeeded -- at the time this file is written, "
 786                f"the branch/commit/PR/CI/merge steps that follow have not happened yet. The "
 787                f"merge outcome is independently verified by the production git integration "
 788                f"steps themselves, never asserted in this file's content."
 789            ),
 790            risk_level="medium",
 791            campaign_state=campaign_state,
 792            state_dir=state_dir,
 793            allowed_paths=[journal_path],
 794            reviewer_requirements=[
 795                "correctness-reviewer",
 796                "regression-reviewer",
 797                "simplicity-reviewer",
 798            ],
 799        )
 800
 801        if task_success and git_rec:
 802            campaign_state.record_task_completed({
 803                "task_id": task_id,
 804                "objective": "Live autonomous acceptance canary",
 805                "provider": git_rec.get("provider", "unknown"),
 806                "remediations": 0,
 807            })
 808            campaign_state.record_git_integration(git_rec)
 809        campaign_state.stop_reason = "acceptance_canary_complete" if task_success else "acceptance_canary_incomplete"
 810        campaign_state.save(state_dir)
 811
 812        return {
 813            "campaign_id": campaign_id,
 814            "task_id": task_id,
 815            "journal_path": journal_path,
 816            "task_success": task_success,
 817            "git_record": git_rec,
 818            "state_dir": str(state_dir),
 819        }
 820
 821    def _refuse_if_target_is_dirty(
 822        self,
 823        campaign_id: str,
 824        state_dir: Path,
 825        authority_profile_id: str,
 826        started: float,
 827    ) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
 828        """Refuses to begin a new campaign against a working tree someone else owns.
 829
 830        A marathon implements directly in the target checkout: the orchestrator
 831        edits files in place, and `capture_baseline` then distinguishes what the
 832        task changed from what was already there. That is the right design for
 833        attribution, and the wrong thing to start on top of unresolved work --
 834        an unattended run would interleave its own changes with a person's,
 835        commit the result, and open a pull request nobody can cleanly separate.
 836        The HowlFrame checkout is the live example: four modified files owned by
 837        a task that is AWAITING_HUMAN.
 838
 839        This runs before anything: before an authority envelope is bound, before
 840        a provider is invoked, before a task is selected, before a branch,
 841        commit, push, or pull request, and before any directory is created --
 842        including the campaign's own state directory, so a refusal leaves no
 843        trace to clean up.
 844
 845        Nothing is cleaned, stashed, reset, or adopted. Ownership of unexplained
 846        work is a human's call, and this only reports what it found.
 847        """
 848        # A campaign directory configured to live inside the target repository
 849        # is this engine's own state, not a change to refuse over.
 850        internal_prefixes = [DEFAULT_CAMPAIGN_DIR_NAME]
 851        try:
 852            internal_prefixes.append(str(self.campaign_base_dir.relative_to(self.target_repo)))
 853        except ValueError:
 854            pass
 855
 856        tree = describe_working_tree(self.target_repo, extra_internal_prefixes=internal_prefixes)
 857        if tree.is_clean:
 858            return None
 859
 860        return {
 861            "campaign_id": campaign_id,
 862            "state_dir": str(state_dir),
 863            "target_repo": str(self.target_repo),
 864            "repo_slug": self.repo_slug,
 865            "authority_profile": authority_profile_id,
 866            "tasks_attempted": [],
 867            "tasks_completed": [],
 868            "tasks_failed": [],
 869            "tasks_parked": [],
 870            "git_records": [],
 871            "stop_reason": DIRTY_TARGET_STOP_REASON,
 872            "refused": True,
 873            "duration_seconds": round(time.time() - started, 3),
 874            "dirty_files": tree.all_paths(),
 875            "dirty_summary": tree.describe(),
 876            "refusal_reason": (
 877                f"Refusing to start a new marathon: {self.target_repo} contains "
 878                f"uncommitted changes ({tree.describe()}). Resolve or preserve "
 879                f"the existing work before starting a campaign, or pass --resume "
 880                f"to continue the campaign that owns it. Nothing was cleaned, "
 881                f"stashed, or reset, no provider was invoked, and nothing was written."
 882            ),
 883        }
 884
 885    def run_backlog_marathon(
 886        self,
 887        authority_profile_id: str,
 888        max_tasks: int = 3,
 889        max_runtime_hours: float = 8.0,
 890        resume_campaign_id: Optional[str] = None,
 891        roi_floor: float = 0.5,
 892        backlog_files: Optional[List[str]] = None,
 893    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 894        """Works a bounded sequence of a project's ranked backlog items.
 895
 896        This is the marathon the control plane did not previously have.
 897        `run_marathon` iterates *product-synthesis benchmarks*; this iterates
 898        the target repository's own ranked backlog, which is what
 899        `select_next_evidence_backed_task` in the authority profile always
 900        meant and never had an implementation for.
 901
 902        Every task goes through `_execute_governed_engineering_improvement`,
 903        so it gets the identical real lifecycle as any other governed task:
 904        branch, provider implementation with bounded failover, independent
 905        review, deterministic verification, commit, push, PR, CI observation,
 906        and merge only if the bound envelope actually delegates it. Nothing
 907        here is a shortcut around that.
 908
 909        Bounded four ways, all of which stop the loop truthfully rather than
 910        letting it run on:
 911
 912        * `max_tasks` -- how many items may be attempted at all
 913        * `max_runtime_hours` -- wall clock, checked before starting each task
 914          so a task is never begun that cannot plausibly finish
 915        * the eligible backlog -- when it empties, the run stops
 916        * the usable provider pool -- when it empties, the run parks
 917
 918        A task whose authority boundary the envelope does not delegate is
 919        PARKED and the loop continues with other independent work, which is
 920        the `park_and_continue` action the profile grants. The campaign only
 921        stops for a human when nothing else can proceed.
 922        """
 923        from howlplane.control_plane.backlog_source import BacklogSource
 924
 925        started = time.time()
 926        deadline = started + max_runtime_hours * 3600.0
 927
 928        campaign_id = resume_campaign_id or self._generate_campaign_id()
 929        state_dir = self.campaign_base_dir / campaign_id
 930        # The same condition that decides whether campaign state is loaded
 931        # below, evaluated early because the preflight applies only to a new
 932        # campaign. A resumed campaign's durable state legitimately owns an
 933        # unfinished worktree; refusing that would make an interrupted task
 934        # impossible to finish.
 935        is_resume = bool(resume_campaign_id and (state_dir / "campaign_state.json").is_file())
 936
 937        if not is_resume:
 938            refusal = self._refuse_if_target_is_dirty(campaign_id, state_dir, authority_profile_id, started)
 939            if refusal is not None:
 940                return refusal
 941
 942        self.base_output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 943        self.campaign_base_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 944        state_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 945
 946        if is_resume:
 947            campaign_state = DurableCampaignState.load(state_dir)
 948            # A resumed run re-probes providers whose cooldown has elapsed
 949            # rather than inheriting a stale exhausted view of the pool.
 950            self.provider_pool.reset_transient_exhaustion()
 951        else:
 952            campaign_state = DurableCampaignState(campaign_id=campaign_id)
 953
 954        self.authority_envelope = self._bind_authority_envelope(
 955            state_dir, campaign_id, authority_profile_id,
 956            is_resume=bool(resume_campaign_id),
 957        )
 958        campaign_state.authority_envelope = (
 959            self.authority_envelope.to_dict() if self.authority_envelope else None
 960        )
 961        self.git_executor = self._git_executor_factory(
 962            self.authority_envelope, campaign_state.merges_this_campaign,
 963        )
 964
 965        source = BacklogSource(
 966            self.target_repo,
 967            backlog_files=backlog_files or list(DEFAULT_BACKLOG_FILES),
 968            roi_floor=roi_floor,
 969        )
 970        worked: List[str] = []
 971        attempted_ids: List[str] = [
 972            task.get("task_id") for task in campaign_state.completed_tasks
 973        ] + [task.get("task_id") for task in campaign_state.failed_tasks]
 974        attempted_ids += [park.get("task_id") for park in campaign_state.parked_tasks]
 975        attempted_ids = [task_id for task_id in attempted_ids if task_id]
 976
 977        stop_reason = "max_tasks_reached"
 978        while len(worked) < max_tasks:
 979            if time.time() >= deadline:
 980                stop_reason = "max_runtime_reached"
 981                break
 982            if not self.provider_pool.has_available_providers():
 983                # Truthful park, not a loop: nothing usable remains to ask.
 984                stop_reason = "resources_unavailable"
 985                break
 986
 987            selection = source.select()
 988            item = selection.next_item(skip=attempted_ids)
 989            if item is None:
 990                stop_reason = "backlog_exhausted"
 991                break
 992
 993            attempted_ids.append(item.task_id)
 994            detail = source.item_detail(item)
 995            success, git_rec = self._execute_governed_engineering_improvement(
 996                task_id=item.task_id,
 997                benchmark_key=item.task_id,
 998                gap_type="backlog_item",
 999                gap_desc=item.title,
1000                objective_override=(
1001                    f"Resolve {item.source_file} item #{item.item_id}: {item.title}\n\n"
1002                    f"{detail}"
1003                ),
1004                task_class="bug_fix" if item.kind == "bug" else "feature",
1005                commit_message_override=(
1006                    f"fix({item.source_file.replace('.md', '')} #{item.item_id}): "
1007                    f"{item.title[:60]}"
1008                ),
1009                risk_level="medium",
1010                campaign_state=campaign_state,
1011                state_dir=state_dir,
1012            )
1013            worked.append(item.task_id)
1014
1015            record = {
1016                "task_id": item.task_id,
1017                "objective": item.title,
1018                "source_file": item.source_file,
1019                "item_id": item.item_id,
1020                "score": item.score,
1021                "provider": (git_rec or {}).get("provider", "unknown"),
1022            }
1023            if (git_rec or {}).get("integration_mode") == "parked":
1024                campaign_state.record_park((git_rec or {}).get("parked_record", record))
1025            elif success:
1026                campaign_state.record_task_completed(record)
1027            else:
1028                campaign_state.record_task_failed(record)
1029            if git_rec and "parked_record" not in git_rec:
1030                campaign_state.record_git_integration(git_rec)
1031            campaign_state.save(state_dir)
1032
1033        campaign_state.stop_reason = stop_reason
1034        campaign_state.total_duration_seconds = round(time.time() - started, 3)
1035        campaign_state.save(state_dir)
1036
1037        return {
1038            "campaign_id": campaign_id,
1039            "state_dir": str(state_dir),
1040            "target_repo": str(self.target_repo),
1041            "repo_slug": self.repo_slug,
1042            "authority_profile": authority_profile_id,
1043            "tasks_attempted": worked,
1044            "tasks_completed": [t.get("task_id") for t in campaign_state.completed_tasks],
1045            "tasks_failed": [t.get("task_id") for t in campaign_state.failed_tasks],
1046            "tasks_parked": [p.get("task_id") for p in campaign_state.parked_tasks],
1047            "git_records": campaign_state.git_records,
1048            "stop_reason": stop_reason,
1049            "duration_seconds": campaign_state.total_duration_seconds,
1050        }
1051
1052    def _run_local_only_continuation(self, campaign_state: DurableCampaignState, avoid_provider: Optional[str]) -> str:
1053        """
1054        Bounded local-only engineering continuation, entered only once every cloud
1055        provider is exhausted/unavailable (#58 Phase 13). Attempts to resolve
1056        outstanding, evidence-backed framework gaps (recorded during this
1057        campaign) using the quota-free local model, one gap per iteration, up to
1058        `local_only_iteration_limit` consecutive iterations. Never retried
1059        indefinitely: a local failure on a gap escalates immediately rather than
1060        looping, since no cloud provider remains available to escalate to right
1061        now -- that gap is simply left unresolved for a future resumed session.
1062        Returns the final stop_reason.
1063        """
1064        lm = campaign_state.ensure_local_model_defaults()
1065        resolved_codes = {t.get("gap_type_resolved") for t in campaign_state.completed_tasks if t.get("gap_type_resolved")}
1066        pending_gaps = [g for g in campaign_state.framework_gaps if g.get("code") not in resolved_codes]
1067
1068        state_dir = self.campaign_base_dir / campaign_state.campaign_id
1069
1070        for gap in pending_gaps:
1071            if campaign_state.local_only_budget_reached():
1072                campaign_state.save(state_dir)
1073                return "local_only_budget_reached"
1074
1075            if lm.get("overnight_ram_exhausted"):
1076                # #59 Phase 17: RAM remained dangerously low after a prior
1077                # unload this session -- stop attempting further local work
1078                # rather than repeatedly reloading the model.
1079                campaign_state.save(state_dir)
1080                return "local_resource_constrained"
1081
1082            gap_task_id = f"LOCAL-{gap.get('code', 'GAP')}"
1083            if already_parked(campaign_state.parked_tasks, gap_task_id):
1084                continue
1085
1086            ram_before = read_available_memory_gib()
1087            lm["last_available_ram_gib"] = ram_before
1088            iteration_no = campaign_state.increment_local_only_iteration()
1089
1090            task_id = f"LOCAL-{gap.get('code', 'GAP')}-{iteration_no:02d}"
1091            task_success, git_rec = self._execute_governed_engineering_improvement(
1092                task_id=task_id,
1093                benchmark_key=gap.get("code", "unknown"),
1094                gap_type=gap.get("code", "UNKNOWN_GAP"),
1095                gap_desc=gap.get("required_behavior", ""),
1096                avoid_provider=avoid_provider,
1097                risk_level="low",
1098                campaign_state=campaign_state,
1099                state_dir=state_dir,
1100            )
1101
1102            if (
1103                self.authority_envelope is not None and git_rec
1104                and git_rec.get("provider") == "local_ollama"
1105                and git_rec.get("integration_mode") != "parked"
1106            ):
1107                # #59 Phase 17: if available memory remains dangerously low
1108                # after this local inference's (possible) unload, stop
1109                # attempting further local work for the rest of this
1110                # session's local-only continuation rather than repeatedly
1111                # reloading the model against an already-thin margin.
1112                ram_after = read_available_memory_gib()
1113                lm["last_available_ram_gib"] = ram_after
1114                if ram_after is not None and ram_after < self.authority_envelope.local_ram_threshold_gib:
1115                    lm["overnight_ram_exhausted"] = True
1116
1117            if not task_success and git_rec and git_rec.get("integration_mode") == "parked":
1118                # Parked awaiting human authority: not a local-capability
1119                # failure -- don't count it against the local-only budget's
1120                # failure/escalation accounting. Continue with other gaps.
1121                parked_record = git_rec.get("parked_record", {})
1122                parked_record["task_id"] = gap_task_id
1123                campaign_state.record_park(parked_record)
1124                campaign_state.save(state_dir)
1125                continue
1126
1127            if task_success and git_rec and git_rec.get("provider") == "local_ollama":
1128                campaign_state.record_local_success(ram_before)
1129                git_rec["gap_type_resolved"] = gap.get("code")
1130                campaign_state.record_task_completed({
1131                    "task_id": task_id,
1132                    "objective": f"[local_ollama] Resolve {gap.get('code')}",
1133                    "provider": "local_ollama",
1134                    "remediations": 0,
1135                    "gap_type_resolved": gap.get("code"),
1136                })
1137                campaign_state.record_git_integration(git_rec)
1138            elif task_success and git_rec:
1139                # A cloud provider became available mid-continuation; that's fine,
1140                # but it means local-only continuation is no longer necessary.
1141                campaign_state.record_task_completed({
1142                    "task_id": task_id, "objective": f"Resolve {gap.get('code')}",
1143                    "provider": git_rec.get("provider"), "remediations": 0,
1144                })
1145                campaign_state.record_git_integration(git_rec)
1146                campaign_state.reset_local_only_iterations()
1147            else:
1148                campaign_state.record_local_failure(ram_before)
1149                campaign_state.record_local_escalation()
1150                campaign_state.record_task_failed({
1151                    "task_id": task_id, "objective": f"Resolve {gap.get('code')}",
1152                    "provider": "local_ollama", "error": "LOCAL_CAPABILITY_INSUFFICIENT: no eligible provider remained",
1153                })
1154
1155            campaign_state.save(state_dir)
1156
1157        lm["current_availability"] = "AVAILABLE"
1158        return "all_providers_exhausted"
1159
1160    def _execute_synthesis(
1161        self,
1162        prompt: str,
1163        out_dir: Path,
1164        avoid_provider: Optional[str],
1165        preferred_agent: Optional[str],
1166        iteration_idx: int,
1167    ) -> SynthesisResult:
1168        return self.synthesizer.create_from_prompt(
1169            prompt=prompt,
1170            output_dir=out_dir,
1171            avoid_provider=avoid_provider,
1172            preferred_agent=preferred_agent,
1173            port=8088 + (iteration_idx % 50),
1174        )
1175
1176    def _classify_failure(
1177        self, synth_res: SynthesisResult, benchmark_key: str
1178    ) -> Tuple[str, str, FrameworkGapEvidence]:
1179        """
1180        Classifies an observed synthesis failure from concrete evidence, and
1181        grades how strong that evidence is (#59.1 Phase 5).
1182
1183        The three deterministic sources -- the capability negotiator declaring
1184        a gap, the negotiator blocking the product outright, and the compiler
1185        rejecting required syntax -- prove something about the framework
1186        independently of whatever any model generated, so they are actionable
1187        immediately. A failing acceptance run or a general orchestration
1188        failure only proves that *this attempt* did not work, so it starts out
1189        provisional and must survive cross-provider falsification first.
1190        """
1191        proof = FrameworkGapEvidence.DETERMINISTIC_FRAMEWORK_PROOF
1192        provisional = FrameworkGapEvidence.PROVISIONAL_FAILURE
1193        if synth_res.framework_gaps:
1194            return "HOWLFRAME_RUNTIME_GAP", synth_res.framework_gaps[0].required_behavior, proof
1195        if synth_res.status == "PRODUCT_BLOCKED":
1196            desc = synth_res.error_message or "Product blocked by capability negotiator"
1197            return "HOWLFRAME_CAPABILITY_GAP", desc, proof
1198        if synth_res.error_message and "Compiler error" in synth_res.error_message:
1199            return "HOWLFRAME_COMPILER_GAP", synth_res.error_message, proof
1200        if synth_res.error_message and "Acceptance failure" in synth_res.error_message:
1201            return "SYNTHESIS_REPAIR_FAIL", synth_res.error_message, provisional
1202        desc = synth_res.error_message or f"General synthesis failure on {benchmark_key}"
1203        return "HOWLPLANE_ORCHESTRATION_GAP", desc, provisional
1204
1205    @staticmethod
1206    def _failure_signature(synth_res: SynthesisResult, gap_type: str) -> str:
1207        """
1208        A normalized, deterministic identity for a synthesis failure, used to
1209        decide whether two providers failed the *same* way.
1210
1211        Deliberately built from structural facts -- the classified gap type and
1212        the identity of the acceptance check that failed -- rather than
1213        free-text message equality, which would vary with model wording,
1214        timings and paths.
1215        """
1216        detail = ""
1217        message = synth_res.error_message or ""
1218        marker = "Acceptance failure:"
1219        if marker in message:
1220            # "...Acceptance failure: server_health_probe: Server did not..."
1221            remainder = message.split(marker, 1)[1].strip()
1222            detail = remainder.split(":", 1)[0].strip()
1223        elif synth_res.framework_gaps:
1224            detail = synth_res.framework_gaps[0].code
1225        return f"{gap_type}|{detail}"
1226
1227    def _falsify_framework_gap(
1228        self,
1229        prompt: str,
1230        benchmark_key: str,
1231        out_dir: Path,
1232        failing_provider: Optional[str],
1233        signature: str,
1234        iteration_idx: int,
1235    ) -> Tuple[FrameworkGapEvidence, Optional[SynthesisResult], Optional[Path], List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
1236        """
1237        Tries to falsify a provisional framework gap by re-synthesizing the
1238        same benchmark with independent providers (#59.1 Phase 5).
1239
1240        Bounded by `framework_gap_confirmations_required` (default 1), so this
1241        never becomes an unbounded retry loop, and it runs inside the current
1242        benchmark iteration rather than consuming iteration budget.
1243
1244        Returns (evidence, succeeding_result, its_output_dir, attempt_records):
1245          * an independent provider SUCCEEDS -> PROVIDER_SPECIFIC_FAILURE, plus
1246            the successful result and the directory it was built into, which
1247            the caller uses as the benchmark's outcome and bundle path. No
1248            framework gap, no self-modification.
1249          * an independent provider reproduces the SAME deterministic
1250            signature -> VERIFIED_FRAMEWORK_GAP.
1251          * it fails differently, or no independent provider exists ->
1252            PROVISIONAL_FAILURE. Still not enough to modify HowlPlane.
1253        """
1254        attempts: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
1255        confirmations = 0
1256        tried = {failing_provider} if failing_provider else set()
1257
1258        # Falsification re-runs full product synthesis, which is never
1259        # local-eligible (#58 Phase 9). Exclude local providers here so the
1260        # attempt is attributed to the provider actually asked to do the work
1261        # rather than silently reassigned inside the synthesizer.
1262        probe = TaskSpec(
1263            task_id=f"FALSIFY-{benchmark_key.upper()}", repository="howlplane",
1264            objective=f"Independently re-synthesize {benchmark_key}",
1265            task_class="feature", risk_level="medium",
1266        )
1267        while confirmations < self.framework_gap_confirmations_required:
1268            candidates = [
1269                c for c in self.provider_pool.select_candidates(
1270                    task_category="code_heavy", task=probe,
1271                )
1272                if c not in tried and c not in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS
1273            ]
1274            if not candidates:
1275                return FrameworkGapEvidence.PROVISIONAL_FAILURE, None, None, attempts
1276
1277            provider = candidates[0]
1278            tried.add(provider)
1279            confirm_dir = out_dir.parent / f"{out_dir.name}_falsify{len(attempts) + 1}"
1280            confirm_res = self._execute_synthesis(
1281                prompt, confirm_dir, failing_provider, provider, iteration_idx,
1282            )
1283            if confirm_res.success:
1284                attempts.append({"provider": provider, "outcome": "SUCCESS"})
1285                return (
1286                    FrameworkGapEvidence.PROVIDER_SPECIFIC_FAILURE, confirm_res, confirm_dir, attempts,
1287                )
1288
1289            confirm_type, _desc, confirm_evidence = self._classify_failure(confirm_res, benchmark_key)
1290            confirm_signature = self._failure_signature(confirm_res, confirm_type)
1291            same_symptom = confirm_signature == signature
1292            attempts.append({
1293                "provider": provider,
1294                "outcome": "FAILED_SAME_SYMPTOM" if same_symptom else "FAILED_DIFFERENT_SYMPTOM",
1295                "signature": confirm_signature,
1296            })
1297            if confirm_evidence == FrameworkGapEvidence.DETERMINISTIC_FRAMEWORK_PROOF:
1298                # An independent provider hit a deterministic framework wall.
1299                return FrameworkGapEvidence.VERIFIED_FRAMEWORK_GAP, None, None, attempts
1300            if not same_symptom:
1301                # Two providers failing differently is evidence about the
1302                # providers, not about the framework.
1303                return FrameworkGapEvidence.PROVIDER_SPECIFIC_FAILURE, None, None, attempts
1304            confirmations += 1
1305
1306        return FrameworkGapEvidence.VERIFIED_FRAMEWORK_GAP, None, None, attempts
1307
1308    def _persist_git_record(
1309        self,
1310        git_rec: "GitIntegrationRecord",
1311        campaign_state: Optional[DurableCampaignState],
1312        state_dir: Optional[Path],
1313    ) -> None:
1314        """
1315        Incrementally persists a GitIntegrationRecord's current state
1316        (#59 Phase 2/22): saved after each real step, not just once at the
1317        end, so crash-resume reconciliation has an accurate last-known
1318        state to check against observable remote truth.
1319        """
1320        if campaign_state is None or state_dir is None:
1321            return
1322        campaign_state.record_git_integration(git_rec.to_dict())
1323        campaign_state.save(state_dir)
1324
1325    def _authorize_and_execute_git_step(
1326        self,
1327        action_type: str,
1328        arguments: Dict[str, Any],
1329        task_id: str,
1330        run_dir: Path,
1331        git_rec: "GitIntegrationRecord",
1332    ) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
1333        """
1334        Evaluates then executes a single real git/GitHub step via
1335        self.git_executor. Returns the step's metadata dict on success, or
1336        None (with git_rec.failure_reason set) on denial/failure -- never
1337        fabricates a success record for a step that did not actually
1338        complete.
1339        """
1340        action = ProposedAction(
1341            action_type=action_type,
1342            target_repo=self.repo_slug or self.target_repo.name,
1343            arguments=arguments,
1344        )
1345        verdict, decision_id, reason = self.git_executor.evaluate(action, self.target_repo, run_dir)
1346        if verdict != "ALLOW":
1347            git_rec.failure_reason = f"{action_type}: {reason or verdict}"
1348            return None
1349        if action_type in {"push_task_branch", "create_pull_request", "merge_pull_request"}:
1350            status, receipt, reconciliation_reason = self.git_executor.query_execution_status(
1351                decision_id or "", self.target_repo, run_dir, action, task_id
1352            )
1353            if status == "already_executed":
1354                if receipt is not None:
1355                    return receipt.native_receipt
1356                git_rec.failure_reason = reconciliation_reason
1357                return {}
1358            if status == "reconciliation_conflict":
1359                # An unexpected remote task branch is neither a push success
1360                # nor an engineering failure. Preserve it for a human rather
1361                # than retrying, force-pushing, or overwriting remote work.
1362                git_rec.integration_mode = "parked"
1363                git_rec.failure_reason = reconciliation_reason
1364                return None
1365        result = self.git_executor.execute(decision_id, self.target_repo, run_dir, action, task_id)
1366        if result.status != "success":
1367            git_rec.failure_reason = f"{action_type}: {result.error_message}"
1368            return None
1369        return result.metadata
1370
1371    def _run_step_or_bail(
1372        self,
1373        action_type: str,
1374        arguments: Dict[str, Any],
1375        task_id: str,
1376        run_dir: Path,
1377        git_rec: "GitIntegrationRecord",
1378        campaign_state: Optional[DurableCampaignState],
1379        state_dir: Optional[Path],
1380        apply_metadata: Callable[[Dict[str, Any]], None],
1381    ) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
1382        """
1383        Runs one real git/GitHub step, applies its metadata to `git_rec` on
1384        success, and incrementally persists either way. Every step in the
1385        real integration sequence shares this exact bail-and-persist shape
1386        (#59 Phase 2/22); centralizing it here means the sequence in
1387        _execute_governed_engineering_improvement is a series of one-line
1388        calls rather than repeated boilerplate per step.
1389        """
1390        meta = self._authorize_and_execute_git_step(action_type, arguments, task_id, run_dir, git_rec)
1391        if meta is not None:
1392            apply_metadata(meta)
1393        self._persist_git_record(git_rec, campaign_state, state_dir)
1394        return meta
1395
1396    def _persist_provider_states(
1397        self,
1398        campaign_state: Optional[DurableCampaignState],
1399        state_dir: Optional[Path],
1400    ) -> None:
1401        """
1402        Snapshots the pool's live provider statuses into durable campaign
1403        state immediately (#59.1 Blocker 5). Previously statuses were only
1404        written once per benchmark iteration, so a campaign could report a
1405        provider AVAILABLE after that provider had already returned a quota
1406        error.
1407        """
1408        if campaign_state is None:
1409            return
1410        campaign_state.provider_states = self.provider_pool.get_all_statuses()
1411        if state_dir is not None:
1412            campaign_state.save(state_dir)

1414    def _record_attempt(
1415        self,
1416        campaign_state: Optional[DurableCampaignState],
1417        state_dir: Optional[Path],
1418        task_id: str,
1419        provider: str,
1420        attempt_index: int,
1421        *,
1422        result: str,
1423        failure_class: Optional[str],
1424        exit_code: Optional[int],
1425        error_digest: str,
1426        delta_reconciled: bool,
1427        duration: float,
1428    ) -> None:
1429        """Appends and immediately persists one provider attempt (#59.1 Phase 4)."""
1430        if campaign_state is None:
1431            return
1432        attempt = EngineeringAttempt(
1433            task_id=task_id,
1434            provider=provider,
1435            attempt_index=attempt_index,
1436            result=result,
1437            failure_class=failure_class,
1438            exit_code=exit_code,
1439            error_digest=EngineeringAttempt.digest(error_digest),
1440            delta_reconciled=delta_reconciled,
1441            duration_seconds=round(duration, 3),
1442        )
1443        campaign_state.record_engineering_attempt(attempt.to_dict())
1444        if state_dir is not None:
1445            campaign_state.save(state_dir)

1447    def _reconcile_attempt_state(self, baseline: Any, task_id: str, attempt_index: int) -> bool:
1448        """
1449        Restores the repository to an attempt's baseline before handing it to
1450        the next provider (#59.1 Phase 3).
1451
1452        A provider can exhaust its quota *after* it has already written files.
1453        Handing those partial, unreviewed changes to the next provider would
1454        make the fallback attempt's delta a mixture of two providers' work.
1455        Equally, discarding them wholesale would violate the #56 recovery
1456        invariants.
1457
1458        So: capture the delta, checkpoint it as attempt evidence, then revert
1459        *only the paths that delta names*. Tracked paths are restored with
1460        `git checkout --`; paths the attempt newly added are removed. Any file
1461        the attempt did not touch -- including concurrent user work and
1462        unrelated dirty state -- is never inspected and never modified. There
1463        is deliberately no `git reset --hard` and no `git clean` anywhere on
1464        this path.
1465
1466        Returns True when there was a task-owned delta that had to be reverted.
1467        """
1468        try:
1469            delta = capture_delta(self.target_repo, baseline)
1470        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - reconciliation must never crash the campaign
1471            return False
1472        if delta is None or delta.is_empty:
1473            return False
1474
1475        attempt_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_id / "attempts" / f"{attempt_index:02d}"
1476        try:
1477            attempt_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1478            (attempt_dir / "delta.json").write_text(json.dumps(delta.to_dict(), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
1479            (attempt_dir / "delta.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content or "", encoding="utf-8")
1480        except OSError:
1481            pass
1482
1483        added = list(delta.files_added)
1484        restorable = list(delta.files_modified) + list(delta.files_deleted)
1485        for rel_path in restorable:
1486            self._git_runner(self.target_repo, ["checkout", "--", rel_path], 30)
1487        for rel_path in added:
1488            candidate = (self.target_repo / rel_path).resolve()
1489            # Never step outside the repository, whatever the delta claims.
1490            if not str(candidate).startswith(str(self.target_repo.resolve())):
1491                continue
1492            try:
1493                if candidate.is_file():
1494                    candidate.unlink()
1495            except OSError:
1496                pass
1497        return True
1498
1499    @staticmethod
1500    def _attempt_result_for(event: Optional[Any], final_state: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
1501        """
1502        Maps one attempt's observed outcome onto (attempt_result, failure_class).
1503
1504        Only a ProviderExhaustionEvent -- produced by detect_exhaustion() from
1505        the provider's own execution result -- can yield a provider-availability
1506        class. Bad generated code, failing tests and rejected reviews all stay
1507        ENGINEERING_FAILURE and must never mark a provider exhausted (#59.1).
1508        """
1509        if event is not None:
1510            status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RATE_LIMITED if event.failure_type == "rate_limit" else (
1511                ProviderAvailabilityStatus.SESSION_EXHAUSTED if event.failure_type == "session_limit"
1512                else ProviderAvailabilityStatus.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED if event.failure_type == "quota_exhausted"
1513                else ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE
1514            )
1515            failure_class = (
1516                FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE
1517                if event.failure_type in ("unavailable", "authentication_required")
1518                else FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_EXHAUSTED
1519            )
1520            return status.value, failure_class
1521        if final_state in ("awaiting_human", "blocked"):
1522            return "AUTHORITY_BLOCKED", FAILURE_CLASS_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED
1523        return "ENGINEERING_FAILURE", FAILURE_CLASS_ENGINEERING
1524
1525    def execute_factory_work_item(
1526        self,
1527        work_item: Any,
1528        risk_level: str = "medium",
1529        task_class: str = "feature",
1530        files_changed: Optional[List[str]] = None,
1531        dispatch_id: Optional[str] = None,
1532        run_mode: str = "continuous",
1533    ) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[Dict[str, Any]]]:
1534        """Public adapter to run a single factory WorkItem through the governed engineering lifecycle.
1535
1536        The factory supervisor selects portfolio-level work; this method hands
1537        the selected item to the same bounded lifecycle used by backlog and
1538        marathon tasks, instead of duplicating it.
1539        """
1540        objective = f"{work_item.title}\n\n{work_item.description}".strip()
1541        return self._execute_governed_engineering_improvement(
1542            task_id=work_item.work_item_id,
1543            benchmark_key=work_item.work_item_id,
1544            gap_type="factory_work_item",
1545            gap_desc=objective,
1546            objective_override=objective,
1547            risk_level=risk_level,
1548            task_class=task_class,
1549            files_changed=files_changed,
1550            repository_override=work_item.repository,
1551            dispatch_id=dispatch_id,
1552            run_mode=run_mode,
1553        )
1554
1555    def _execute_governed_engineering_improvement(
1556        self,
1557        task_id: str,
1558        benchmark_key: str,
1559        gap_type: str,
1560        gap_desc: str,
1561        avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None,
1562        risk_level: str = "medium",
1563        campaign_state: Optional[DurableCampaignState] = None,
1564        state_dir: Optional[Path] = None,
1565        allowed_paths: Optional[List[str]] = None,
1566        reviewer_requirements: Optional[List[str]] = None,
1567        objective_override: Optional[str] = None,
1568        task_class: str = "bug_fix",
1569        commit_message_override: Optional[str] = None,
1570        files_changed: Optional[List[str]] = None,
1571        repository_override: Optional[str] = None,
1572        dispatch_id: Optional[str] = None,
1573        run_mode: str = "continuous",
1574    ) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[Dict[str, Any]]]:
1575        """
1576        Executes a bounded engineering task through the REAL governed
1577        lifecycle (#59 Phase 2): task branch -> real provider implementation
1578        via GovernedTaskOrchestrator -> independent review -> deterministic
1579        verification -> real commit/push/PR/CI-observe/merge via
1580        GitIntegrationExecutor -> independent remote verification.
1581
1582        No fabricated Git values are ever produced. Returns (True, git_rec)
1583        only after the full real lifecycle -- through remote-verified
1584        merge -- has completed. Returns (False, git_rec_with_integration_mode_parked)
1585        when a boundary requires human authority the campaign's envelope
1586        does not delegate; the caller records the park and continues with
1587        other independent work rather than treating it as a failure.
1588
1589        `risk_level="low"` (used by bounded LOCAL_ONLY_CONTINUATION) makes the
1590        quota-free local model an eligible candidate for this specific fix;
1591        the default "medium" keeps normal in-campaign gap fixes on cloud
1592        providers, consistent with Tier-3 local eligibility rules (#58 Phase 9).
1593
1594        `allowed_paths` (#59.2 Phase 8), when given, mechanically restricts
1595        the eventual commit to exactly those repo-relative paths --
1596        GitIntegrationExecutor.stage_and_commit rejects any other path before
1597        staging anything. Used by the live acceptance canary to guarantee it
1598        can touch only its designated evidence artifact.
1599        """
1600        objective = objective_override or f"Resolve {gap_type} for {benchmark_key}: {gap_desc}"
1601        # The repository is the one this engine was pointed at, not a constant.
1602        # It was hardcoded to "howlplane", which is correct for self-improvement
1603        # dogfooding and wrong for every other target -- including the HowlFrame
1604        # backlog marathon, whose whole purpose is to work another repository.
1605        repository = repository_override or self.target_repo.name
1606        target_identities = {
1607            self.target_repo.name,
1608            str(self.target_repo),
1609            self.repo_slug,
1610        }
1611        if repository_override and repository_override not in target_identities:
1612            return False, {
1613                "task_id": task_id,
1614                "target_repo": repository_override,
1615                "integration_mode": "parked",
1616                "failure_reason": "TARGET_REPOSITORY_MISMATCH",
1617                "failure_class": FAILURE_CLASS_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED,
1618                "failure_code": "target_repository_mismatch",
1619            }
1620        gap_probe = TaskSpec(
1621            task_id=task_id, repository=repository,
1622            objective=objective, task_class=task_class, risk_level=risk_level,
1623            allowed_paths=list(allowed_paths or []),
1624            reviewer_requirements=list(reviewer_requirements or []),
1625        )
1626        candidates = self.provider_pool.select_candidates(
1627            task_category="code_heavy",
1628            avoid_provider=avoid_provider,
1629            task=gap_probe,
1630        )
1631        if not candidates:
1632            return False, {
1633                "task_id": task_id,
1634                "target_repo": repository,
1635                "failure_reason": "NO_ELIGIBLE_PROVIDER",
1636                "failure_class": FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
1637                "failure_code": "no_eligible_provider",
1638            }
1639
1640        provider = candidates[0]
1641        gap_probe.preferred_agent = provider
1642        commit_message = commit_message_override or (
1643            f"fix({benchmark_key}): resolve {gap_type} found during marathon dogfooding"
1644        )
1645
1646        git_rec = GitIntegrationRecord(
1647            task_id=task_id, target_repo=repository, provider=provider,
1648            commit_message=commit_message,
1649        )
1650
1651        planned_actions = [
1652            f"create branch fix/{task_id}", "commit task-owned files", "push branch",
1653            "open pull request", "merge when required checks green",
1654        ]
1655
1656        boundary = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate_with_delegated_authority(
1657            gap_probe, planned_actions, self.authority_envelope, self.target_repo,
1658            repo_slug=self.repo_slug, files_changed=files_changed,
1659        )
1660        if boundary.requires_human_approval:
1661            packet = boundary.decision_packet
1662            parked = ParkedTaskRecord(
1663                task_id=task_id,
1664                objective=objective,
1665                boundary_type=boundary.triggered_boundaries[0] if boundary.triggered_boundaries else "unknown",
1666                requested_action="governed_engineering_improvement",
1667                repository=self.repo_slug or repository,
1668                evidence=list(packet.evidence) if packet else [],
1669                risks=list(packet.risks) if packet else [],
1670                verification_state="not_reached",
1671                why_delegated_authority_did_not_apply="; ".join(boundary.triggered_boundaries),
1672                decision_packet=packet.to_dict() if packet else {},
1673            )
1674            git_rec.failure_reason = "AWAITING_HUMAN"
1675            return False, {
1676                "task_id": task_id, "target_repo": repository, "integration_mode": "parked",
1677                "provider": provider, "parked_record": parked.to_dict(),
1678            }
1679
1680        if self.git_executor is None:
1681            # No --authority-profile was bound for this campaign, so no
1682            # GitIntegrationExecutor was ever constructed (see cli.py's
1683            # campaign setup, which only builds one when an envelope is
1684            # present). This is a human-authority condition, not an
1685            # engineering failure: without delegated authority there is no
1686            # basis to create a branch/push/PR/merge autonomously. Park it
1687            # exactly like the AWAITING_HUMAN branch above rather than
1688            # returning a bare failure the supervisor would count against
1689            # failure_count/backoff (#B5).
1690            parked = ParkedTaskRecord(
1691                task_id=task_id,
1692                objective=objective,
1693                boundary_type="no_authority_envelope",
1694                requested_action="governed_engineering_improvement",
1695                repository=self.repo_slug or repository,
1696                evidence=["No --authority-profile was bound for this campaign, so no delegated authority exists for git/GitHub actions."],
1697                verification_state="not_reached",
1698                why_delegated_authority_did_not_apply="no_authority_envelope",
1699            )
1700            git_rec.failure_reason = "AWAITING_HUMAN"
1701            return False, {
1702                "task_id": task_id, "target_repo": repository, "integration_mode": "parked",
1703                "provider": provider, "parked_record": parked.to_dict(),
1704            }
1705
