1706        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
1707        # Bounded provider failover (#59.1 Phase 2).
1708        #
1709        # A single governed engineering task may be attempted by several
1710        # providers in turn. A provider that reports quota/session exhaustion
1711        # or unavailability is marked in the pool -- so it is not handed the
1712        # next task either -- and the next eligible provider is tried. A
1713        # provider that merely produced bad code, failed tests or a rejected
1714        # review is NOT marked exhausted and does NOT trigger failover: that is
1715        # a normal engineering failure and follows normal remediation policy.
1716        #
1717        # Attempts are bounded by the finite eligible provider set: `attempted`
1718        # only grows, and any provider already tried is filtered out of the
1719        # next selection, so the loop cannot spin.
1720        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
1721        orch_config = OrchestrationConfig(
1722            acquire_locks=True,
1723            record_evidence=bool(self.ledger),
1724            # Share this campaign's pool so governed reviews get bounded
1725            # alternate-provider failover and so review-time quota exhaustion
1726            # is visible to implementation failover (#59.2 Phases 4/9).
1727            provider_pool=self.provider_pool,
1728            run_mode=run_mode,
1729        )
1730        attempted: set = set()
1731        result = None
1732        attempt_index = 0
1733        previous_provider: Optional[str] = None
1734
1735        while True:
1736            attempt_index += 1
1737            attempted.add(provider)
1738            gap_probe.preferred_agent = provider
1739            gap_probe.metadata["provider_attempt_index"] = attempt_index
1740            gap_probe.metadata["failover_from_resource_id"] = previous_provider
1741            # One trajectory per (dispatch, attempt). Without this the
1742            # trajectory identity falls back to the run directory, which the
1743            # factory reuses for every attempt at a work item
1744            # (.task_runs/<work_item_id>), so a retry derives the id the first
1745            # attempt already wrote. The trajectory store is deliberately
1746            # immutable -- identical content is an idempotent no-op, differing
1747            # content raises -- so the retry died with "Artifact 'traj-...'
1748            # already exists with different content_digest" before it could
1749            # reach a provider at all. dispatch_id is unique per dispatch, so
1750            # attempts stay distinguishable across ticks and across restarts.
1751            if dispatch_id:
1752                gap_probe.metadata["trajectory_event_id"] = (
1753                    f"{dispatch_id}:{attempt_index}"
1754                )
1755            git_rec.provider = provider
1756            attempt_started = time.time()
1757            attempt_baseline = None
1758            try:
1759                attempt_baseline = capture_baseline(self.target_repo)
1760            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - baseline is best-effort attempt evidence
1761                attempt_baseline = None
1762
1763            orchestrator = self._orchestrator_factory(orch_config)
1764            try:
1765                result = orchestrator.run(gap_probe, planned_actions)
1766            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - real provider/orchestrator failures must not crash the campaign
1767                git_rec.failure_reason = f"orchestrator_exception: {exc}"
1768                self._record_attempt(
1769                    campaign_state, state_dir, task_id, provider, attempt_index,
1770                    result="ENGINEERING_FAILURE", failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_ENGINEERING,
1771                    exit_code=None, error_digest=str(exc), delta_reconciled=False,
1772                    duration=time.time() - attempt_started,
1773                )
1774                self._persist_git_record(git_rec, campaign_state, state_dir)
1775                return False, git_rec.to_dict()
1776
1777            if campaign_state is not None and result.trajectory_id:
1778                campaign_state.record_trajectory(result.trajectory_id)
1779                campaign_state.save(state_dir)
1780
1781            exec_res = result.provider_execution
1782            if exec_res is not None and campaign_state is not None:
1783                campaign_state.record_provider_invocation(provider, role="implementation")
1784
1785            if result.final_state == "complete":
1786                self._record_attempt(
1787                    campaign_state, state_dir, task_id, provider, attempt_index,
1788                    result="COMPLETE", failure_class=None,
1789                    exit_code=exec_res.exit_code if exec_res else 0,
1790                    error_digest="", delta_reconciled=False,
1791                    duration=time.time() - attempt_started,
1792                )
1793                break
1794
1795            # Ask the pool -- from the provider's own execution result, never
1796            # from summary text -- whether this was an availability failure.
1797            event = None
1798            if exec_res is not None:
1799                if result.failure_class in {
1800                    FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_EXHAUSTED,
1801                    FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
1802                }:
1803                    state = self.provider_pool.get_resource_status(provider)
1804                    event = state.exhaustion_event if state is not None else None
1805                else:
1806                    event = self.provider_pool.detect_exhaustion(
1807                        provider, exec_res, task_id=task_id
1808                    )
1809            attempt_result, failure_class = self._attempt_result_for(event, result.final_state)
1810
1811            # The factory pin steers one governed attempt; it is not an owner
1812            # restriction on later workers. A local deadline creates no global
1813            # exhaustion event, but can still use this finite provider loop.
1814            budget_retry = (
1815                event is None and exec_res is not None and not exec_res.success
1816                and result.final_state == "failed"
1817                and result.failure_class in {
1818                    FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_EXHAUSTED,
1819                    FAILURE_CLASS_EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED,
1820                }
1821                and ProviderPoolManager.classify_result(provider, exec_res).value
1822                == FAILURE_CLASS_EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
1823            )
1824            if budget_retry:
1825                attempt_result = failure_class = FAILURE_CLASS_EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
1826
1827            reconciled = False
1828            if event is not None and attempt_baseline is not None:
1829                reconciled = self._reconcile_attempt_state(attempt_baseline, task_id, attempt_index)
1830            if budget_retry:
1831                # Governed failure should already have preserved its evidence
1832                # and restored the attempt baseline. Never assume it did.
1833                # The check is: "has the repository actually returned to the
1834                # captured pre-attempt baseline?" -- not "do two baseline objects
1835                # contain identical metadata". Snapshot-by-snapshot content
1836                # verification is used only for the pre-existing files we
1837                # retained, and a non-empty task delta is a hard failure.
1838                try:
1839                    reconciled, _ = is_baseline_restored(self.target_repo, attempt_baseline)
1840                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - unknown state cannot be handed off
1841                    reconciled = False
1842
1843            self._record_attempt(
1844                campaign_state, state_dir, task_id, provider, attempt_index,
1845                result=attempt_result, failure_class=failure_class,
1846                exit_code=exec_res.exit_code if exec_res else None,
1847                error_digest=(exec_res.stderr if exec_res else "") or (result.error_message or ""),
1848                delta_reconciled=reconciled,
1849                duration=time.time() - attempt_started,
1850            )
1851            # The pool's updated view of provider availability must be durable
1852            # before the next selection -- a campaign that crashes here must
1853            # not resume believing an exhausted provider is AVAILABLE (#59.1
1854            # Blocker 5).
1855            self._persist_provider_states(campaign_state, state_dir)
1856
1857            if budget_retry and not reconciled:
1858                git_rec.failure_reason = "STATE_FAILURE: budget retry baseline not restored"
1859                self._persist_git_record(git_rec, campaign_state, state_dir)
1860                record = git_rec.to_dict()
1861                record["failure_class"] = FAILURE_CLASS_ENGINEERING
1862                record["failure_code"] = "budget_retry_baseline_not_restored"
1863                return False, record
1864
1865            if event is None and not budget_retry:
1866                # Engineering failure or authority block: do not fail over.
1867                git_rec.failure_reason = f"orchestrator_final_state:{result.final_state}"
1868                self._persist_git_record(git_rec, campaign_state, state_dir)
1869                record = git_rec.to_dict()
1870                record["failure_class"] = result.failure_class or failure_class
1871                record["failure_code"] = "orchestrator_terminal_state"
1872                return False, record
1873
1874            # `gap_probe.preferred_agent` holds this loop's *current* provider,
1875            # not an operator override: gap_probe is constructed above without
1876            # one, and the pin exists only to steer the orchestrator at each
1877            # attempt. select_resource reads a task-carried preference as an
1878            # explicit override and empties the eligible set when that resource
1879            # is no longer selectable (provider_pool.py, `if selected is None:
1880            # candidates = []`), so asking the pool while the just-failed
1881            # provider is still pinned reports that nothing is eligible while
1882            # healthy providers are standing by. Ask the unpinned question; the
1883            # top of the loop re-pins whichever provider is chosen next.
1884            gap_probe.preferred_agent = None
1885            next_candidates = [
1886                c for c in self.provider_pool.select_candidates(
1887                    task_category="code_heavy", avoid_provider=avoid_provider, task=gap_probe,
1888                )
1889                if c not in attempted
1890            ]
1891            if not next_candidates:
1892                git_rec.failure_reason = (
1893                    f"NO_ELIGIBLE_PROVIDER_REMAINING: tried {', '.join(sorted(attempted))}"
1894                )
1895                self._persist_git_record(git_rec, campaign_state, state_dir)
1896                record = git_rec.to_dict()
1897                record["failure_class"] = FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE
1898                record["failure_code"] = "no_eligible_provider_remaining"
1899                return False, record
1900            previous_provider = provider
1901            provider = next_candidates[0]
1902            # Every hop reuses this one TaskSpec, and the attempt that just
1903            # failed left it in `failed`. The lifecycle allows
1904            # failed -> planned precisely so work can be re-attempted, and
1905            # refuses failed -> implementing, so without this the next
1906            # orchestrator.run dies with "Cannot transition task ... from
1907            # 'failed' to 'implementing'" -- the failover selects a healthy
1908            # provider and then cannot hand it the task.
1909            if gap_probe.current_state == "failed":
1910                gap_probe.transition_to("planned", reason="provider_failover_retry")
1911
1912        delta = result.final_delta
1913        if delta is None or delta.is_empty:
1914            git_rec.failure_reason = "EMPTY_DELTA: governed implementation produced no changes to integrate"
1915            self._persist_git_record(git_rec, campaign_state, state_dir)
1916            return False, git_rec.to_dict()
1917
1918        run_dir = Path(result.run_dir) if result.run_dir else (self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_id)
1919        paths = list(delta.files_added) + list(delta.files_modified) + list(delta.files_deleted)
1920
1921        # The pre-execution estimate is not an authority grant for unknown
1922        # output. Evaluate the observed final delta before any git operation.
1923        final_boundary = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate_with_delegated_authority(
1924            gap_probe,
1925            planned_actions,
1926            self.authority_envelope,
1927            self.target_repo,
1928            repo_slug=self.repo_slug,
1929            files_changed=paths,
1930        )
1931        if final_boundary.requires_human_approval:
1932            packet = final_boundary.decision_packet
1933            git_rec.integration_mode = "parked"
1934            git_rec.failure_reason = "AWAITING_HUMAN_FINAL_DELTA"
1935            parked = ParkedTaskRecord(
1936                task_id=task_id,
1937                objective=objective,
1938                boundary_type=(
1939                    final_boundary.triggered_boundaries[0]
1940                    if final_boundary.triggered_boundaries
1941                    else "unknown"
1942                ),
1943                requested_action="integrate_observed_final_delta",
1944                repository=repository,
1945                evidence=list(packet.evidence) if packet else paths,
1946                risks=list(packet.risks) if packet else [],
1947                verification_state="complete",
1948                why_delegated_authority_did_not_apply="; ".join(
1949                    final_boundary.triggered_boundaries
1950                ),
1951                decision_packet=packet.to_dict() if packet else {},
1952            )
1953            record = git_rec.to_dict()
1954            record.update({
1955                "integration_mode": "parked",
1956                "parked_record": parked.to_dict(),
1957                "failure_class": FAILURE_CLASS_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED,
1958                "failure_code": "final_delta_authority_boundary",
1959            })
1960            self._persist_git_record(git_rec, campaign_state, state_dir)
1961            return False, record
1962
1963        baseline_sha: Optional[str] = None
1964        baseline_file = run_dir / "baseline.json"
1965        if baseline_file.is_file():
1966            try:
1967                baseline_sha = json.loads(baseline_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("initial_commit_sha")
1968            except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError):
1969                baseline_sha = None
1970
1971        def _apply_branch(meta: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
1972            git_rec.branch = meta.get("branch")
1973            git_rec.branch_observed = True
1974
1975        def _apply_commit(meta: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
1976            git_rec.commit_sha = meta.get("commit_sha")
1977            git_rec.commit_observed = True
1978
1979        def _apply_push(_meta: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
1980            git_rec.push_observed = True
1981
1982        def _apply_pr(meta: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
1983            git_rec.pr_number = meta.get("pr_number")
1984            git_rec.pr_url = meta.get("pr_url")
1985            git_rec.pr_observed = True
1986
1987        if self._run_step_or_bail(
1988            "create_task_branch", {}, task_id, run_dir, git_rec, campaign_state, state_dir, _apply_branch,
1989        ) is None:
1990            return False, git_rec.to_dict()
1991
1992        if self._run_step_or_bail(
1993            "commit_task_changes",
1994            {
1995                "paths": paths, "message": commit_message, "baseline_sha": baseline_sha,
1996                "allowed_paths": gap_probe.allowed_paths or None,
1997            },
1998            task_id, run_dir, git_rec, campaign_state, state_dir, _apply_commit,
1999        ) is None:
2000            return False, git_rec.to_dict()
2001
2002        if self._run_step_or_bail(
2003            "push_task_branch", {"branch": git_rec.branch, "expected_commit": git_rec.commit_sha},
2004            task_id, run_dir, git_rec, campaign_state, state_dir, _apply_push,
2005        ) is None:
2006            return False, git_rec.to_dict()
2007
2008        if self._run_step_or_bail(
2009            "create_pull_request",
2010            {
2011                "branch": git_rec.branch,
2012                "title": f"fix({benchmark_key}): {gap_type}",
2013                "body": f"Automated marathon dogfooding fix.\n\nGap: {gap_type}\n{gap_desc}",
2014            },
2015            task_id, run_dir, git_rec, campaign_state, state_dir, _apply_pr,
2016        ) is None:
2017            return False, git_rec.to_dict()
2018
2019        # An unattended merge requires live CI policy AND terminal green
2020        # required checks. Every other outcome -- unreadable policy, a policy
2021        # enforcing no checks at all, still-pending jobs, a poll timeout --
2022        # fails closed (#59.1 Blockers 3/4).
2023        ci_obs = self.git_executor.observe_required_checks(git_rec.pr_number)
2024        policy = ci_obs.policy
2025        git_rec.required_checks = ci_obs.checks
2026        git_rec.required_checks_observed = ci_obs.all_required_observed
2027        git_rec.required_checks_green = ci_obs.all_required_green
2028        git_rec.ci_observed_head_sha = ci_obs.checks_head_sha
2029        git_rec.current_pr_head_sha = ci_obs.pr_head_sha
2030        if policy is not None and not policy.available:
2031            git_rec.ci_status = "policy_unavailable"
2032        elif policy is not None and not policy.contexts:
2033            git_rec.ci_status = "no_required_checks"
2034        elif ci_obs.failed_jobs:
2035            git_rec.ci_status = "failed"
2036        elif ci_obs.timed_out:
2037            git_rec.ci_status = "timeout"
2038        elif not ci_obs.all_required_observed or not ci_obs.all_required_terminal:
2039            git_rec.ci_status = "pending"
2040        else:
2041            git_rec.ci_status = "passed" if ci_obs.all_required_green else "failed"
2042        self._persist_git_record(git_rec, campaign_state, state_dir)
2043
2044        if not ci_obs.authorizes_merge():
2045            reason = (policy.reason if policy is not None and policy.reason else git_rec.ci_status)
2046            git_rec.failure_reason = f"CI_NOT_GREEN: {reason}"
2047            self._persist_git_record(git_rec, campaign_state, state_dir)
2048            return False, git_rec.to_dict()
2049
2050        def _apply_merge(meta: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
2051            git_rec.merge_sha = meta.get("merge_sha")
2052            git_rec.merge_observed = True
2053
2054        if self._run_step_or_bail(
2055            "merge_pull_request", {"pr_number": git_rec.pr_number},
2056            task_id, run_dir, git_rec, campaign_state, state_dir, _apply_merge,
2057        ) is None:
2058            return False, git_rec.to_dict()
2059        if campaign_state is not None:
2060            campaign_state.increment_merge_count()
2061            # Persist immediately after the irreversible merge operation so a
2062            # crash before remote verification cannot reset the envelope budget.
2063            if state_dir is not None:
2064                campaign_state.save(state_dir)
2065
2066        remote_ok = self.git_executor.verify_remote_main_contains(git_rec.merge_sha)
2067        if not remote_ok:
2068            git_rec.failure_reason = "MERGE_NOT_YET_REACHABLE_FROM_REMOTE_MAIN"
2069            self._persist_git_record(git_rec, campaign_state, state_dir)
2070            return False, git_rec.to_dict()
2071        git_rec.remote_main_contains_merge = True
2072        git_rec.merged = True
2073        git_rec.merged_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
2074        self._persist_git_record(git_rec, campaign_state, state_dir)
2075
2076        sync_meta = self._authorize_and_execute_git_step("sync_local_main", {}, task_id, run_dir, git_rec)
2077        git_rec.local_main_synced = bool(sync_meta and sync_meta.get("local_main_synced"))
2078        git_rec.integration_mode = "real"
2079        self._persist_git_record(git_rec, campaign_state, state_dir)
2080
2081        if self.ledger:
2082            self.ledger.append_entry(EvidenceEntry(
2083                task_id=task_id,
2084                agent_id=provider,
2085                action="engineering_gap_resolved",
2086                command=f"gh pr merge {git_rec.pr_number} --squash",
2087                result="PASS" if git_rec.is_fully_integrated() else "PARTIAL",
2088                artifact=f"commit:{git_rec.commit_sha}",
2089                task_class="bug_fix",
2090                risk_level="low",
2091                reasoning_tier="tier_2",
2092                implementing_agent=provider,
2093                metadata={"gap_type": gap_type, "benchmark": benchmark_key, "git_record": git_rec.to_dict()},
2094            ))
2095
2096        return git_rec.is_fully_integrated(), git_rec.to_dict()

Drives continuous, evidence-backed dogfooding loops across product benchmarks. Handles real AI provider execution, exhaustion fallback, failure classification, governed self-improvement task delegation, git/PR integration, and durable state persistence.

MarathonDogfoodEngine( synthesizer: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.engine.ProductSynthesizer] = None, provider_pool: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool.ProviderPoolManager] = None, ledger: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.evidence_ledger.EvidenceLedger] = None, base_output_dir: Union[str, pathlib.Path] = 'output', campaign_dir: Union[str, pathlib.Path, NoneType] = None, target_repo: Union[str, pathlib.Path] = '.', repo_slug: Optional[str] = None, git_executor_factory: Optional[Callable[..., howlplane.control_plane.git_integration.GitIntegrationExecutor]] = None, orchestrator_factory: Optional[Callable[[howlplane.control_plane.orchestrator.OrchestrationConfig], howlplane.control_plane.orchestrator.GovernedTaskOrchestrator]] = None, git_runner: Optional[Callable[..., Any]] = None, framework_gap_confirmations_required: int = 1) 
221    def __init__(
222        self,
223        synthesizer: Optional[ProductSynthesizer] = None,
224        provider_pool: Optional[ProviderPoolManager] = None,
225        ledger: Optional[EvidenceLedger] = None,
226        base_output_dir: Union[str, Path] = "output",
227        campaign_dir: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
228        target_repo: Union[str, Path] = ".",
229        repo_slug: Optional[str] = None,
230        git_executor_factory: Optional[Callable[..., GitIntegrationExecutor]] = None,
231        orchestrator_factory: Optional[Callable[[OrchestrationConfig], GovernedTaskOrchestrator]] = None,
232        git_runner: Optional[Callable[..., Any]] = None,
233        framework_gap_confirmations_required: int = 1,
234    ):
235        self.provider_pool = provider_pool or ProviderPoolManager()
236        self.ledger = ledger
237        self.synthesizer = synthesizer or ProductSynthesizer(provider_pool=self.provider_pool, ledger=self.ledger)
238        self.base_output_dir = Path(base_output_dir).resolve()
239        self.campaign_base_dir = (
240            Path(campaign_dir).resolve()
241            if campaign_dir
242            else Path(".dogfood_runs").resolve()
243        )
244        # Real git/GitHub integration target (#59). Defaults to the current
245        # working directory (the howlplane repo itself, for self-improvement
246        # tasks). `repo_slug` is auto-detected from the `origin` remote when
247        # not explicitly provided.
248        self.target_repo = Path(target_repo).resolve()
249        self.repo_slug = repo_slug or detect_repo_slug(self.target_repo) or ""
250        self.authority_envelope: Optional[AuthorityEnvelope] = None
251        # Injectable for tests; defaults to the real GitIntegrationExecutor.
252        self._git_executor_factory = git_executor_factory or (
253            lambda envelope, merges_so_far: GitIntegrationExecutor(
254                self.target_repo, self.repo_slug, envelope, merges_so_far=merges_so_far
255            )
256        )
257        self.git_executor: Optional[GitIntegrationExecutor] = None
258        # Injectable for tests (mirrors GovernedTaskOrchestrator's own
259        # custom_backend seam); defaults to constructing the real
260        # orchestrator against self.target_repo. The orchestrator's own
261        # lifecycle (locks, routing, review, verification) is exhaustively
262        # covered by its dedicated test suite -- this seam lets marathon-
263        # level tests exercise the real git/GitHub continuation logic
264        # without re-driving that whole subsystem end-to-end.
265        self._orchestrator_factory = orchestrator_factory or (
266            lambda config: GovernedTaskOrchestrator(target_repo=self.target_repo, config=config)
267        )
268        # Raw git seam used only by attempt-state reconciliation (#59.1
269        # Phase 3), kept separate from the authority-gated GitIntegrationExecutor:
270        # reverting a failed attempt's own files is repository hygiene, not a
271        # proposed action against the envelope.
272        self._git_runner = git_runner or run_git
273        # How many *independent* providers must reproduce an ambiguous synthesis
274        # failure before it may be called a framework gap (#59.1 Phase 5).
275        self.framework_gap_confirmations_required = max(0, framework_gap_confirmations_required)
provider_pool
ledger
synthesizer
base_output_dir
campaign_base_dir
target_repo
repo_slug
authority_envelope: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.authority_envelope.AuthorityEnvelope]
git_executor: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.git_integration.GitIntegrationExecutor]
framework_gap_confirmations_required
def run_marathon( self, benchmarks: Optional[List[str]] = None, max_iterations: int = 5, until_providers_exhausted: bool = False, avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None, preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None, resume_campaign_id: Optional[str] = None, authority_profile_id: Optional[str] = None) -> howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.marathon.MarathonSummaryReport: 
340    def run_marathon(
341        self,
342        benchmarks: Optional[List[str]] = None,
343        max_iterations: int = 5,
344        until_providers_exhausted: bool = False,
345        avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None,
346        preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None,
347        resume_campaign_id: Optional[str] = None,
348        authority_profile_id: Optional[str] = None,
349    ) -> MarathonSummaryReport:
350        """
351        Executes evidence-driven marathon dogfooding.
352        Respects --until-providers-exhausted by running as long as providers remain available,
353        with a high finite safety ceiling to avoid unbounded spins.
354        """
355        t0 = time.time()
356        self.base_output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
357        self.campaign_base_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
358
359        # 1. Initialize or Resume Durable Campaign State
360        campaign_id = resume_campaign_id or self._generate_campaign_id()
361        state_dir = self.campaign_base_dir / campaign_id
362        state_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
363
364        scope_extended: List[str] = []
365        if resume_campaign_id and (state_dir / "campaign_state.json").is_file():
366            campaign_state = DurableCampaignState.load(state_dir)
367            # Re-check LIVE provider availability upon resume: previously exhausted
368            # cloud providers may have refreshed quota (#58 Phase 16).
369            self.provider_pool.reset_transient_exhaustion()
370
371            # Restore the campaign's PERSISTED benchmark scope. A resume must NOT
372            # silently expand into the full default benchmark suite (#58 Phase 1).
373            # Campaigns persisted before #58 have no `requested_benchmarks`; fall
374            # back to the full default suite once, for backward compatibility.
375            persisted_scope = campaign_state.requested_benchmarks or list(STANDARD_BENCHMARKS.keys())
376            if benchmarks:
377                # Explicit --benchmarks on a resume is treated as an operator-driven
378                # scope EXTENSION, not a silent expansion or an override.
379                scope_extended = campaign_state.extend_benchmark_scope(benchmarks)
380                benchmark_keys_scope = campaign_state.requested_benchmarks
381            else:
382                benchmark_keys_scope = persisted_scope
383            campaign_state.requested_benchmarks = benchmark_keys_scope
384
385            # Skip benchmarks already verified successful in a prior session; retry
386            # any that previously failed, plus anything newly added to scope.
387            already_succeeded = {
388                b.get("benchmark_id") for b in campaign_state.benchmark_history if b.get("success")
389            }
390            benchmark_keys = [b for b in benchmark_keys_scope if b not in already_succeeded]
391        else:
392            campaign_state = DurableCampaignState(campaign_id=campaign_id)
393            benchmark_keys = benchmarks or list(STANDARD_BENCHMARKS.keys())
394            campaign_state.requested_benchmarks = list(benchmark_keys)
395
396        is_resume = bool(resume_campaign_id and (state_dir / "campaign_state.json").is_file())
397        self.authority_envelope = self._bind_authority_envelope(
398            state_dir, campaign_id, authority_profile_id, is_resume
399        )
400        campaign_state.authority_envelope = self.authority_envelope.to_dict() if self.authority_envelope else None
401        self.git_executor = self._git_executor_factory(self.authority_envelope, campaign_state.merges_this_campaign)
402
403        if self.authority_envelope is not None:
404            # Overnight-safe envelope bound: use its (more conservative)
405            # local RAM threshold and keep_alive behavior for local Ollama
406            # inference rather than the interactive default (#59 Phases
407            # 16/17). Registered for the lifetime of this process; a fresh
408            # process picks the interactive default again unless it too
409            # binds an envelope.
410            from howlplane.control_plane.agent_execution import OllamaLocalBackend
411            AgentBackendRegistry.register_backend(
412                "local_ollama",
413                OllamaLocalBackend(
414                    min_available_ram_gib=self.authority_envelope.local_ram_threshold_gib,
415                    keep_alive=self.authority_envelope.local_keep_alive,
416                ),
417            )
418            lm = campaign_state.ensure_local_model_defaults()
419            lm["resource_guard_min_ram_gib"] = self.authority_envelope.local_ram_threshold_gib
420
421        # When --until-providers-exhausted is True, do not silently cap at 5;
422        # set high safety ceiling (e.g. 100) to allow long autonomous campaigns
423        if until_providers_exhausted:
424            effective_max_iterations = max(max_iterations, 100)
425        else:
426            effective_max_iterations = max_iterations
427
428        results: List[DogfoodIterationResult] = []
429        stop_reason = "completed_all_benchmarks"
430
431        iteration_idx = 0
432        b_index = 0
433
434        while iteration_idx < effective_max_iterations:
435            if b_index >= len(benchmark_keys):
436                stop_reason = "completed_all_benchmarks"
437                break
438
439            b_key = benchmark_keys[b_index]
440            b_index += 1
441            iteration_idx += 1
442
443            prompt = STANDARD_BENCHMARKS.get(b_key, b_key)
444            out_dir = self.base_output_dir / f"dogfood_{b_key}"
445
446            campaign_state.active_benchmark = b_key
447            campaign_state.provider_states = self.provider_pool.get_all_statuses()
448            campaign_state.save(state_dir)
449
450            # Check provider pool capacity. Full-app benchmark synthesis is a broad
451            # task and never local-eligible (#58 Phase 9), so probe with a
452            # medium-risk task to correctly exclude the quota-free local model from
453            # this capacity check -- otherwise a machine with Ollama installed would
454            # never observe "exhausted" and the campaign could run indefinitely.
455            benchmark_task_probe = TaskSpec(
456                task_id=f"BENCH-{b_key.upper()}", repository="dogfood",
457                objective=prompt, task_class="feature", risk_level="medium",
458            )
459            available_candidates = self.provider_pool.select_candidates(
460                task_category="code_heavy",
461                avoid_provider=avoid_provider,
462                preferred_agent=preferred_agent,
463                task=benchmark_task_probe,
464            )
465            # `is_all_exhausted()` (true SESSION_EXHAUSTED/RATE_LIMITED quota
466            # exhaustion) always stops, even in deterministic-baseline mode, same
467            # as before #58. Local Ollama can never reach that state, so this
468            # branch is unaffected by its presence. Lack of any *candidate*
469            # (e.g. no real provider binaries installed) only stops real runs;
470            # deterministic-baseline mode (used in CI/tests) synthesizes
471            # regardless of provider availability, exactly as before #58.
472            if self.provider_pool.is_all_exhausted() or (
473                not available_candidates and self.synthesizer.synthesis_mode != "deterministic_baseline"
474            ):
475                stop_reason = "all_providers_exhausted"
476                break
477
478            # Execute Prompt-to-Product Synthesis
479            synth_res = self._execute_synthesis(prompt, out_dir, avoid_provider, preferred_agent, iteration_idx)
480
481            # Track provider invocation
482            if synth_res.implementing_provider:
483                campaign_state.record_provider_invocation(synth_res.implementing_provider)
484
485            acc_passed = synth_res.acceptance_report.passed_count if synth_res.acceptance_report else 0
486            acc_total = synth_res.acceptance_report.total_count if synth_res.acceptance_report else 0
487
488            # Record reviewer diversity, distinguishing which reviewers were
489            # merely assigned a role from which actually executed (#59.1
490            # Phase 8). Counters only move for real executions.
491            invocations = list(synth_res.reviewer_invocations)
492            campaign_state.reviewer_diversity_records.append({
493                "target": b_key,
494                "implementer": synth_res.implementing_provider,
495                "reviewers": synth_res.reviewer_mapping,
496                "diversity_achieved": synth_res.diversity_achieved,
497                "assigned": sorted({i["provider"] for i in invocations}),
498                "invoked": sorted({i["provider"] for i in invocations if i.get("invoked")}),
499                "completed": sorted({i["provider"] for i in invocations if i.get("completed")}),
500                "invocations": invocations,
501            })
502            for inv in invocations:
503                if not inv.get("invoked"):
504                    continue
505                campaign_state.record_provider_invocation(inv["provider"], role="review")
506                if inv["provider"] in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS:
507                    recorder = (
508                        campaign_state.record_local_success if inv.get("completed")
509                        else campaign_state.record_local_failure
510                    )
511                    recorder(inv.get("ram_after_gib"))
512
513            # 3. Check for Framework Gap / Failure -> Trigger Self-Improvement Flywheel
514            retried = False
515            bundle_dir = out_dir
516            if not synth_res.success:
517                # Classify the observed failure from concrete evidence, and
518                # grade that evidence. Only deterministic proof, or a symptom
519                # independently reproduced by another provider, may open a
520                # self-improvement task against HowlPlane itself (#59.1
521                # Phase 5).
522                gap_type, gap_desc, evidence = self._classify_failure(synth_res, b_key)
523                falsification: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
524                if evidence == FrameworkGapEvidence.PROVISIONAL_FAILURE:
525                    signature = self._failure_signature(synth_res, gap_type)
526                    evidence, rescued, rescued_dir, falsification = self._falsify_framework_gap(
527                        prompt, b_key, out_dir, synth_res.implementing_provider,
528                        signature, iteration_idx,
529                    )
530                    if rescued is not None:
531                        # An independent provider synthesized the same
532                        # benchmark successfully: the framework was never the
533                        # problem. Adopt that result -- and the directory it
534                        # was actually built into -- as the outcome.
535                        synth_res = rescued
536                        bundle_dir = rescued_dir or bundle_dir
537                        acc_passed = rescued.acceptance_report.passed_count if rescued.acceptance_report else 0
538                        acc_total = rescued.acceptance_report.total_count if rescued.acceptance_report else 0
539                        if rescued.implementing_provider:
540                            campaign_state.record_provider_invocation(rescued.implementing_provider)
541
542                campaign_state.record_gap_falsification({
543                    "benchmark": b_key,
544                    "gap_type": gap_type,
545                    "evidence": evidence.value,
546                    "failing_provider": synth_res.implementing_provider,
547                    "attempts": falsification,
548                })
549
550            if not synth_res.success and evidence not in _GAP_ACTIONABLE_EVIDENCE:
551                # Not enough evidence to modify HowlPlane. Record what was
552                # observed for future provider routing and fall through to the
553                # normal iteration result -- no framework gap, no governed
554                # self-improvement task, no self-modification.
555                campaign_state.record_provider_specific_failure({
556                    "benchmark": b_key,
557                    "gap_type": gap_type,
558                    "evidence": evidence.value,
559                    "failing_provider": synth_res.implementing_provider,
560                    "required_behavior": gap_desc,
561                    "falsification_attempts": falsification,
562                })
563                campaign_state.save(state_dir)
564
565            elif not synth_res.success:
566                gap_code = f"HF_GAP_{b_key.upper()}"
567                campaign_state.record_framework_gap({
568                    "code": gap_code,
569                    "target_component": "howlframe_runtime" if "runtime" in gap_type else "howlplane_synthesis",
570                    "required_behavior": gap_desc,
571                    "impact": "blocks_product_synthesis",
572                    "evidence": evidence.value,
573                    "falsification_attempts": falsification,
574                })
575
576                # Create concrete, bounded engineering task
577                eng_task_id = f"ENG-{b_key.upper()}-{iteration_idx:02d}"
578                campaign_state.active_engineering_task = eng_task_id
579
580                if already_parked(campaign_state.parked_tasks, eng_task_id):
581                    # Never repeatedly re-select an already-parked task (#59 Phase 13).
582                    campaign_state.save(state_dir)
583                    continue
584
585                # Execute governed engineering task to resolve gap
586                task_success, git_rec = self._execute_governed_engineering_improvement(
587                    task_id=eng_task_id,
588                    benchmark_key=b_key,
589                    gap_type=gap_type,
590                    gap_desc=gap_desc,
591                    avoid_provider=avoid_provider,
592                    campaign_state=campaign_state,
593                    state_dir=state_dir,
594                )
595
596                if task_success and git_rec:
597                    campaign_state.record_task_completed({
598                        "task_id": eng_task_id,
599                        "objective": f"Resolve {gap_type} for {b_key}",
600                        "provider": git_rec.get("provider", "codex"),
601                        "remediations": 0,
602                    })
603                    campaign_state.record_git_integration(git_rec)
604
605                    # RETRY ORIGINAL BENCHMARK after fix is integrated!
606                    retry_res = self._execute_synthesis(prompt, out_dir, avoid_provider, preferred_agent, iteration_idx)
607                    if retry_res.success:
608                        synth_res = retry_res
609                        acc_passed = synth_res.acceptance_report.passed_count if synth_res.acceptance_report else 0
610                        acc_total = synth_res.acceptance_report.total_count if synth_res.acceptance_report else 0
611                        retried = True
612                elif git_rec and git_rec.get("integration_mode") == "parked":
613                    # Parked awaiting human authority: not a capability
614                    # failure. Preserve state and continue with other
615                    # independent work unless this park blocks everything
616                    # meaningful remaining (#59 Phases 12/13).
617                    already_succeeded_benchmarks = [
618                        b.get("benchmark_id") for b in campaign_state.benchmark_history if b.get("success")
619                    ]
620                    resolved_gap_codes = [
621                        t.get("gap_type_resolved") for t in campaign_state.completed_tasks if t.get("gap_type_resolved")
622                    ]
623                    blocks_all = compute_blocks_other_work(
624                        eng_task_id,
625                        campaign_state.framework_gaps,
626                        campaign_state.requested_benchmarks,
627                        already_succeeded_benchmarks,
628                        resolved_gap_codes,
629                        campaign_state.parked_tasks,
630                        current_gap_code=gap_code,
631                    )
632                    parked_record = git_rec.get("parked_record", {})
633                    parked_record["blocks_other_work"] = blocks_all
634                    campaign_state.record_park(parked_record)
635                    campaign_state.save(state_dir)
636                    if blocks_all:
637                        stop_reason = "AWAITING_HUMAN"
638                        break
639                else:
640                    # Report the engineering task's own provider and its
641                    # concrete failure reason. Previously this recorded the
642                    # *synthesis* provider and the fixed string "Engineering
643                    # task failed or blocked", discarding the git record's
644                    # failure_reason entirely (#59.1).
645                    attempts = campaign_state.attempts_for_task(eng_task_id)
646                    campaign_state.record_task_failed({
647                        "task_id": eng_task_id,
648                        "objective": f"Resolve {gap_type} for {b_key}",
649                        "provider": (git_rec or {}).get("provider") or "unknown",
650                        "error": (git_rec or {}).get("failure_reason") or "Engineering task failed or blocked",
651                        "attempts": [
652                            {"provider": a.get("provider"), "result": a.get("result")} for a in attempts
653                        ],
654                    })
655
656            iter_res = DogfoodIterationResult(
657                benchmark_id=b_key,
658                prompt=prompt,
659                product_name=synth_res.product_name,
660                success=synth_res.success,
661                status=synth_res.status,
662                passed_checks=acc_passed,
663                total_checks=acc_total,
664                repair_cycles=synth_res.repair_cycles,
665                duration_seconds=synth_res.duration_seconds,
666                implementing_provider=synth_res.implementing_provider,
667                reviewing_providers=synth_res.reviewing_providers,
668                diversity_achieved=synth_res.diversity_achieved,
669                framework_gaps_count=len(synth_res.framework_gaps),
670                error_message=synth_res.error_message,
671                bundle_path=str(bundle_dir) if synth_res.success else None,
672                retried_after_fix=retried,
673            )
674            results.append(iter_res)
675            campaign_state.record_benchmark_result(iter_res.to_dict())
676            campaign_state.save(state_dir)
677
678            if synth_res.status == "PROVIDER_POOL_EXHAUSTED":
679                stop_reason = "all_providers_exhausted"
680                break
681
682        if iteration_idx >= effective_max_iterations and stop_reason == "completed_all_benchmarks" and len(results) < len(benchmark_keys):
683            stop_reason = "campaign_safety_ceiling_reached"
684
685        # Cloud exhausted: before stopping, use bounded LOCAL_ONLY_CONTINUATION to
686        # mop up any outstanding, evidence-backed, local-eligible engineering gaps
687        # rather than declaring the campaign done with unresolved fixable gaps
688        # (#58 Phase 13). This never runs unbounded: capped by the durable
689        # `local_only_iteration_limit` counter, and it never re-attempts full
690        # benchmark synthesis (not local-eligible; see capacity probe above).
691        if stop_reason == "all_providers_exhausted":
692            local_backend = AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend("local_ollama")
693            if local_backend.is_available():
694                stop_reason = self._run_local_only_continuation(campaign_state, avoid_provider)
695
696        total_elapsed = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
697        succeeded = sum(1 for r in results if r.success)
698        failed = len(results) - succeeded
699
700        campaign_state.stop_reason = stop_reason
701        campaign_state.total_duration_seconds = total_elapsed
702        campaign_state.next_action = "none" if failed == 0 else f"ai dogfood --resume {campaign_id}"
703        campaign_state.save(state_dir)
704
705        return MarathonSummaryReport(
706            campaign_id=campaign_id,
707            iterations_attempted=len(results),
708            iterations_succeeded=succeeded,
709            iterations_failed=failed,
710            total_duration_seconds=total_elapsed,
711            benchmark_results=results,
712            provider_states=self.provider_pool.get_all_statuses(),
713            provider_invocations=campaign_state.provider_invocations,
714            framework_gaps=campaign_state.framework_gaps,
715            completed_engineering_tasks=campaign_state.completed_tasks,
716            git_records=campaign_state.git_records,
717            stopped_reason=stop_reason,
718            next_action=campaign_state.next_action,
719            state_dir=str(state_dir),
720        )

Executes evidence-driven marathon dogfooding. Respects --until-providers-exhausted by running as long as providers remain available, with a high finite safety ceiling to avoid unbounded spins.

def run_acceptance_canary(self, authority_profile_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]: 
722    def run_acceptance_canary(self, authority_profile_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
723        """
724        Live governed integration acceptance canary (#59.2 Phases 15-18).
725
726        A first-class, explicitly labeled acceptance action -- not a
727        fabricated defect -- whose only purpose is to exercise the real
728        governed git/GitHub lifecycle end-to-end with no mocked boundary:
729        GovernedTaskOrchestrator -> independent review -> deterministic
730        verification -> real branch/commit/push/PR via GitIntegrationExecutor
731        -> live GitHub Ruleset discovery -> CI poll to terminal -> delegated
732        merge -> real gh merge verification -> remote-main reconciliation ->
733        local-main sync. Reuses _execute_governed_engineering_improvement
734        exactly as any other governed engineering task does -- no special
735        shortcut, no direct git/gh call outside the production executor.
736
737        The task is mechanically scoped via TaskSpec.allowed_paths (#59.2
738        Phase 8) to touch only its designated acceptance evidence artifact
739        under documentation/task_journals/ -- a fail-closed guarantee, not a
740        prompt-only request. `risk_level="medium"` excludes the quota-free
741        local model, since the canary's entire point is proving the
742        cloud-governed path works.
743
744        Returns a dict: campaign_id, task_id, journal_path, task_success,
745        git_record. Callers should treat completion as verified only when
746        git_record's merged / remote_main_contains_merge / local_main_synced
747        are all true.
748        """
749        self.base_output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
750        self.campaign_base_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
751
752        campaign_id = self._generate_campaign_id()
753        state_dir = self.campaign_base_dir / campaign_id
754        state_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
755
756        campaign_state = DurableCampaignState(campaign_id=campaign_id)
757        self.authority_envelope = self._bind_authority_envelope(
758            state_dir, campaign_id, authority_profile_id, is_resume=False,
759        )
760        campaign_state.authority_envelope = (
761            self.authority_envelope.to_dict() if self.authority_envelope else None
762        )
763        self.git_executor = self._git_executor_factory(
764            self.authority_envelope, campaign_state.merges_this_campaign,
765        )
766
767        date_str = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
768        journal_path = f"documentation/task_journals/{date_str}_live_autonomous_acceptance.md"
769        task_id = f"ACCEPTANCE-{campaign_id}"
770
771        start_sha_proc = self._git_runner(self.target_repo, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"], 15)
772        start_sha = start_sha_proc.stdout.strip() if start_sha_proc.returncode == 0 else "unknown"
773        digest = self.authority_envelope.policy_digest if self.authority_envelope else "unknown"
774
775        task_success, git_rec = self._execute_governed_engineering_improvement(
776            task_id=task_id,
777            benchmark_key="LIVE-ACCEPTANCE-CANARY",
778            gap_type="live_autonomous_acceptance",
779            gap_desc=(
780                f"Create or update {journal_path} to record that live acceptance canary "
781                f"{campaign_id} was initiated: starting main SHA {start_sha}, authority "
782                f"profile digest {digest}, and its purpose (exercising the real governed "
783                f"branch/commit/push/PR/CI/merge/remote-verify/local-sync git lifecycle "
784                f"end-to-end, with no mocked git/gh boundary). Do NOT assert that the merge "
785                f"lifecycle has completed or succeeded -- at the time this file is written, "
786                f"the branch/commit/PR/CI/merge steps that follow have not happened yet. The "
787                f"merge outcome is independently verified by the production git integration "
788                f"steps themselves, never asserted in this file's content."
789            ),
790            risk_level="medium",
791            campaign_state=campaign_state,
792            state_dir=state_dir,
793            allowed_paths=[journal_path],
794            reviewer_requirements=[
795                "correctness-reviewer",
796                "regression-reviewer",
797                "simplicity-reviewer",
798            ],
799        )
800
801        if task_success and git_rec:
802            campaign_state.record_task_completed({
803                "task_id": task_id,
804                "objective": "Live autonomous acceptance canary",
805                "provider": git_rec.get("provider", "unknown"),
806                "remediations": 0,
807            })
808            campaign_state.record_git_integration(git_rec)
809        campaign_state.stop_reason = "acceptance_canary_complete" if task_success else "acceptance_canary_incomplete"
810        campaign_state.save(state_dir)
811
812        return {
813            "campaign_id": campaign_id,
814            "task_id": task_id,
815            "journal_path": journal_path,
816            "task_success": task_success,
817            "git_record": git_rec,
818            "state_dir": str(state_dir),
819        }

Live governed integration acceptance canary (#59.2 Phases 15-18).

A first-class, explicitly labeled acceptance action -- not a fabricated defect -- whose only purpose is to exercise the real governed git/GitHub lifecycle end-to-end with no mocked boundary: GovernedTaskOrchestrator -> independent review -> deterministic verification -> real branch/commit/push/PR via GitIntegrationExecutor -> live GitHub Ruleset discovery -> CI poll to terminal -> delegated merge -> real gh merge verification -> remote-main reconciliation -> local-main sync. Reuses _execute_governed_engineering_improvement exactly as any other governed engineering task does -- no special shortcut, no direct git/gh call outside the production executor.

The task is mechanically scoped via TaskSpec.allowed_paths (#59.2 Phase 8) to touch only its designated acceptance evidence artifact under documentation/task_journals/ -- a fail-closed guarantee, not a prompt-only request. risk_level="medium" excludes the quota-free local model, since the canary's entire point is proving the cloud-governed path works.

Returns a dict: campaign_id, task_id, journal_path, task_success, git_record. Callers should treat completion as verified only when git_record's merged / remote_main_contains_merge / local_main_synced are all true.

def run_backlog_marathon( self, authority_profile_id: str, max_tasks: int = 3, max_runtime_hours: float = 8.0, resume_campaign_id: Optional[str] = None, roi_floor: float = 0.5, backlog_files: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]: 
 885    def run_backlog_marathon(
 886        self,
 887        authority_profile_id: str,
 888        max_tasks: int = 3,
 889        max_runtime_hours: float = 8.0,
 890        resume_campaign_id: Optional[str] = None,
 891        roi_floor: float = 0.5,
 892        backlog_files: Optional[List[str]] = None,
 893    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 894        """Works a bounded sequence of a project's ranked backlog items.
 895
 896        This is the marathon the control plane did not previously have.
 897        `run_marathon` iterates *product-synthesis benchmarks*; this iterates
 898        the target repository's own ranked backlog, which is what
 899        `select_next_evidence_backed_task` in the authority profile always
 900        meant and never had an implementation for.
 901
 902        Every task goes through `_execute_governed_engineering_improvement`,
 903        so it gets the identical real lifecycle as any other governed task:
 904        branch, provider implementation with bounded failover, independent
 905        review, deterministic verification, commit, push, PR, CI observation,
 906        and merge only if the bound envelope actually delegates it. Nothing
 907        here is a shortcut around that.
 908
 909        Bounded four ways, all of which stop the loop truthfully rather than
 910        letting it run on:
 911
 912        * `max_tasks` -- how many items may be attempted at all
 913        * `max_runtime_hours` -- wall clock, checked before starting each task
 914          so a task is never begun that cannot plausibly finish
 915        * the eligible backlog -- when it empties, the run stops
 916        * the usable provider pool -- when it empties, the run parks
 917
 918        A task whose authority boundary the envelope does not delegate is
 919        PARKED and the loop continues with other independent work, which is
 920        the `park_and_continue` action the profile grants. The campaign only
 921        stops for a human when nothing else can proceed.
 922        """
 923        from howlplane.control_plane.backlog_source import BacklogSource
 924
 925        started = time.time()
 926        deadline = started + max_runtime_hours * 3600.0
 927
 928        campaign_id = resume_campaign_id or self._generate_campaign_id()
 929        state_dir = self.campaign_base_dir / campaign_id
 930        # The same condition that decides whether campaign state is loaded
 931        # below, evaluated early because the preflight applies only to a new
 932        # campaign. A resumed campaign's durable state legitimately owns an
 933        # unfinished worktree; refusing that would make an interrupted task
 934        # impossible to finish.
 935        is_resume = bool(resume_campaign_id and (state_dir / "campaign_state.json").is_file())
 936
 937        if not is_resume:
 938            refusal = self._refuse_if_target_is_dirty(campaign_id, state_dir, authority_profile_id, started)
 939            if refusal is not None:
 940                return refusal
 941
 942        self.base_output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 943        self.campaign_base_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 944        state_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 945
 946        if is_resume:
 947            campaign_state = DurableCampaignState.load(state_dir)
 948            # A resumed run re-probes providers whose cooldown has elapsed
 949            # rather than inheriting a stale exhausted view of the pool.
 950            self.provider_pool.reset_transient_exhaustion()
 951        else:
 952            campaign_state = DurableCampaignState(campaign_id=campaign_id)
 953
 954        self.authority_envelope = self._bind_authority_envelope(
 955            state_dir, campaign_id, authority_profile_id,
 956            is_resume=bool(resume_campaign_id),
 957        )
 958        campaign_state.authority_envelope = (
 959            self.authority_envelope.to_dict() if self.authority_envelope else None
 960        )
 961        self.git_executor = self._git_executor_factory(
 962            self.authority_envelope, campaign_state.merges_this_campaign,
 963        )
 964
 965        source = BacklogSource(
 966            self.target_repo,
 967            backlog_files=backlog_files or list(DEFAULT_BACKLOG_FILES),
 968            roi_floor=roi_floor,
 969        )
 970        worked: List[str] = []
 971        attempted_ids: List[str] = [
 972            task.get("task_id") for task in campaign_state.completed_tasks
 973        ] + [task.get("task_id") for task in campaign_state.failed_tasks]
 974        attempted_ids += [park.get("task_id") for park in campaign_state.parked_tasks]
 975        attempted_ids = [task_id for task_id in attempted_ids if task_id]
 976
 977        stop_reason = "max_tasks_reached"
 978        while len(worked) < max_tasks:
 979            if time.time() >= deadline:
 980                stop_reason = "max_runtime_reached"
 981                break
 982            if not self.provider_pool.has_available_providers():
 983                # Truthful park, not a loop: nothing usable remains to ask.
 984                stop_reason = "resources_unavailable"
 985                break
 986
 987            selection = source.select()
 988            item = selection.next_item(skip=attempted_ids)
 989            if item is None:
 990                stop_reason = "backlog_exhausted"
 991                break
 992
 993            attempted_ids.append(item.task_id)
 994            detail = source.item_detail(item)
 995            success, git_rec = self._execute_governed_engineering_improvement(
 996                task_id=item.task_id,
 997                benchmark_key=item.task_id,
 998                gap_type="backlog_item",
 999                gap_desc=item.title,
1000                objective_override=(
1001                    f"Resolve {item.source_file} item #{item.item_id}: {item.title}\n\n"
1002                    f"{detail}"
1003                ),
1004                task_class="bug_fix" if item.kind == "bug" else "feature",
1005                commit_message_override=(
1006                    f"fix({item.source_file.replace('.md', '')} #{item.item_id}): "
1007                    f"{item.title[:60]}"
1008                ),
1009                risk_level="medium",
1010                campaign_state=campaign_state,
1011                state_dir=state_dir,
1012            )
1013            worked.append(item.task_id)
1014
1015            record = {
1016                "task_id": item.task_id,
1017                "objective": item.title,
1018                "source_file": item.source_file,
1019                "item_id": item.item_id,
1020                "score": item.score,
1021                "provider": (git_rec or {}).get("provider", "unknown"),
1022            }
1023            if (git_rec or {}).get("integration_mode") == "parked":
1024                campaign_state.record_park((git_rec or {}).get("parked_record", record))
1025            elif success:
1026                campaign_state.record_task_completed(record)
1027            else:
1028                campaign_state.record_task_failed(record)
1029            if git_rec and "parked_record" not in git_rec:
1030                campaign_state.record_git_integration(git_rec)
1031            campaign_state.save(state_dir)
1032
1033        campaign_state.stop_reason = stop_reason
1034        campaign_state.total_duration_seconds = round(time.time() - started, 3)
1035        campaign_state.save(state_dir)
1036
1037        return {
1038            "campaign_id": campaign_id,
1039            "state_dir": str(state_dir),
1040            "target_repo": str(self.target_repo),
1041            "repo_slug": self.repo_slug,
1042            "authority_profile": authority_profile_id,
1043            "tasks_attempted": worked,
1044            "tasks_completed": [t.get("task_id") for t in campaign_state.completed_tasks],
1045            "tasks_failed": [t.get("task_id") for t in campaign_state.failed_tasks],
1046            "tasks_parked": [p.get("task_id") for p in campaign_state.parked_tasks],
1047            "git_records": campaign_state.git_records,
1048            "stop_reason": stop_reason,
1049            "duration_seconds": campaign_state.total_duration_seconds,
1050        }

Works a bounded sequence of a project's ranked backlog items.

This is the marathon the control plane did not previously have. run_marathon iterates product-synthesis benchmarks; this iterates the target repository's own ranked backlog, which is what select_next_evidence_backed_task in the authority profile always meant and never had an implementation for.

Every task goes through _execute_governed_engineering_improvement, so it gets the identical real lifecycle as any other governed task: branch, provider implementation with bounded failover, independent review, deterministic verification, commit, push, PR, CI observation, and merge only if the bound envelope actually delegates it. Nothing here is a shortcut around that.

Bounded four ways, all of which stop the loop truthfully rather than letting it run on:

  • max_tasks -- how many items may be attempted at all
  • max_runtime_hours -- wall clock, checked before starting each task so a task is never begun that cannot plausibly finish
  • the eligible backlog -- when it empties, the run stops
  • the usable provider pool -- when it empties, the run parks

A task whose authority boundary the envelope does not delegate is PARKED and the loop continues with other independent work, which is the park_and_continue action the profile grants. The campaign only stops for a human when nothing else can proceed.

def execute_factory_work_item( self, work_item: Any, risk_level: str = 'medium', task_class: str = 'feature', files_changed: Optional[List[str]] = None, dispatch_id: Optional[str] = None, run_mode: str = 'continuous') -> Tuple[bool, Optional[Dict[str, Any]]]: 
1525    def execute_factory_work_item(
1526        self,
1527        work_item: Any,
1528        risk_level: str = "medium",
1529        task_class: str = "feature",
1530        files_changed: Optional[List[str]] = None,
1531        dispatch_id: Optional[str] = None,
1532        run_mode: str = "continuous",
1533    ) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[Dict[str, Any]]]:
1534        """Public adapter to run a single factory WorkItem through the governed engineering lifecycle.
1535
1536        The factory supervisor selects portfolio-level work; this method hands
1537        the selected item to the same bounded lifecycle used by backlog and
1538        marathon tasks, instead of duplicating it.
1539        """
1540        objective = f"{work_item.title}\n\n{work_item.description}".strip()
1541        return self._execute_governed_engineering_improvement(
1542            task_id=work_item.work_item_id,
1543            benchmark_key=work_item.work_item_id,
1544            gap_type="factory_work_item",
1545            gap_desc=objective,
1546            objective_override=objective,
1547            risk_level=risk_level,
1548            task_class=task_class,
1549            files_changed=files_changed,
1550            repository_override=work_item.repository,
1551            dispatch_id=dispatch_id,
1552            run_mode=run_mode,
1553        )
