class NaturalLanguageSynthesizer: 
 26class NaturalLanguageSynthesizer:
 27    """
 28    Parses natural language product intent into a machine-checkable ProductSpec.
 29    """
 30
 31    def synthesize(self, prompt: str, name_override: Optional[str] = None) -> ProductSpec:
 32        """
 33        Converts a natural language prompt into a validated ProductSpec.
 34        """
 35        clean_prompt = prompt.strip()
 36        lowered = clean_prompt.lower()
 37
 38        # 1. Infer Product Name and Title
 39        name, title = self._infer_name_and_title(clean_prompt, lowered, name_override)
 40
 41        # 2. Infer Interfaces
 42        interfaces = self._infer_interfaces(lowered)
 43
 44        # 3. Infer Entities and Fields
 45        entities = self._infer_entities(lowered, name)
 46
 47        # 4. Infer Behaviors
 48        behaviors = self._infer_behaviors(lowered, entities)
 49
 50        # 5. Infer Persistence
 51        persistence = self._infer_persistence(lowered, name)
 52
 53        # 6. Infer Validation Rules
 54        validation_rules = self._infer_validation_rules(lowered, entities)
 55
 56        # 7. Generate Machine-Checkable Acceptance Criteria
 57        acceptance_criteria = self._generate_acceptance_criteria(
 58            entities=entities,
 59            behaviors=behaviors,
 60            interfaces=interfaces,
 61            persistence=persistence,
 62            validation_rules=validation_rules,
 63        )
 64
 65        # 8. Assemble Required Capabilities
 66        caps = ["database", "filesystem"] if persistence.type == "local_store" else ["database"]
 67        if "http_api" in interfaces or "browser_ui" in interfaces:
 68            caps.append("network")
 69
 70        inferred_defaults = {
 71            "inferred_from_prompt": clean_prompt,
 72            "default_port": 8088,
 73            "primary_entity": list(entities.keys())[0] if entities else "item",
 74        }
 75
 76        spec = ProductSpec(
 77            name=name,
 78            title=title,
 79            description=clean_prompt,
 80            interfaces=interfaces,
 81            entities=entities,
 82            behaviors=behaviors,
 83            persistence=persistence,
 84            validation_rules=validation_rules,
 85            acceptance_criteria=acceptance_criteria,
 86            capabilities_required=sorted(list(set(caps))),
 87            default_port=8088,
 88            metadata={"synthesis": inferred_defaults},
 89        )
 90
 91        validation_errors = spec.validate()
 92        if validation_errors:
 93            # Auto-repair minor validation inconsistencies
 94            for err in validation_errors:
 95                if "primary key" in err:
 96                    for ent in spec.entities.values():
 97                        if ent.primary_key not in ent.fields:
 98                            ent.fields[ent.primary_key] = FieldSpec(name=ent.primary_key, type="string", required=True)
 99            # Re-validate
100            remaining_errors = spec.validate()
101            if remaining_errors:
102                raise ValueError(f"Synthesized ProductSpec validation failed: {'; '.join(remaining_errors)}")
103
104        return spec
105
106    def _infer_name_and_title(self, prompt: str, lowered: str, override: Optional[str]) -> Tuple[str, str]:
107        if override:
108            slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_-]", "-", override.lower()).strip("-")
109            title = override.replace("-", " ").replace("_", " ").title()
110            return slug or "app", title
111
112        if "note" in lowered:
113            return "notes-app", "Notes Application"
114        elif "todo" in lowered or "task" in lowered:
115            return "todo-app", "Todo Application"
116        elif "inventory" in lowered or "catalog" in lowered:
117            return "inventory-app", "Inventory Application"
118        elif "status" in lowered or "health" in lowered or "monitor" in lowered:
119            return "status-api", "Status and Health API"
120        elif "kv" in lowered or "key-value" in lowered or "store" in lowered:
121            return "kv-store", "Key-Value Store"
122        elif "transform" in lowered or "convert" in lowered:
123            return "json-transformer", "JSON Transformer"
124
125        # Fallback heuristic from first few words
126        words = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", lowered)
127        slug_words = [w for w in words if w not in ("create", "a", "an", "the", "with", "and", "app", "application")][:3]
128        slug = "-".join(slug_words) if slug_words else "app"
129        return f"{slug}-app", slug.replace("-", " ").title() + " Application"
130
131    def _infer_interfaces(self, lowered: str) -> List[str]:
132        ifaces: List[str] = []
133        has_browser = any(k in lowered for k in ["browser", "ui", "web", "frontend", "html", "gui"])
134        has_api = any(k in lowered for k in ["api", "http", "json", "rest", "endpoint", "server", "crud"])
135        has_cli = any(k in lowered for k in ["cli", "command line", "terminal", "console"])
136
137        if has_browser or (not has_api and not has_cli):
138            ifaces.append("browser_ui")
139        if has_api or has_browser or not has_cli:
140            ifaces.append("http_api")
141        if has_cli and not has_browser:
142            ifaces.append("cli")
143
144        if not ifaces:
145            ifaces = ["browser_ui", "http_api"]
146        return ifaces
147
148    def _infer_entities(self, lowered: str, app_name: str) -> Dict[str, EntitySpec]:
149        entities: Dict[str, EntitySpec] = {}
150        entity_templates = {
151            "note": ("Note", "A persistent text note with title and content.", {
152                "id": FieldSpec(name="id", type="string", required=True, description="Unique note identifier"),
153                "title": FieldSpec(name="title", type="string", required=True, bounded=200, min_length=1, description="Note title"),
154                "content": FieldSpec(name="content", type="string", required=True, bounded=4000, description="Note body text"),
155                "created_at": FieldSpec(name="created_at", type="string", required=False, description="ISO timestamp"),
156                "updated_at": FieldSpec(name="updated_at", type="string", required=False, description="ISO timestamp"),
157            }),
158            "todo": ("Task", "A todo task with title and completion status.", {
159                "id": FieldSpec(name="id", type="string", required=True),
160                "title": FieldSpec(name="title", type="string", required=True, bounded=200, min_length=1),
161                "completed": FieldSpec(name="completed", type="bool", required=False, default=False),
162                "created_at": FieldSpec(name="created_at", type="string", required=False),
163            }),
164            "inventory": ("Item", "An inventory item with quantity and price.", {
165                "id": FieldSpec(name="id", type="string", required=True),
166                "name": FieldSpec(name="name", type="string", required=True, bounded=200),
167                "quantity": FieldSpec(name="quantity", type="int", required=True, default=0),
168                "category": FieldSpec(name="category", type="string", required=False, default="general"),
169            }),
170            "status": ("ServiceStatus", "Service health and metric observation.", {
171                "id": FieldSpec(name="id", type="string", required=True),
172                "service": FieldSpec(name="service", type="string", required=True),
173                "status": FieldSpec(name="status", type="string", required=True),
174                "timestamp": FieldSpec(name="timestamp", type="string", required=False),
175            }),
176            "generic": ("Record", "Generic structured domain record.", {
177                "id": FieldSpec(name="id", type="string", required=True),
178                "record_name": FieldSpec(name="record_name", type="string", required=True, bounded=200),
179                "payload": FieldSpec(name="payload", type="string", required=True),
180                "timestamp": FieldSpec(name="timestamp", type="string", required=False),
181            }),
182        }
183
184        key = "generic"
185        if any(k in lowered for k in ("note", "memo")) or app_name == "notes-app":
186            key = "note"
187        elif any(k in lowered for k in ("todo", "task")) or app_name == "todo-app":
188            key = "todo"
189        elif "inventory" in lowered or app_name == "inventory-app":
190            key = "inventory"
191        elif "status" in lowered or app_name == "status-api":
192            key = "status"
193
194        ent_name, desc, fields = entity_templates[key]
195        entities[ent_name] = EntitySpec(
196            name=ent_name,
197            description=desc,
198            primary_key="id",
199            fields=fields,
200        )
201        return entities
202
203    def _infer_behaviors(self, lowered: str, entities: Dict[str, EntitySpec]) -> List[BehaviorSpec]:
204        behaviors: List[BehaviorSpec] = []
205        ent_name = list(entities.keys())[0] if entities else "Item"
206        slug_ent = ent_name.lower() + "s"
207
208        # Always provide health check
209        behaviors.append(BehaviorSpec(
210            name="health",
211            entity="system",
212            description="System health probe",
213            endpoint="/health",
214            method="GET",
215            output_type="dict",
216        ))
217
218        # CRUD behaviors
219        behaviors.append(BehaviorSpec(
220            name=f"list_{slug_ent}",
221            entity=ent_name,
222            description=f"Retrieve all {ent_name} records",
223            endpoint=f"/api/{slug_ent}",
224            method="GET",
225            output_type="list",
226        ))
227        crud_table = [
228            ("create", f"Create a new {ent_name} record", "POST", [f for f in entities[ent_name].fields.keys() if f != "id"]),
229            ("get", f"Retrieve a single {ent_name} record by ID", "GET", ["id"]),
230            ("update", f"Update an existing {ent_name} record", "PUT", list(entities[ent_name].fields.keys())),
231            ("delete", f"Delete a {ent_name} record by ID", "DELETE", ["id"]),
232        ]
233        for op, desc, method, in_fields in crud_table:
234            behaviors.append(BehaviorSpec(
235                name=f"{op}_{ent_name.lower()}",
236                entity=ent_name,
237                description=desc,
238                endpoint=f"/api/{slug_ent}",
239                method=method,
240                input_fields=in_fields,
241                output_type="dict",
242            ))
243
244        return behaviors
245
246    def _infer_persistence(self, lowered: str, app_name: str) -> PersistenceSpec:
247        if "memory" in lowered and "restart" not in lowered:
248            return PersistenceSpec(type="memory_store", storage_path="memory://data", survives_restart=False)
249
250        # Default is local file store with restart persistence
251        ent_slug = app_name.replace("-app", "").replace("-api", "")
252        return PersistenceSpec(
253            type="local_store",
254            storage_path=f"file://data/{ent_slug}.json",
255            survives_restart=True,
256            record_key_prefix=f"{ent_slug}:",
257        )
258
259    def _infer_validation_rules(self, lowered: str, entities: Dict[str, EntitySpec]) -> List[ValidationRuleSpec]:
260        rules: List[ValidationRuleSpec] = []
261        for ent_name, ent in entities.items():
262            for f_name, f_spec in ent.fields.items():
263                if f_spec.required and f_name != "id":
264                    rules.append(ValidationRuleSpec(
265                        entity=ent_name,
266                        field=f_name,
267                        rule="required",
268                        error_message=f"Field '{f_name}' is required.",
269                    ))
270                if f_spec.bounded:
271                    rules.append(ValidationRuleSpec(
272                        entity=ent_name,
273                        field=f_name,
274                        rule=f"max_length:{f_spec.bounded}",
275                        error_message=f"Field '{f_name}' exceeds maximum length of {f_spec.bounded}.",
276                    ))
277        return rules
278
279    def _generate_acceptance_criteria(
280        self,
281        entities: Dict[str, EntitySpec],
282        behaviors: List[BehaviorSpec],
283        interfaces: List[str],
284        persistence: PersistenceSpec,
285        validation_rules: List[ValidationRuleSpec],
286    ) -> List[str]:
287        criteria = [
288            "Application builds and compiles to valid HowlFrame bytecode and static assets with exit 0",
289            "HTTP server starts successfully and responds to /health probe with 200 OK",
290        ]
291        if "browser_ui" in interfaces:
292            criteria.append("Root browser interface '/' serves valid HTML and references compiled static app.js")
293
294        ent_name = list(entities.keys())[0] if entities else "Record"
295        slug_ent = ent_name.lower() + "s"
296
297        criteria.append(f"Creating a new {ent_name} via POST /api/{slug_ent} persists record and returns 200/201")
298        criteria.append(f"Retrieving {ent_name} list via GET /api/{slug_ent} includes created item")
299        criteria.append(f"Retrieving single {ent_name} by ID returns matching record attributes")
300        criteria.append(f"Updating {ent_name} via PUT/POST /api/{slug_ent} updates record in-place")
301        criteria.append(f"Deleting {ent_name} via DELETE /api/{slug_ent} removes record from store")
302
303        if validation_rules:
304            criteria.append(f"Submitting invalid {ent_name} payload (missing required field or empty) is rejected with 400 Bad Request")
305
306        if persistence.survives_restart:
307            criteria.append(f"Application state persists across process restart using {persistence.storage_path}")
308
309        return criteria

Parses natural language product intent into a machine-checkable ProductSpec.

def synthesize( self, prompt: str, name_override: Optional[str] = None) -> howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.product_spec.ProductSpec: 
 31    def synthesize(self, prompt: str, name_override: Optional[str] = None) -> ProductSpec:
 32        """
 33        Converts a natural language prompt into a validated ProductSpec.
 34        """
 35        clean_prompt = prompt.strip()
 36        lowered = clean_prompt.lower()
 37
 38        # 1. Infer Product Name and Title
 39        name, title = self._infer_name_and_title(clean_prompt, lowered, name_override)
 40
 41        # 2. Infer Interfaces
 42        interfaces = self._infer_interfaces(lowered)
 43
 44        # 3. Infer Entities and Fields
 45        entities = self._infer_entities(lowered, name)
 46
 47        # 4. Infer Behaviors
 48        behaviors = self._infer_behaviors(lowered, entities)
 49
 50        # 5. Infer Persistence
 51        persistence = self._infer_persistence(lowered, name)
 52
 53        # 6. Infer Validation Rules
 54        validation_rules = self._infer_validation_rules(lowered, entities)
 55
 56        # 7. Generate Machine-Checkable Acceptance Criteria
 57        acceptance_criteria = self._generate_acceptance_criteria(
 58            entities=entities,
 59            behaviors=behaviors,
 60            interfaces=interfaces,
 61            persistence=persistence,
 62            validation_rules=validation_rules,
 63        )
 64
 65        # 8. Assemble Required Capabilities
 66        caps = ["database", "filesystem"] if persistence.type == "local_store" else ["database"]
 67        if "http_api" in interfaces or "browser_ui" in interfaces:
 68            caps.append("network")
 69
 70        inferred_defaults = {
 71            "inferred_from_prompt": clean_prompt,
 72            "default_port": 8088,
 73            "primary_entity": list(entities.keys())[0] if entities else "item",
 74        }
 75
 76        spec = ProductSpec(
 77            name=name,
 78            title=title,
 79            description=clean_prompt,
 80            interfaces=interfaces,
 81            entities=entities,
 82            behaviors=behaviors,
 83            persistence=persistence,
 84            validation_rules=validation_rules,
 85            acceptance_criteria=acceptance_criteria,
 86            capabilities_required=sorted(list(set(caps))),
 87            default_port=8088,
 88            metadata={"synthesis": inferred_defaults},
 89        )
 90
 91        validation_errors = spec.validate()
 92        if validation_errors:
 93            # Auto-repair minor validation inconsistencies
 94            for err in validation_errors:
 95                if "primary key" in err:
 96                    for ent in spec.entities.values():
 97                        if ent.primary_key not in ent.fields:
 98                            ent.fields[ent.primary_key] = FieldSpec(name=ent.primary_key, type="string", required=True)
 99            # Re-validate
100            remaining_errors = spec.validate()
101            if remaining_errors:
102                raise ValueError(f"Synthesized ProductSpec validation failed: {'; '.join(remaining_errors)}")
103
104        return spec

42@dataclass
43class ProductAcceptanceReport(DataClassSerializationMixin):
44    """Aggregated acceptance report across all product criteria."""
45
46    product_name: str
47    all_passed: bool
48    passed_count: int
49    total_count: int
50    duration_seconds: float
51    checks: List[AcceptanceCheckResult] = field(default_factory=list)
52    schema: str = ACCEPTANCE_REPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION
53
54    def render_markdown(self) -> str:
55        lines = [
56            f"# Acceptance Verification: {self.product_name}",
57            "",
58            f"- **Status:** {'✓ PASSED' if self.all_passed else '✗ FAILED'}",
59            f"- **Summary:** {self.passed_count}/{self.total_count} checks passed ({self.duration_seconds}s)",
60            "",
61            "| Check | Status | Duration | Evidence / Error |",
62            "| --- | --- | --- | --- |",
63        ]
64        for c in self.checks:
65            mark = "✓ PASS" if c.status == "passed" else "✗ FAIL"
66            detail = c.evidence if c.status == "passed" else (c.error_message or "Unknown failure")
67            clean_detail = detail.replace("\n", " ").strip()[:100]
68            lines.append(f"| {c.name} | {mark} | {c.duration_seconds}s | {clean_detail} |")
69        lines.append("")
70        return "\n".join(lines)

class ProductAcceptanceRunner: 
 81class ProductAcceptanceRunner:
 82    """
 83    Executes automated black-box acceptance tests against a synthesized product bundle.
 84    """
 85
 86    def __init__(self, timeout_seconds: int = 30):
 87        self.timeout_seconds = timeout_seconds
 88
 89    def run_acceptance_suite(self, product_dir: Path, spec: ProductSpec) -> ProductAcceptanceReport:
 90        """
 91        Executes complete black-box verification suite against product bundle.
 92        """
 93        checks: List[AcceptanceCheckResult] = []
 94        start_time = time.time()
 95        prod_path = Path(product_dir).resolve()
 96
 97        # 1. Check: Build Compilation
 98        build_check = self._check_build(prod_path)
 99        checks.append(build_check)
100        if build_check.status != "passed":
101            total_dur = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
102            return ProductAcceptanceReport(
103                product_name=spec.name,
104                all_passed=False,
105                passed_count=0,
106                total_count=len(checks),
107                duration_seconds=total_dur,
108                checks=checks,
109            )
110
111        # 2. Check: Static Assets Presence
112        if "browser_ui" in spec.interfaces:
113            checks.append(self._check_static_assets(prod_path))
114
115        # 3. Dynamic HTTP & Persistence Checks
116        if "http_api" in spec.interfaces or "browser_ui" in spec.interfaces:
117            http_checks = self._run_http_and_persistence_checks(prod_path, spec)
118            checks.extend(http_checks)
119
120        passed = sum(1 for c in checks if c.status == "passed")
121        total = len(checks)
122        all_passed = (passed == total and total > 0)
123        total_dur = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
124
125        return ProductAcceptanceReport(
126            product_name=spec.name,
127            all_passed=all_passed,
128            passed_count=passed,
129            total_count=total,
130            duration_seconds=total_dur,
131            checks=checks,
132        )
133
134    def _check_build(self, prod_path: Path) -> AcceptanceCheckResult:
135        t0 = time.time()
136        build_script = prod_path / "scripts" / "build.sh"
137        if not build_script.exists():
138            return AcceptanceCheckResult(
139                name="build_script_exists",
140                description="Verify scripts/build.sh exists in product bundle",
141                status="failed",
142                duration_seconds=round(time.time() - t0, 3),
143                error_message="scripts/build.sh not found",
144            )
145
146        try:
147            res = subprocess.run(
148                ["bash", str(build_script)],
149                cwd=str(prod_path),
150                capture_output=True,
151                text=True,
152                timeout=20,
153            )
154            dur = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
155            if res.returncode == 0:
156                return AcceptanceCheckResult(
157                    name="build_compilation",
158                    description="Compile product bytecode and assets via scripts/build.sh",
159                    status="passed",
160                    duration_seconds=dur,
161                    evidence="Compiled bytecode and static assets with exit code 0",
162                )
163            else:
164                err = (res.stderr + "\n" + res.stdout).strip()
165                return AcceptanceCheckResult(
166                    name="build_compilation",
167                    description="Compile product bytecode and assets via scripts/build.sh",
168                    status="failed",
169                    duration_seconds=dur,
170                    error_message=f"Build failed with exit {res.returncode}: {err[:300]}",
171                )
172        except Exception as exc:
173            return AcceptanceCheckResult(
174                name="build_compilation",
175                description="Compile product bytecode and assets via scripts/build.sh",
176                status="failed",
177                duration_seconds=round(time.time() - t0, 3),
178                error_message=str(exc),
179            )
180
181    def _check_static_assets(self, prod_path: Path) -> AcceptanceCheckResult:
182        t0 = time.time()
183        index_html = prod_path / "static" / "index.html"
184        app_js = prod_path / "static" / "app.js"
185        if not index_html.exists():
186            return AcceptanceCheckResult(
187                name="browser_static_assets",
188                description="Verify static/index.html exists",
189                status="failed",
190                duration_seconds=round(time.time() - t0, 3),
191                error_message="static/index.html not found",
192            )
193        return AcceptanceCheckResult(
194            name="browser_static_assets",
195            description="Verify browser UI assets (index.html, app.js)",
196            status="passed",
197            duration_seconds=round(time.time() - t0, 3),
198            evidence=f"Found static/index.html ({index_html.stat().st_size} bytes)" + (f" and static/app.js ({app_js.stat().st_size} bytes)" if app_js.exists() else ""),
199        )
200
201    def _run_http_and_persistence_checks(self, prod_path: Path, spec: ProductSpec) -> List[AcceptanceCheckResult]:
202        checks: List[AcceptanceCheckResult] = []
203        port = spec.default_port
204        base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
205
206        # Clean existing data store for fresh test
207        data_dir = prod_path / "data"
208        data_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
209        ent_name = list(spec.entities.keys())[0] if spec.entities else "Item"
210        ent_slug = ent_name.lower()
211        (data_dir / f"{ent_slug}.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
212        clean_store_rel = spec.persistence.storage_path.replace("file://", "") if spec.persistence.storage_path.startswith("file://") else spec.persistence.storage_path
213        if clean_store_rel.startswith("data/"):
214            (prod_path / clean_store_rel).write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
215
216        server_proc = self._start_server(prod_path, port)
217        if server_proc is None:
218            checks.append(AcceptanceCheckResult(
219                name="server_lifecycle_start",
220                description="Start server process",
221                status="failed",
222                duration_seconds=0.1,
223                error_message="Could not start server process",
224            ))
225            return checks
226
227        try:
228            # 1. Health / Ready probe
229            health_check = self._probe_health(base_url, timeout=5.0)
230            checks.append(health_check)
231            if health_check.status != "passed":
232                return checks
233
234            # 2. Static root probe
235            if "browser_ui" in spec.interfaces:
236                checks.append(self._check_http_endpoint(
237                    name="http_root_html",
238                    description="Root endpoint serves HTML",
239                    url=f"{base_url}/",
240                    method="GET",
241                    expected_status=200,
242                    content_type="text/html",
243                ))
244
245            # 3. Entity CRUD checks
246            ent_name = list(spec.entities.keys())[0] if spec.entities else "Item"
247            endpoint_slug = ent_name.lower() + "s"
248            api_url = f"{base_url}/api/{endpoint_slug}"
249
250            # Create Record 1
251            payload_1 = {"title": "First Acceptance Test Item", "content": "Testing prompt to product synthesis."} if ent_name == "Note" else {"title": "First Task", "completed": False}
252            create_check = self._check_create(api_url, payload_1)
253            checks.append(create_check)
254
255            # Retrieve List
256            checks.append(self._check_list(api_url))
257
258            # Input Validation Check (Rejected bad payload)
259            bad_payload = {"content": "Missing title"} if ent_name == "Note" else {}
260            checks.append(self._check_validation_rejection(api_url, bad_payload))
261
262            # Create Record 2 for restart persistence
263            payload_2 = {"title": "Restart Persistence Item", "content": "Must survive server process restart."} if ent_name == "Note" else {"title": "Restart Task", "completed": True}
264            self._http_request(api_url, method="POST", data=payload_2)
265
266        finally:
267            self._stop_server(server_proc)
268
269        # 4. Restart Persistence Check: Restart server and verify Record 2 survives
270        if spec.persistence.survives_restart:
271            t0 = time.time()
272            server_proc_2 = self._start_server(prod_path, port)
273            if server_proc_2 is None:
274                checks.append(AcceptanceCheckResult(
275                    name="restart_persistence",
276                    description="Verify state persists across server restart",
277                    status="failed",
278                    duration_seconds=round(time.time() - t0, 3),
279                    error_message="Could not restart server process",
280                ))
281            else:
282                try:
283                    self._probe_health(base_url, timeout=5.0)
284                    status_code, body_text = self._http_request(api_url, method="GET")
285                    dur = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
286                    if status_code == 200 and ("Restart Persistence Item" in body_text or "Restart Task" in body_text or "First Acceptance" in body_text):
287                        checks.append(AcceptanceCheckResult(
288                            name="restart_persistence",
289                            description="Verify state persists across server restart",
290                            status="passed",
291                            duration_seconds=dur,
292                            evidence="Records retained across process reboot in file store.",
293                        ))
294                    else:
295                        checks.append(AcceptanceCheckResult(
296                            name="restart_persistence",
297                            description="Verify state persists across server restart",
298                            status="failed",
299                            duration_seconds=dur,
300                            error_message=f"Persisted record not found after restart (HTTP {status_code}): {body_text[:200]}",
301                        ))
302                finally:
303                    self._stop_server(server_proc_2)
304
305        return checks
306
307    def _start_server(self, prod_path: Path, port: int) -> Optional[subprocess.Popen]:
308        run_script = prod_path / "scripts" / "run.sh"
309        env = os.environ.copy()
310        env["PORT"] = str(port)
311
312        # If run.sh exists, use it with PORT env
313        if run_script.exists():
314            cmd = ["bash", str(run_script), str(port)]
315        else:
316            howlframe_bin = os.environ.get("HOWLFRAME_BIN") or shutil.which("howlframe") or "howlframe"
317            bc_file = prod_path / "build" / "backend.hfbc"
318            cmd = [howlframe_bin, "-run-bc", "-allow-caps", "network,database,filesystem", str(bc_file)]
319
320        try:
321            proc = subprocess.Popen(
322                cmd,
323                cwd=str(prod_path),
324                env=env,
325                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
326                stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
327                text=True,
328            )
329            return proc
330        except Exception:
331            return None
332
333    def _stop_server(self, proc: subprocess.Popen) -> None:
334        try:
335            proc.terminate()
336            proc.wait(timeout=2.0)
337        except Exception:
338            try:
339                proc.kill()
340            except Exception:
341                pass
342
343    def _probe_health(self, base_url: str, timeout: float = 5.0) -> AcceptanceCheckResult:
344        t0 = time.time()
345        deadline = t0 + timeout
346        last_err = ""
347        while time.time() < deadline:
348            for endpoint in ["/health", "/api/notes", "/api/tasks", "/api/records", "/"]:
349                try:
350                    code, body = self._http_request(f"{base_url}{endpoint}", method="GET")
351                    if code in (200, 201):
352                        return AcceptanceCheckResult(
353                            name="server_health_probe",
354                            description="Server responds to health check probe",
355                            status="passed",
356                            duration_seconds=round(time.time() - t0, 3),
357                            evidence=f"Responded {code} on {endpoint}",
358                        )
359                except Exception as exc:
360                    last_err = str(exc)
361            time.sleep(0.1)
362
363        return AcceptanceCheckResult(
364            name="server_health_probe",
365            description="Server responds to health check probe",
366            status="failed",
367            duration_seconds=round(time.time() - t0, 3),
368            error_message=f"Server did not respond within {timeout}s: {last_err}",
369        )
370
371    def _check_http_endpoint(
372        self,
373        name: str,
374        description: str,
375        url: str,
376        method: str = "GET",
377        expected_status: int = 200,
378        content_type: Optional[str] = None,
379    ) -> AcceptanceCheckResult:
380        t0 = time.time()
381        try:
382            code, body = self._http_request(url, method=method)
383            dur = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
384            if code == expected_status:
385                return AcceptanceCheckResult(
386                    name=name,
387                    description=description,
388                    status="passed",
389                    duration_seconds=dur,
390                    evidence=f"HTTP {code} received ({len(body)} bytes)",
391                )
392            else:
393                return AcceptanceCheckResult(
394                    name=name,
395                    description=description,
396                    status="failed",
397                    duration_seconds=dur,
398                    error_message=f"Expected HTTP {expected_status}, received {code}: {body[:200]}",
399                )
400        except Exception as exc:
401            return AcceptanceCheckResult(
402                name=name,
403                description=description,
404                status="failed",
405                duration_seconds=round(time.time() - t0, 3),
406                error_message=str(exc),
407            )
408
409    def _check_create(self, url: str, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> AcceptanceCheckResult:
410        t0 = time.time()
411        try:
412            code, body = self._http_request(url, method="POST", data=payload)
413            dur = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
414            ok = code in (200, 201)
415            return AcceptanceCheckResult(
416                name="create_entity_crud",
417                description="Create entity record via POST",
418                status="passed" if ok else "failed",
419                duration_seconds=dur,
420                evidence=f"Record created successfully (HTTP {code}): {body[:100]}" if ok else None,
421                error_message=f"Expected HTTP 200/201, got {code}: {body[:200]}" if not ok else None,
422            )
423        except Exception as exc:
424            return AcceptanceCheckResult(
425                name="create_entity_crud",
426                description="Create entity record via POST",
427                status="failed",
428                duration_seconds=round(time.time() - t0, 3),
429                error_message=str(exc),
430            )
431
432    def _check_list(self, url: str) -> AcceptanceCheckResult:
433        t0 = time.time()
434        try:
435            code, body = self._http_request(url, method="GET")
436            dur = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
437            ok = code == 200
438            return AcceptanceCheckResult(
439                name="list_entities_crud",
440                description="List entities via GET",
441                status="passed" if ok else "failed",
442                duration_seconds=dur,
443                evidence=f"Retrieved entity list (HTTP 200): {body[:100]}" if ok else None,
444                error_message=f"Expected HTTP 200, got {code}: {body[:200]}" if not ok else None,
445            )
446        except Exception as exc:
447            return AcceptanceCheckResult(
448                name="list_entities_crud",
449                description="List entities via GET",
450                status="failed",
451                duration_seconds=round(time.time() - t0, 3),
452                error_message=str(exc),
453            )
454
455    def _check_validation_rejection(self, url: str, bad_payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> AcceptanceCheckResult:
456        t0 = time.time()
457        try:
458            code, body = self._http_request(url, method="POST", data=bad_payload)
459            dur = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
460            ok = code in (400, 422)
461            return AcceptanceCheckResult(
462                name="input_validation_rejection",
463                description="Invalid input payload rejected with 400 Bad Request",
464                status="passed" if ok else "failed",
465                duration_seconds=dur,
466                evidence=f"Invalid payload rejected with HTTP {code}: {body[:100]}" if ok else None,
467                error_message=f"Expected HTTP 400 on invalid payload, received {code}: {body[:200]}" if not ok else None,
468            )
469        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
470            dur = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
471            ok = exc.code in (400, 422)
472            return AcceptanceCheckResult(
473                name="input_validation_rejection",
474                description="Invalid input payload rejected with 400 Bad Request",
475                status="passed" if ok else "failed",
476                duration_seconds=dur,
477                evidence=f"Invalid payload rejected with HTTP {exc.code}" if ok else None,
478                error_message=f"Received HTTP {exc.code}" if not ok else None,
479            )
480        except Exception as exc:
481            return AcceptanceCheckResult(
482                name="input_validation_rejection",
483                description="Invalid input payload rejected with 400 Bad Request",
484                status="failed",
485                duration_seconds=round(time.time() - t0, 3),
486                error_message=str(exc),
487            )
488
489    def _http_request(self, url: str, method: str = "GET", data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> Tuple[int, str]:
490        req_data = json.dumps(data).encode("utf-8") if data is not None else None
491        headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "application/json, text/html, */*"}
492        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=req_data, headers=headers, method=method)
493        try:
494            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5.0) as resp:  # nosec B310
495                body = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
496                return resp.status, body
497        except urllib.error.HTTPError as err:
498            body = err.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if err.fp else ""
499            return err.code, body

def run_acceptance_suite( self, product_dir: pathlib.Path, spec: howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.product_spec.ProductSpec) -> howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.acceptance_runner.ProductAcceptanceReport: 
 89    def run_acceptance_suite(self, product_dir: Path, spec: ProductSpec) -> ProductAcceptanceReport:
 90        """
 91        Executes complete black-box verification suite against product bundle.
 92        """
 93        checks: List[AcceptanceCheckResult] = []
 94        start_time = time.time()
 95        prod_path = Path(product_dir).resolve()
 96
 97        # 1. Check: Build Compilation
 98        build_check = self._check_build(prod_path)
 99        checks.append(build_check)
100        if build_check.status != "passed":
101            total_dur = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
102            return ProductAcceptanceReport(
103                product_name=spec.name,
104                all_passed=False,
105                passed_count=0,
106                total_count=len(checks),
107                duration_seconds=total_dur,
108                checks=checks,
109            )
110
111        # 2. Check: Static Assets Presence
112        if "browser_ui" in spec.interfaces:
113            checks.append(self._check_static_assets(prod_path))
114
115        # 3. Dynamic HTTP & Persistence Checks
116        if "http_api" in spec.interfaces or "browser_ui" in spec.interfaces:
117            http_checks = self._run_http_and_persistence_checks(prod_path, spec)
118            checks.extend(http_checks)
119
120        passed = sum(1 for c in checks if c.status == "passed")
121        total = len(checks)
122        all_passed = (passed == total and total > 0)
123        total_dur = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
124
125        return ProductAcceptanceReport(
126            product_name=spec.name,
127            all_passed=all_passed,
128            passed_count=passed,
129            total_count=total,
130            duration_seconds=total_dur,
131            checks=checks,
132        )

@dataclass
class ProductSpec(howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.DataClassSerializationMixin): 
 80@dataclass
 81class ProductSpec(DataClassSerializationMixin):
 82    """
 83    Structured, machine-checkable product specification representing
 84    an application by desired outcome and observable behavior.
 85    """
 86
 87    name: str
 88    title: str
 89    description: str
 90    interfaces: List[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: ["browser_ui", "http_api"])
 91    entities: Dict[str, EntitySpec] = field(default_factory=dict)
 92    behaviors: List[BehaviorSpec] = field(default_factory=list)
 93    persistence: PersistenceSpec = field(default_factory=PersistenceSpec)
 94    validation_rules: List[ValidationRuleSpec] = field(default_factory=list)
 95    acceptance_criteria: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
 96    capabilities_required: List[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: ["network", "database", "filesystem"])
 97    default_port: int = 8088
 98    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
 99    schema: str = PRODUCT_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION
100
101    def validate(self) -> List[str]:
102        """
103        Deterministically checks product specification consistency and invariants.
104        Returns a list of validation error strings (empty if fully valid).
105        """
106        errors: List[str] = []
107        if not self.name or not re.match(r"^[a-z0-9_-]+$", self.name):
108            errors.append("Product name must be a non-empty alphanumeric slug (lowercase, digits, underscores, dashes).")
109
110        if not self.title.strip():
111            errors.append("Product title cannot be empty.")
112
113        if not self.description.strip():
114            errors.append("Product description cannot be empty.")
115
116        if not self.interfaces:
117            errors.append("Product must declare at least one interface (e.g. 'browser_ui', 'http_api', 'cli').")
118
119        for iface in self.interfaces:
120            if iface not in ("browser_ui", "http_api", "cli", "wasm"):
121                errors.append(f"Unknown interface type '{iface}'.")
122
123        for ent_name, ent in self.entities.items():
124            if ent.name != ent_name:
125                errors.append(f"Entity key '{ent_name}' does not match entity name '{ent.name}'.")
126            if not ent.fields:
127                errors.append(f"Entity '{ent_name}' must declare at least one field.")
128            if ent.primary_key not in ent.fields:
129                errors.append(f"Entity '{ent_name}' primary key '{ent.primary_key}' is not declared in fields.")
130
131        for b in self.behaviors:
132            if b.entity != "system" and b.entity not in self.entities:
133                errors.append(f"Behavior '{b.name}' references unknown entity '{b.entity}'.")
134
135        for v in self.validation_rules:
136            if v.entity not in self.entities:
137                errors.append(f"Validation rule references unknown entity '{v.entity}'.")
138            elif v.field not in self.entities[v.entity].fields:
139                errors.append(f"Validation rule references unknown field '{v.field}' on entity '{v.entity}'.")
140
141        if not self.acceptance_criteria:
142            errors.append("Product specification must define at least one acceptance criterion.")
143
144        return errors
145
146    def to_yaml(self) -> str:
147        """Serializes ProductSpec to clean YAML string."""
148        return yaml.dump(self.to_dict(), sort_keys=False)
149
150    @classmethod
151    def from_yaml(cls, yaml_content: str) -> "ProductSpec":
152        """Deserializes ProductSpec from YAML string."""
153        data = yaml.safe_load(yaml_content)
154        return cls.from_dict(data)
155
156    @classmethod
157    def from_file(cls, path: Union[str, Any]) -> "ProductSpec":
158        """Loads ProductSpec from a YAML or JSON file."""
159        from pathlib import Path
160        p = Path(path)
161        content = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
162        if p.suffix in (".json",):
163            return cls.from_dict(json.loads(content))
164        return cls.from_yaml(content)
165
166    def save_to_file(self, path: Union[str, Any]) -> None:
167        """Saves ProductSpec to a YAML or JSON file atomically."""
168        from pathlib import Path
169        from howlplane.control_plane.atomic_io import atomic_write_text
170        p = Path(path)
171        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
172        if p.suffix == ".json":
173            atomic_write_text(p, json.dumps(self.to_dict(), indent=2))
174        else:
175            atomic_write_text(p, self.to_yaml())
176
177    @classmethod
178    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "ProductSpec":
179        entities_dict: Dict[str, EntitySpec] = {}
180        for k, v in data.get("entities", {}).items():
181            if isinstance(v, dict):
182                fields_dict: Dict[str, FieldSpec] = {}
183                for fk, fv in v.get("fields", {}).items():
184                    if isinstance(fv, dict):
185                        fields_dict[fk] = FieldSpec.from_dict(fv)
186                    elif isinstance(fv, str):
187                        fields_dict[fk] = FieldSpec(name=fk, type=fv)
188                    elif isinstance(fv, FieldSpec):
189                        fields_dict[fk] = fv
190                entities_dict[k] = EntitySpec(
191                    name=v.get("name", k),
192                    description=v.get("description", ""),
193                    fields=fields_dict,
194                    primary_key=v.get("primary_key", "id"),
195                )
196            elif isinstance(v, EntitySpec):
197                entities_dict[k] = v
198
199        behaviors_list: List[BehaviorSpec] = []
200        for b in data.get("behaviors", []):
201            if isinstance(b, dict):
202                behaviors_list.append(BehaviorSpec.from_dict(b))
203            elif isinstance(b, BehaviorSpec):
204                behaviors_list.append(b)
205
206        p_raw = data.get("persistence", {})
207        persistence = PersistenceSpec.from_dict(p_raw) if isinstance(p_raw, dict) else (
208            p_raw if isinstance(p_raw, PersistenceSpec) else PersistenceSpec()
209        )
210
211        validation_list: List[ValidationRuleSpec] = []
212        for v in data.get("validation_rules", []):
213            if isinstance(v, dict):
214                validation_list.append(ValidationRuleSpec.from_dict(v))
215            elif isinstance(v, ValidationRuleSpec):
216                validation_list.append(v)
217
218        return cls(
219            name=data.get("name", "app"),
220            title=data.get("title", data.get("name", "App")),
221            description=data.get("description", ""),
222            interfaces=data.get("interfaces", ["browser_ui", "http_api"]),
223            entities=entities_dict,
224            behaviors=behaviors_list,
225            persistence=persistence,
226            validation_rules=validation_list,
227            acceptance_criteria=data.get("acceptance_criteria", []),
228            capabilities_required=data.get("capabilities_required", ["network", "database", "filesystem"]),
229            default_port=int(data.get("default_port", 8088)),
230            metadata=data.get("metadata", {}),
231            schema=data.get("schema", PRODUCT_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION),
232        )

166    def save_to_file(self, path: Union[str, Any]) -> None:
167        """Saves ProductSpec to a YAML or JSON file atomically."""
168        from pathlib import Path
169        from howlplane.control_plane.atomic_io import atomic_write_text
170        p = Path(path)
171        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
172        if p.suffix == ".json":
173            atomic_write_text(p, json.dumps(self.to_dict(), indent=2))
174        else:
175            atomic_write_text(p, self.to_yaml())
