@classmethod
def from_dict( cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.product_spec.ProductSpec: 
177    @classmethod
178    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "ProductSpec":
179        entities_dict: Dict[str, EntitySpec] = {}
180        for k, v in data.get("entities", {}).items():
181            if isinstance(v, dict):
182                fields_dict: Dict[str, FieldSpec] = {}
183                for fk, fv in v.get("fields", {}).items():
184                    if isinstance(fv, dict):
185                        fields_dict[fk] = FieldSpec.from_dict(fv)
186                    elif isinstance(fv, str):
187                        fields_dict[fk] = FieldSpec(name=fk, type=fv)
188                    elif isinstance(fv, FieldSpec):
189                        fields_dict[fk] = fv
190                entities_dict[k] = EntitySpec(
191                    name=v.get("name", k),
192                    description=v.get("description", ""),
193                    fields=fields_dict,
194                    primary_key=v.get("primary_key", "id"),
195                )
196            elif isinstance(v, EntitySpec):
197                entities_dict[k] = v
198
199        behaviors_list: List[BehaviorSpec] = []
200        for b in data.get("behaviors", []):
201            if isinstance(b, dict):
202                behaviors_list.append(BehaviorSpec.from_dict(b))
203            elif isinstance(b, BehaviorSpec):
204                behaviors_list.append(b)
205
206        p_raw = data.get("persistence", {})
207        persistence = PersistenceSpec.from_dict(p_raw) if isinstance(p_raw, dict) else (
208            p_raw if isinstance(p_raw, PersistenceSpec) else PersistenceSpec()
209        )
210
211        validation_list: List[ValidationRuleSpec] = []
212        for v in data.get("validation_rules", []):
213            if isinstance(v, dict):
214                validation_list.append(ValidationRuleSpec.from_dict(v))
215            elif isinstance(v, ValidationRuleSpec):
216                validation_list.append(v)
217
218        return cls(
219            name=data.get("name", "app"),
220            title=data.get("title", data.get("name", "App")),
221            description=data.get("description", ""),
222            interfaces=data.get("interfaces", ["browser_ui", "http_api"]),
223            entities=entities_dict,
224            behaviors=behaviors_list,
225            persistence=persistence,
226            validation_rules=validation_list,
227            acceptance_criteria=data.get("acceptance_criteria", []),
228            capabilities_required=data.get("capabilities_required", ["network", "database", "filesystem"]),
229            default_port=int(data.get("default_port", 8088)),
230            metadata=data.get("metadata", {}),
231            schema=data.get("schema", PRODUCT_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION),
232        )
class ProductSynthesizer: 
 105class ProductSynthesizer:
 106    """
 107    Drives prompt-to-product synthesis, real AI provider execution, and bounded repair loops.
 108    """
 109
 110    def __init__(
 111        self,
 112        provider_pool: Optional[ProviderPoolManager] = None,
 113        acceptance_runner: Optional[ProductAcceptanceRunner] = None,
 114        capability_negotiator: Optional[CapabilityNegotiator] = None,
 115        max_repair_cycles: int = 3,
 116        ledger: Optional[EvidenceLedger] = None,
 117        synthesis_mode: str = "auto",  # "auto", "real_ai", "deterministic_baseline"
 118        custom_backend: Optional[AgentBackend] = None,
 119    ):
 120        self.provider_pool = provider_pool or ProviderPoolManager()
 121        self.acceptance_runner = acceptance_runner or ProductAcceptanceRunner()
 122        self.capability_negotiator = capability_negotiator or CapabilityNegotiator()
 123        self.max_repair_cycles = max_repair_cycles
 124        self.ledger = ledger
 125        if custom_backend is not None:
 126            self.synthesis_mode = "real_ai"
 127        elif synthesis_mode != "auto":
 128            self.synthesis_mode = synthesis_mode
 129        else:
 130            self.synthesis_mode = os.environ.get("HOWLPLANE_SYNTHESIS_MODE", "auto")
 131        self.custom_backend = custom_backend
 132
 133    def create_from_prompt(
 134        self,
 135        prompt: str,
 136        output_dir: Union[str, Path],
 137        avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None,
 138        preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None,
 139        port: int = 8088,
 140    ) -> SynthesisResult:
 141        """
 142        End-to-end entrypoint: natural language prompt -> runnable verified product bundle.
 143        """
 144        t0 = time.time()
 145        out_path = Path(output_dir).resolve()
 146        out_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 147
 148        # 1. Natural Language -> Structured ProductSpec
 149        synthesizer = NaturalLanguageSynthesizer()
 150        spec = synthesizer.synthesize(prompt)
 151        spec.default_port = port
 152
 153        # Save product specification
 154        spec_path = out_path / "product_spec.yaml"
 155        spec.save_to_file(spec_path)
 156
 157        # 2. Capability Negotiation with HowlFrame
 158        neg_res = self.capability_negotiator.negotiate(spec)
 159        if not neg_res.is_feasible:
 160            elapsed = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
 161            return SynthesisResult(
 162                product_name=spec.name,
 163                product_spec=spec,
 164                success=False,
 165                status="PRODUCT_BLOCKED",
 166                negotiation=neg_res,
 167                framework_gaps=neg_res.framework_gaps,
 168                duration_seconds=elapsed,
 169                error_message=f"HowlFrame framework gaps block product: {neg_res.framework_gaps[0].required_behavior}",
 170            )
 171
 172        # 3. Provider Selection with Fallback. Full product synthesis is a broad,
 173        # non-mechanical task and is never local-eligible (#58 Phase 9): gate via a
 174        # medium-risk probe task so `local_ollama` is excluded even when AVAILABLE,
 175        # keeping campaigns finite once cloud providers are exhausted.
 176        synthesis_task_probe = TaskSpec(
 177            task_id=f"SYNTH-{spec.name.upper()}",
 178            repository=spec.name,
 179            objective=f"Synthesize {spec.title} HowlFrame product",
 180            task_class="feature",
 181            risk_level="medium",
 182        )
 183        candidates = self.provider_pool.select_candidates(
 184            task_category="code_heavy",
 185            avoid_provider=avoid_provider,
 186            preferred_agent=preferred_agent,
 187            task=synthesis_task_probe,
 188        )
 189        if not candidates and not self.custom_backend:
 190            # Local Ollama has no subscription quota and is never eligible for full
 191            # product synthesis (see probe task above), so it must not keep this
 192            # perpetually "not exhausted" -- gate on cloud providers specifically.
 193            if self.provider_pool.is_all_cloud_exhausted() and self.synthesis_mode != "deterministic_baseline":
 194                return self._exhausted_result(spec, neg_res, t0, "All configured providers are currently exhausted or unavailable")
 195            candidates = ["deterministic_baseline"]
 196
 197        if not candidates and self.custom_backend:
 198            candidates = ["fake_agent"]
 199
 200        # 4. Attempt synthesis with provider fallback
 201        selected_provider: Optional[str] = None
 202        synthesis_prompt = self._build_synthesis_prompt(spec, out_path)
 203
 204        if self.synthesis_mode == "deterministic_baseline" or candidates == ["deterministic_baseline"]:
 205            selected_provider = candidates[0] if candidates else "deterministic_baseline"
 206            self._synthesize_product_files(out_path, spec, repair_iteration=0)
 207        else:
 208            for candidate in candidates:
 209                backend = self.custom_backend or AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(candidate)
 210                task_obj = TaskSpec(
 211                    task_id=f"SYNTH-{spec.name.upper()}",
 212                    repository=spec.name,
 213                    objective=f"Synthesize {spec.title} HowlFrame product",
 214                    task_class="feature",
 215                    risk_level="medium",
 216                    recommended_reasoning_tier="tier_2",
 217                    actual_agent=candidate,
 218                )
 219
 220                # Invoke backend
 221                impl_res = backend.execute(
 222                    task=task_obj,
 223                    cwd=out_path,
 224                    role="implementation",
 225                    prompt_override=synthesis_prompt,
 226                    timeout_seconds=30,
 227                )
 228
 229                # Check for provider exhaustion / rate limit
 230                exhaustion_event = self.provider_pool.detect_exhaustion(candidate, impl_res, task_id=task_obj.task_id)
 231                if exhaustion_event:
 232                    # Quota or availability failure -> advance to next provider
 233                    continue
 234
 235                # Candidate succeeded or is non-exhausted
 236                selected_provider = candidate
 237                break
 238
 239        if not selected_provider:
 240            return self._exhausted_result(spec, neg_res, t0, "All candidate providers failed due to exhaustion or unavailability")
 241
 242        # Ensure required files are present; if backend did not write files directly (e.g. baseline mode / test fixture),
 243        # initialize files from deterministic generator
 244        if not (out_path / "app" / "backend.howl").exists() or not (out_path / "scripts" / "build.sh").exists():
 245            self._synthesize_product_files(out_path, spec, repair_iteration=0)
 246
 247        # 5. Bounded Verification and Repair Loop
 248        repair_count = 0
 249        last_acceptance: Optional[ProductAcceptanceReport] = None
 250        last_reconciliation: Optional[ReconciliationResult] = None
 251        last_err: Optional[str] = None
 252        active_provider = selected_provider
 253        review_role_map: Dict[str, str] = {}
 254        review_invocations: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
 255        diversity_achieved = True
 256        completed_diversity = True
 257
 258        while repair_count <= self.max_repair_cycles:
 259            # Check compile via HowlFrame compiler
 260            compile_ok, compile_err = self._check_compiler(out_path, spec)
 261            if not compile_ok:
 262                repair_count += 1
 263                last_err = f"Compiler error: {compile_err}"
 264                if repair_count <= self.max_repair_cycles:
 265                    active_provider, fail_res = self._attempt_repair_or_exhaustion(
 266                        spec, "compilation", compile_err or "Build failed",
 267                        out_path, active_provider, avoid_provider, repair_count,
 268                        neg_res, last_acceptance, t0
 269                    )
 270                    if fail_res:
 271                        return fail_res
 272                continue
 273
 274            # Run Black-Box Acceptance Verification
 275            accept_report = self.acceptance_runner.run_acceptance_suite(out_path, spec)
 276            last_acceptance = accept_report
 277
 278            if not accept_report.all_passed:
 279                repair_count += 1
 280                failing_checks = [c for c in accept_report.checks if c.status != "passed"]
 281                fail_details = "; ".join(f"{c.name}: {c.error_message}" for c in failing_checks)
 282                last_err = f"Acceptance failure: {fail_details}"
 283                if repair_count <= self.max_repair_cycles:
 284                    active_provider, fail_res = self._attempt_repair_or_exhaustion(
 285                        spec, "acceptance_tests", fail_details,
 286                        out_path, active_provider, avoid_provider, repair_count,
 287                        neg_res, last_acceptance, t0
 288                    )
 289                    if fail_res:
 290                        return fail_res
 291                continue
 292
 293            # Run independent multi-provider review
 294            reviewer_roles = ["test-falsifier", "security-reviewer", "architecture-reviewer"]
 295            review_findings, review_role_map, diversity_achieved, review_invocations, completed_diversity = (
 296                self._run_independent_reviews(
 297                    out_path, spec, reviewer_roles, implementing_provider=active_provider
 298                )
 299            )
 300            reconcile_res = ReviewReconciler.reconcile(review_findings)
 301            last_reconciliation = reconcile_res
 302
 303            # Review completion is a verification gate (#59.2 Phase 3): absence
 304            # of findings is never evidence of a completed review. Every
 305            # required role must have at least one completed invocation before
 306            # VERIFIED_PRODUCT can be returned -- reconciliation findings alone
 307            # are not enough, since a reviewer that never ran has none to report.
 308            completed_roles = {inv["role"] for inv in review_invocations if inv.get("completed")}
 309            missing_roles = [r for r in reviewer_roles if r not in completed_roles]
 310
 311            if self.synthesis_mode != "deterministic_baseline" and missing_roles:
 312                repair_count += 1
 313                last_err = f"Review incomplete: no completed invocation for role(s) {missing_roles}"
 314                if repair_count <= self.max_repair_cycles:
 315                    active_provider, fail_res = self._attempt_repair_or_exhaustion(
 316                        spec, "independent_review", last_err,
 317                        out_path, active_provider, avoid_provider, repair_count,
 318                        neg_res, last_acceptance, t0
 319                    )
 320                    if fail_res:
 321                        return fail_res
 322                continue
 323
 324            if reconcile_res.unresolved_blockers > 0 and repair_count < self.max_repair_cycles:
 325                repair_count += 1
 326                blocker_findings = [f for f in reconcile_res.findings if f.severity in ("blocker", "high") and f.status in ("open", "confirmed", "likely")]
 327                first_title = blocker_findings[0].title if blocker_findings else "Unresolved blocker finding"
 328                last_err = f"Review blocker findings: {first_title}"
 329                active_provider, fail_res = self._attempt_repair_or_exhaustion(
 330                    spec, "independent_review", last_err,
 331                    out_path, active_provider, avoid_provider, repair_count,
 332                    neg_res, last_acceptance, t0
 333                )
 334                if fail_res:
 335                    return fail_res
 336                continue
 337
 338            # Product successfully verified!
 339            bundle = self._package_product_bundle(out_path, spec, accept_report)
 340            elapsed = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
 341
 342            if self.ledger:
 343                self.ledger.append_entry(EvidenceEntry(
 344                    task_id=f"SYNTH-{spec.name.upper()}",
 345                    agent_id=active_provider,
 346                    action="synthesis_verified",
 347                    command=f"howl create '{prompt[:60]}...'",
 348                    result="PASS",
 349                    artifact=str(out_path),
 350                    task_class="feature",
 351                    risk_level="medium",
 352                    reasoning_tier="tier_2",
 353                    implementing_agent=active_provider,
 354                    remediation_cycles=repair_count,
 355                    metadata={
 356                        "product_name": spec.name,
 357                        "passed_checks": accept_report.passed_count,
 358                        "reviewing_providers": list(review_role_map.values()),
 359                        "diversity_achieved": diversity_achieved,
 360                        "completed_diversity": completed_diversity,
 361                    },
 362                ))
 363
 364            return SynthesisResult(
 365                product_name=spec.name,
 366                product_spec=spec,
 367                success=True,
 368                status="VERIFIED_PRODUCT",
 369                product_bundle=bundle,
 370                negotiation=neg_res,
 371                acceptance_report=accept_report,
 372                reconciliation=reconcile_res,
 373                repair_cycles=repair_count,
 374                duration_seconds=elapsed,
 375                implementing_provider=active_provider,
 376                **self._review_evidence_kwargs(review_role_map, review_invocations, diversity_achieved, completed_diversity),
 377            )
 378
 379        # Exhausted repair budget
 380        elapsed = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
 381        return SynthesisResult(
 382            product_name=spec.name,
 383            product_spec=spec,
 384            success=False,
 385            status="REPAIR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED",
 386            negotiation=neg_res,
 387            acceptance_report=last_acceptance,
 388            reconciliation=last_reconciliation,
 389            repair_cycles=repair_count,
 390            duration_seconds=elapsed,
 391            implementing_provider=active_provider,
 392            **self._review_evidence_kwargs(review_role_map, review_invocations, diversity_achieved, completed_diversity),
 393            error_message=f"Exhausted repair budget ({self.max_repair_cycles} cycles): {last_err}",
 394        )
 395
 396    @staticmethod
 397    def _review_evidence_kwargs(
 398        review_role_map: Dict[str, str],
 399        review_invocations: List[Dict[str, Any]],
 400        diversity_achieved: bool,
 401        completed_diversity: bool,
 402    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 403        """Shared SynthesisResult review-evidence fields, common to both the
 404        VERIFIED_PRODUCT and REPAIR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED terminal returns."""
 405        return {
 406            "reviewing_providers": list(review_role_map.values()),
 407            "reviewer_mapping": review_role_map,
 408            "reviewer_invocations": list(review_invocations),
 409            "diversity_achieved": diversity_achieved,
 410            "completed_diversity": completed_diversity,
 411        }
 412
 413    def _exhausted_result(self, spec: ProductSpec, neg_res: NegotiationResult, t0: float, msg: str) -> SynthesisResult:
 414        elapsed = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
 415        return SynthesisResult(
 416            product_name=spec.name,
 417            product_spec=spec,
 418            success=False,
 419            status="PROVIDER_POOL_EXHAUSTED",
 420            negotiation=neg_res,
 421            duration_seconds=elapsed,
 422            error_message=msg,
 423        )
 424
 425    def _attempt_repair_or_exhaustion(
 426        self,
 427        spec: ProductSpec,
 428        stage: str,
 429        details: str,
 430        out_path: Path,
 431        active_provider: str,
 432        avoid_provider: Optional[str],
 433        repair_count: int,
 434        neg_res: NegotiationResult,
 435        last_acceptance: Optional[ProductAcceptanceReport],
 436        t0: float,
 437    ) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Optional[SynthesisResult]]:
 438        active = self._execute_provider_repair(
 439            spec=spec,
 440            failure_stage=stage,
 441            error_details=details,
 442            out_path=out_path,
 443            current_provider=active_provider,
 444            avoid_provider=avoid_provider,
 445        )
 446        if not active:
 447            elapsed = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
 448            return None, SynthesisResult(
 449                product_name=spec.name,
 450                product_spec=spec,
 451                success=False,
 452                status="PROVIDER_POOL_EXHAUSTED",
 453                negotiation=neg_res,
 454                acceptance_report=last_acceptance,
 455                repair_cycles=repair_count,
 456                duration_seconds=elapsed,
 457                error_message=f"All providers exhausted during {stage} repair",
 458            )
 459        return active, None
 460
 461    def _execute_provider_repair(
 462        self,
 463        spec: ProductSpec,
 464        failure_stage: str,
 465        error_details: str,
 466        out_path: Path,
 467        current_provider: str,
 468        avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None,
 469    ) -> Optional[str]:
 470        """
 471        Executes a targeted AI repair cycle using exact feedback diagnostics.
 472        Falls back to next available provider if current provider exhausts.
 473        """
 474        repair_prompt = self._build_repair_prompt(spec, failure_stage, error_details, out_path)
 475        if self.synthesis_mode == "deterministic_baseline" or current_provider == "deterministic_baseline":
 476            self._synthesize_product_files(out_path, spec, repair_iteration=1)
 477            return "deterministic_baseline"
 478
 479        repair_task_probe = TaskSpec(
 480            task_id=f"REPAIR-{spec.name.upper()}",
 481            repository=spec.name,
 482            objective=f"Repair {spec.title} after {failure_stage} failure",
 483            task_class="bug_fix",
 484            risk_level="medium",
 485        )
 486        candidates = self.provider_pool.select_candidates(
 487            task_category="code_heavy",
 488            avoid_provider=avoid_provider,
 489            preferred_agent=current_provider,
 490            task=repair_task_probe,
 491        )
 492
 493        for candidate in candidates:
 494            backend = self.custom_backend or AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(candidate)
 495            task_obj = TaskSpec(
 496                task_id=f"REPAIR-{spec.name.upper()}",
 497                repository=spec.name,
 498                objective=f"Repair {spec.title} after {failure_stage} failure",
 499                task_class="bug_fix",
 500                risk_level="medium",
 501                recommended_reasoning_tier="tier_2",
 502                actual_agent=candidate,
 503            )
 504
 505            res = backend.execute(
 506                task=task_obj,
 507                cwd=out_path,
 508                role="remediation",
 509                prompt_override=repair_prompt,
 510                timeout_seconds=90,
 511            )
 512
 513            exhaustion = self.provider_pool.detect_exhaustion(candidate, res, task_id=task_obj.task_id)
 514            if exhaustion:
 515                continue
 516
 517            return candidate
 518
 519        return None
 520
 521    def _resolve_entity_slugs(self, spec: ProductSpec) -> Tuple[str, str, str]:
 522        ent_name = list(spec.entities.keys())[0] if spec.entities else "Item"
 523        ent_slug = ent_name.lower()
 524        return ent_name, ent_slug, ent_slug + "s"
 525
 526    def _build_synthesis_prompt(self, spec: ProductSpec, out_path: Path) -> str:
 527        ent_name, ent_slug, slug_plural = self._resolve_entity_slugs(spec)
 528        store_path = spec.persistence.storage_path
 529        port = spec.default_port
 530
 531        return f"""You are an expert HowlFrame software engineer.
 532Synthesize a complete, verified, runnable HowlFrame product named '{spec.name}' in the current working directory.
 533
 534Product Specification:
 535Title: {spec.title}
 536Description: {spec.description}
 537Entity: {ent_name} (fields: title, content, created_at)
 538Storage: {store_path} (Native persistent key-value storage)
 539Port: {port}
 540Capabilities: network, database, filesystem
 541
 542Required File Structure to create in the current directory:
 5431. app/backend.howl:
 544   - Must contain (http_server {port} ...)
 545   - Routes:
 546     * "/health" -> JSON 200 {{"status": "ok", "service": "{spec.name}", "healthy": "true"}}
 547     * "/" -> HTML 200 serving static/index.html via (read_file "static/index.html")
 548     * "/static/app.js" -> JS 200 serving static/app.js via (read_file "static/app.js")
 549     * "/static/style.css" -> CSS 200 serving static/style.css via (read_file "static/style.css")
 550     * "/api/{slug_plural}" ->
 551       - OPTIONS: JSON 200 {{"status": "ok"}}
 552       - GET: (store_open kv "{store_path}") -> (store_get kv "1") -> JSON 200 {{"{slug_plural}": [items]}}
 553       - POST: (try_let (body (parse_json {ent_name}Input req.body)) (catch ... (res_json 400 {{"error": "invalid_json"}}))) -> check title required -> (store_put kv "1" item) -> JSON 201
 554       - DELETE: (store_open kv "{store_path}") -> (store_delete kv "1") -> JSON 200 {{"status": "deleted", "id": "1"}}
 5552. app/frontend.howl:
 556   - (web_app ...) definition.
 5573. static/index.html:
 558   - Clean HTML5 layout with form (input-title, input-content, btn-create), status banner, item list.
 5594. static/style.css:
 560   - Modern clean styling.
 5615. static/app.js:
 562   - Client JS making fetch requests to /api/{slug_plural}.
 5636. scripts/build.sh:
 564   - Deterministic build script compiling app/backend.howl -> build/backend.hfbc via howlframe -compile-bc.
 5657. scripts/run.sh:
 566   - Deterministic runner script starting howlframe -run-bc -allow-caps network,database,filesystem build/backend.hfbc.
 5678. scripts/test.sh:
 568   - Test execution script.
 5699. data/{ent_slug}.json:
 570   - Initial data file containing '{{}}'.
 571
 572Generate all files cleanly and ensure scripts/build.sh passes.
 573"""
 574
 575    def _build_repair_prompt(
 576        self,
 577        spec: ProductSpec,
 578        failure_stage: str,
 579        error_details: str,
 580        out_path: Path,
 581    ) -> str:
 582        ent_name = list(spec.entities.keys())[0] if spec.entities else "Item"
 583        slug_plural = ent_name.lower() + "s"
 584        return f"""You are repairing a HowlFrame product '{spec.name}'.
 585The previous build/verification attempt failed during {failure_stage}.
 586
 587Exact Failure Diagnostics:
 588{error_details}
 589
 590Current Files in Repository:
 591Inspect the files in app/, static/, scripts/, data/ and repair the implementation so that:
 5921. scripts/build.sh compiles cleanly without errors.
 5932. All endpoints (/health, /, /api/{slug_plural}) respond with correct status codes and JSON formats.
 5943. Persistence across restart works.
 5954. All acceptance tests and review constraints pass.
 596
 597Make the necessary file edits now.
 598"""
 599
 600    def _run_independent_reviews(
 601        self,
 602        out_path: Path,
 603        spec: ProductSpec,
 604        roles: List[str],
 605        implementing_provider: str = "codex",
 606    ) -> Tuple[List[ReviewFinding], Dict[str, str], bool, List[Dict[str, Any]], bool]:
 607        """
 608        Executes independent multi-provider adversarial reviews over synthesized artifacts.
 609        Distributes reviewer roles across distinct available providers, with bounded
 610        failover (#59.2 Phase 4) to one independent fallback candidate per role when
 611        the preferred assignment is unavailable, exhausted, times out, or produces
 612        invalid/malformed output.
 613
 614        Also returns a per-role invocation record distinguishing assigned from
 615        invoked from completed (#59.1 Phase 8) -- the role mapping alone says
 616        nothing about whether a reviewer actually ran -- plus `completed_diversity`
 617        (#59.2 Phase 5), which reflects which providers actually completed each
 618        role rather than which providers were merely assigned.
 619        """
 620        findings: List[ReviewFinding] = []
 621        invocations: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
 622        rev_mapping, diversity_achieved = self.provider_pool.select_reviewers(
 623            implementing_provider, roles, allow_same_provider=True
 624        )
 625
 626        backend_file = out_path / "app" / "backend.howl"
 627        backend_txt = backend_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if backend_file.exists() else ""
 628
 629        # Deterministic heuristic verification checks (always run)
 630        if "eval" in backend_txt or "system_exec" in backend_txt:
 631            findings.append(ReviewFinding(
 632                id="F-SEC-001",
 633                reviewer_role="security-reviewer",
 634                title="Unsafe execution construct detected in backend",
 635                severity="high",
 636                category="security",
 637                location="app/backend.howl:1",
 638                description="Avoid using unrestricted system exec or eval in backend handlers.",
 639            ))
 640
 641        scripts_present = [str(p.name) for p in (out_path / "scripts").glob("*")] if (out_path / "scripts").is_dir() else []
 642        if "build.sh" not in scripts_present:
 643            findings.append(ReviewFinding(
 644                id="F-TEST-001",
 645                reviewer_role="test-falsifier",
 646                title="Missing deterministic build script",
 647                severity="high",
 648                category="test_gap",
 649                location="scripts/",
 650                description="Product bundle requires scripts/build.sh for automated verification.",
 651            ))
 652
 653        # Multi-provider reviewer execution (only in real AI / custom backend mode)
 654        if self.synthesis_mode != "deterministic_baseline":
 655            for role_id in roles:
 656                preferred = rev_mapping.get(role_id, implementing_provider)
 657                role_obj = get_reviewer_role(role_id)
 658                if not role_obj:
 659                    continue
 660
 661                brief = role_obj.render_brief(
 662                    task=TaskSpec(
 663                        task_id=f"SYNTH-{spec.name.upper()}",
 664                        repository=spec.name,
 665                        objective=f"Review synthesized product {spec.title}",
 666                        task_class="feature",
 667                        risk_level="medium",
 668                        recommended_reasoning_tier="tier_2",
 669                    ),
 670                    diff_content=backend_txt[:4000],
 671                )
 672                review_task = TaskSpec(
 673                    task_id=f"SYNTH-REV-{role_id}",
 674                    repository=spec.name,
 675                    objective=f"Perform {role_id} review for {spec.name}",
 676                    task_class="other",
 677                    risk_level="low",
 678                    recommended_reasoning_tier="tier_2",
 679                )
 680
 681                # The implementer is passed so it is ordered *last*, exactly as
 682                # on the governed review path. Without it, ordinary failover
 683                # could hand a role to the provider that wrote the code --
 684                # which is what PR #60 fixed for governed reviews and what this
 685                # call site silently opted out of (issues.md #15, adjacent
 686                # observation). It stays reachable, because a degraded pool
 687                # should still yield some signal rather than none, but only
 688                # after every independent candidate has been tried.
 689                candidates = build_reviewer_candidates(
 690                    role_id,
 691                    preferred,
 692                    self.provider_pool,
 693                    review_task,
 694                    implementer=implementing_provider,
 695                )
 696
 697                if self.custom_backend:
 698                    backend_lookup: Callable[[str], Optional[AgentBackend]] = lambda _cid: self.custom_backend
 699                else:
 700                    backend_lookup = AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend
 701
 702                winner, rev_res, attempts = invoke_reviewer_with_failover(
 703                    role_id=role_id,
 704                    candidates=candidates,
 705                    task=review_task,
 706                    cwd=out_path,
 707                    prompt_override=brief,
 708                    backend_lookup=backend_lookup,
 709                    provider_pool=self.provider_pool,
 710                )
 711
 712                # Assignment is not execution (#59.1 Phase 8): a reviewer can be
 713                # mapped to a role and never run. Record what actually happened.
 714                invocation: Dict[str, Any] = {
 715                    "role": role_id,
 716                    "provider": winner or preferred,
 717                    "assigned": True,
 718                    "invoked": bool(attempts),
 719                    "completed": bool(winner),
 720                    "status": "completed" if winner else (attempts[-1]["outcome"] if attempts else "not_invoked"),
 721                    "duration_seconds": attempts[-1]["duration_seconds"] if attempts else 0.0,
 722                    "attempts": attempts,
 723                }
 724                if winner and rev_res is not None:
 725                    invocation.update(self._local_review_telemetry(winner, rev_res))
 726                    if rev_res.stdout and rev_res.stdout.strip():
 727                        parsed_findings, _parse_err, _is_valid = parse_and_validate_findings(rev_res.stdout, role_id)
 728                        findings.extend(parsed_findings)
 729                invocations.append(invocation)
 730
 731        completed_by_role = {inv["role"]: inv["provider"] for inv in invocations if inv.get("completed")}
 732        completed_diversity = bool(completed_by_role) and len(set(completed_by_role.values())) == len(completed_by_role)
 733
 734        return findings, rev_mapping, diversity_achieved, invocations, completed_diversity
 735
 736    @staticmethod
 737    def _local_review_telemetry(provider: str, rev_res: AgentExecutionResult) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 738        """
 739        Captures the Tier-3 local provider's own telemetry for a review that
 740        genuinely ran (#59.1 Phase 8) -- model, RAM before/after/after-unload
 741        as the local backend reports them. Observability only: nothing here
 742        widens what the local model is allowed to do.
 743        """
 744        if provider not in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS:
 745            return {}
 746        meta = rev_res.metadata or {}
 747        return {
 748            "model": meta.get("model"),
 749            "ram_before_gib": meta.get("ram_before_gib"),
 750            "ram_after_gib": meta.get("ram_after_gib"),
 751            "ram_after_unload_gib": meta.get("ram_after_unload_gib"),
 752        }
 753
 754    def _synthesize_product_files(
 755        self,
 756        out_path: Path,
 757        spec: ProductSpec,
 758        repair_iteration: int = 0,
 759        last_error: Optional[str] = None,
 760    ) -> None:
 761        """
 762        Synthesizes idiomatic, runnable HowlFrame application artifacts (deterministic baseline).
 763        """
 764        app_dir = out_path / "app"
 765        static_dir = out_path / "static"
 766        scripts_dir = out_path / "scripts"
 767        data_dir = out_path / "data"
 768        build_dir = out_path / "build"
 769
 770        for d in (app_dir, static_dir, scripts_dir, data_dir, build_dir):
 771            d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 772
 773        # Resolve primary entity names
 774        ent_name, ent_slug, slug_plural = self._resolve_entity_slugs(spec)
 775        store_path = spec.persistence.storage_path
 776        port = spec.default_port
 777
 778        # Initialize data store file
 779        atomic_write_text(data_dir / f"{ent_slug}.json", "{}")
 780        clean_store_rel = store_path.replace("file://", "") if store_path.startswith("file://") else store_path
 781        if clean_store_rel.startswith("data/"):
 782            atomic_write_text(out_path / clean_store_rel, "{}")
 783
 784        # 1. app/backend.howl
 785        backend_content = self._render_backend_howl(spec, ent_name, ent_slug, slug_plural, store_path, port)
 786        atomic_write_text(app_dir / "backend.howl", backend_content)
 787
 788        # 2. app/frontend.howl
 789        if "browser_ui" in spec.interfaces:
 790            frontend_content = self._render_frontend_howl(spec, ent_name, slug_plural)
 791            atomic_write_text(app_dir / "frontend.howl", frontend_content)
 792
 793            # 3. static/index.html & static/style.css
 794            html_content = self._render_index_html(spec, ent_name, slug_plural)
 795            atomic_write_text(static_dir / "index.html", html_content)
 796            css_content = self._render_style_css(spec)
 797            atomic_write_text(static_dir / "style.css", css_content)
 798
 799        # 4. scripts/build.sh
 800        build_script = f"""#!/usr/bin/env bash
 801set -euo pipefail
 802
 803# Deterministic HowlFrame compilation script
 804mkdir -p build static data
 805
 806# Locate howlframe compiler
 807if [ -n "${{HOWLFRAME_BIN:-}}" ] && [ -x "${{HOWLFRAME_BIN}}" ]; then
 808    COMPILER="${{HOWLFRAME_BIN}}"
 809elif command -v howlframe >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 810    COMPILER="$(command -v howlframe)"
 811else
 812    echo "ERROR: HowlFrame compiler executable not found." >&2
 813    echo "Please install howlframe or set the HOWLFRAME_BIN environment variable." >&2
 814    exit 127
 815fi
 816
 817echo "==> Building HowlFrame backend bytecode..."
 818"$COMPILER" -compile-bc app/backend.howl -o build/backend.hfbc
 819
 820if [ -f app/frontend.howl ]; then
 821    echo "==> Validating HowlFrame frontend..."
 822    "$COMPILER" -validate app/frontend.howl
 823fi
 824
 825echo "✓ Build complete."
 826"""
 827        atomic_write_text(scripts_dir / "build.sh", build_script)
 828        os.chmod(scripts_dir / "build.sh", 0o755)  # nosec B103
 829
 830        # 5. scripts/run.sh
 831        run_script = f"""#!/usr/bin/env bash
 832set -euo pipefail
 833
 834PORT="${{1:-${{PORT:-{port}}}}}"
 835
 836# Locate howlframe runtime
 837if [ -n "${{HOWLFRAME_BIN:-}}" ] && [ -x "${{HOWLFRAME_BIN}}" ]; then
 838    HOWLFRAME_EXEC="${{HOWLFRAME_BIN}}"
 839elif command -v howlframe >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 840    HOWLFRAME_EXEC="$(command -v howlframe)"
 841else
 842    echo "ERROR: HowlFrame runtime executable not found." >&2
 843    echo "Please install howlframe or set the HOWLFRAME_BIN environment variable." >&2
 844    exit 127
 845fi
 846
 847mkdir -p data build static
 848if [ ! -f data/{ent_slug}.json ]; then
 849    echo '{{}}' > data/{ent_slug}.json
 850fi
 851
 852if [ ! -f build/backend.hfbc ]; then
 853    bash scripts/build.sh
 854fi
 855
 856echo "==> Starting {spec.title} on port ${{PORT}}..."
 857export PORT="${{PORT}}"
 858exec "$HOWLFRAME_EXEC" -run-bc -allow-caps network,database,filesystem build/backend.hfbc
 859"""
 860        atomic_write_text(scripts_dir / "run.sh", run_script)
 861        os.chmod(scripts_dir / "run.sh", 0o755)  # nosec B103
 862
 863        # 6. scripts/test.sh
 864        test_script = f"""#!/usr/bin/env bash
 865set -euo pipefail
 866
 867echo "==> Running {spec.title} acceptance tests..."
 868bash scripts/build.sh
 869echo "✓ All tests verified."
 870"""
 871        atomic_write_text(scripts_dir / "test.sh", test_script)
 872        os.chmod(scripts_dir / "test.sh", 0o755)  # nosec B103
 873
 874        # 7. static/app.js (Compiled client script for interactive browser UI)
 875        if "browser_ui" in spec.interfaces:
 876            app_js_content = self._render_client_js(spec, ent_name, slug_plural)
 877            atomic_write_text(static_dir / "app.js", app_js_content)
 878
 879    def _render_backend_howl(
 880        self,
 881        spec: ProductSpec,
 882        ent_name: str,
 883        ent_slug: str,
 884        slug_plural: str,
 885        store_path: str,
 886        port: int,
 887    ) -> str:
 888        return f""";; =============================================================================
 889;; {spec.title} Backend HTTP Server
 890;; Generated deterministically by HowlPlane Prompt-to-Product Synthesizer
 891;; =============================================================================
 892
 893(http_server {port}
 894
 895  ;; Health probe endpoint
 896  (route "/health" (lambda (req)
 897    (do
 898      (res_header "Access-Control-Allow-Origin" "*")
 899      (res_header "Content-Type" "application/json")
 900      (res_json 200 (dict ("status" "ok") ("service" "{spec.name}") ("healthy" "true")))
 901    )
 902  ))
 903
 904  ;; Static assets serving
 905  (route "/" (lambda (req)
 906    (do
 907      (res_header "Content-Type" "text/html; charset=utf-8")
 908      (res 200 "text/html" (read_file "static/index.html"))
 909    )
 910  ))
 911
 912  (route "/static/app.js" (lambda (req)
 913    (do
 914      (res_header "Content-Type" "application/javascript; charset=utf-8")
 915      (res 200 "application/javascript" (read_file "static/app.js"))
 916    )
 917  ))
 918
 919  (route "/static/style.css" (lambda (req)
 920    (do
 921      (res_header "Content-Type" "text/css; charset=utf-8")
 922      (res 200 "text/css" (read_file "static/style.css"))
 923    )
 924  ))
 925
 926  ;; Primary REST CRUD Endpoints for {slug_plural}
 927  (route "/api/{slug_plural}" (lambda (req)
 928    (do
 929      (res_header "Access-Control-Allow-Origin" "*")
 930      (res_header "Access-Control-Allow-Methods" "GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS")
 931      (res_header "Access-Control-Allow-Headers" "Content-Type")
 932      (let (m (req_method req))
 933        (if (= m "OPTIONS")
 934          (res_json 200 (dict ("status" "ok")))
 935          (if (= m "GET")
 936            (do
 937              (store_open kv "{store_path}")
 938              (let (rec (store_get kv "1"))
 939                (if (is_nil rec)
 940                  (res_json 200 (dict ("{slug_plural}" (list))))
 941                  (res_json 200 (dict ("{slug_plural}" (list rec))))
 942                )
 943              )
 944            )
 945            (if (= m "POST")
 946              (try_let (body (parse_json {ent_name}Input req.body))
 947                (catch parse_err
 948                  (res_json 400 (dict ("error" "invalid_json")))
 949                )
 950                (let (title (map_get body "title"))
 951                  (if (or (is_nil title) (= title ""))
 952                    (res_json 400 (dict ("error" "title_required")))
 953                    (let (content (map_get body "content"))
 954                      (let (note (dict ("id" "1") ("title" title) ("content" content) ("created_at" "2026-08-20T00:00:00Z")))
 955                        (do
 956                          (store_open kv "{store_path}")
 957                          (store_put kv "1" note)
 958                          (res_json 201 note)
 959                        )
 960                      )
 961                    )
 962                  )
 963                )
 964              )
 965              (if (= m "DELETE")
 966                (do
 967                  (store_open kv "{store_path}")
 968                  (store_delete kv "1")
 969                  (res_json 200 (dict ("status" "deleted") ("id" "1")))
 970                )
 971                (res 405 "text/plain" "Method Not Allowed")
 972              )
 973            )
 974          )
 975        )
 976      )
 977    )
 978  ))
 979)
 980"""
 981
 982    def _render_frontend_howl(self, spec: ProductSpec, ent_name: str, slug_plural: str) -> str:
 983        return f""";; =============================================================================
 984;; {spec.title} Frontend Web Application
 985;; Compiled to client JavaScript by HowlFrame Transpiler
 986;; =============================================================================
 987
 988(web_app
 989  (defun load_items ()
 990    (do
 991      (let (status_banner (dom_query "#status"))
 992        (set_text status_banner "Loading {slug_plural}...")
 993      )
 994      (try_let (resp (fetch "/api/{slug_plural}" "GET"))
 995        (catch err
 996          (let (banner (dom_query "#status"))
 997            (set_text banner "Failed to connect to backend server.")
 998          )
 999        )
1000        (let (container (dom_query "#list-container"))
1001          (set_attr container "class" "loaded")
1002        )
1003      )
1004    )
1005  )
1006)
1007"""
1008

1064        return """/* Clean, modern styling for synthesized Howl application */
1065:root {

1079  background-color: var(--bg);

1094
1095.form-group { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
1096.form-group label { display: block; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
1097input[type="text"], textarea {
1098  width: 100%;
1099  background: var(--bg);
1100  border: 1px solid var(--border);
1101  border-radius: 6px;

1122.items-list { display: grid; gap: 0.75rem; }
1123.item-card { background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; }
1124.empty-state { color: var(--text-muted); font-style: italic; text-align: center; padding: 1.5rem 0; }
1125.footer { margin-top: 3rem; text-align: center; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-muted); }

1128    def _render_client_js(self, spec: ProductSpec, ent_name: str, slug_plural: str) -> str:
1129        return f"""// Client logic for {spec.title}
1130document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {{
1131  const form = document.getElementById('create-form');
1132  const titleInput = document.getElementById('input-title');
1133  const contentInput = document.getElementById('input-content');
1134  const listContainer = document.getElementById('list-container');
1135  const refreshBtn = document.getElementById('btn-refresh');
1136  const statusBanner = document.getElementById('status');
1137
1138  async function loadItems() {{
1139    statusBanner.textContent = 'Loading...';
1140    try {{
1141      const res = await fetch('/api/{slug_plural}');
1142      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
1143      const data = await res.json();
1144      const items = data.{slug_plural} || [];
1145      renderItems(items);
1146      statusBanner.textContent = `Ready (${{items.length}} items)`;
1147    }} catch (err) {{
1148      statusBanner.textContent = 'Error loading items: ' + err.message;
1149    }}
1150  }}
1151
1152  function renderItems(items) {{
1153    if (!items || items.length === 0) {{
1154      listContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No {slug_plural} yet. Create your first one above!</div>';
1155      return;
1156    }}
1157    listContainer.innerHTML = items.map(item => `
1158      <div class="item-card" data-id="${{item.id}}">
1159        <div>
1160          <h3>${{escapeHtml(item.title || 'Untitled')}}</h3>
1161          <p>${{escapeHtml(item.content || '')}}</p>
1162        </div>
1163        <button class="btn btn-danger btn-delete" data-id="${{item.id}}">Delete</button>
1164      </div>
1165    `).join('');
1166
1167    document.querySelectorAll('.btn-delete').forEach(btn => {{
1168      btn.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {{
1169        const id = e.target.getAttribute('data-id');
1170        await deleteItem(id);
1171      }});
1172    }});
1173  }}
1174
1175  async function deleteItem(id) {{
1176    try {{
1177      const res = await fetch('/api/{slug_plural}', {{ method: 'DELETE' }});
1178      if (res.ok) await loadItems();
1179    }} catch (err) {{
1180      alert('Failed to delete item: ' + err.message);
1181    }}
1182  }}
1183
1184  form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {{
1185    e.preventDefault();
1186    const title = titleInput.value.trim();
1187    const content = contentInput.value.trim();
1188    if (!title) return;
1189
1190    statusBanner.textContent = 'Saving...';
1191    try {{
1192      const res = await fetch('/api/{slug_plural}', {{
1193        method: 'POST',
1194        headers: {{ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }},
1195        body: JSON.stringify({{ title, content }})
1196      }});
1197      if (res.ok) {{
1198        titleInput.value = '';
1199        contentInput.value = '';
1200        await loadItems();
1201      }} else {{
1202        const errData = await res.json();
1203        alert('Validation error: ' + (errData.message || res.statusText));
1204      }}
1205    }} catch (err) {{
1206      alert('Network error: ' + err.message);
1207    }}
1208  }});
1209
1210  if (refreshBtn) refreshBtn.addEventListener('click', loadItems);
1211  function escapeHtml(str) {{
1212    const div = document.createElement('div');
1213    div.textContent = str;
1214    return div.innerHTML;
1215  }}
1216
1217  loadItems();
1218}});
1219"""
1220
1221    def _check_compiler(self, out_path: Path, spec: ProductSpec) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[str]]:
1222        build_script = out_path / "scripts" / "build.sh"
1223        if not build_script.exists():
1224            return False, "scripts/build.sh not found"
1225        try:
1226            res = subprocess.run(
1227                ["bash", str(build_script)],
1228                cwd=str(out_path),
1229                capture_output=True,
1230                text=True,
1231                timeout=15,
1232            )
1233            if res.returncode == 0:
1234                return True, None
1235            return False, (res.stderr + "\n" + res.stdout).strip()
1236        except Exception as exc:
1237            return False, str(exc)
1238
1239    def _package_product_bundle(
1240        self,
1241        out_path: Path,
1242        spec: ProductSpec,
1243        report: ProductAcceptanceReport,
1244    ) -> ProductBundle:
1245        manifest_data = {
1246            "name": spec.name,
1247            "title": spec.title,
1248            "description": spec.description,
1249            "version": "1.0.0",
1250            "entrypoint": "build/backend.hfbc",
1251            "capabilities": spec.capabilities_required,
1252            "interfaces": spec.interfaces,
1253            "port": spec.default_port,
1254            "created_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
1255            "acceptance": {
1256                "passed": report.passed_count,
1257                "total": report.total_count,
1258                "all_passed": report.all_passed,
1259            },
1260        }
1261
1262        manifest_path = out_path / "manifest.json"
1263        atomic_write_json(manifest_path, manifest_data)
1264
1265        summary_path = out_path / "verification_summary.json"
1266        atomic_write_json(summary_path, report.to_dict())
1267
1268        # Write README.md in product bundle
1269        readme_content = f"""# {spec.title}
1270
1271{spec.description}
1272
1273## Quick Start
1274
1275Run the application with HowlFrame runtime:
1276
1277```bash
1278bash scripts/run.sh
1279```
1280
1281Or execute via HowlPlane:
1282
1283```bash
1284ai run .
1285```
1286
1287Open [http://localhost:{spec.default_port}](http://localhost:{spec.default_port}) in your browser.
1288
1289## Verification
1290
1291Acceptance verification report: {report.passed_count}/{report.total_count} checks passed.
1292"""
1293        atomic_write_text(out_path / "README.md", readme_content)
1294
1295        return ProductBundle(
1296            product_name=spec.name,
1297            directory=str(out_path),
1298            entrypoint=str(out_path / "build" / "backend.hfbc"),
1299            capabilities_required=spec.capabilities_required,
1300            created_at=manifest_data["created_at"],
1301            acceptance_passed=report.all_passed,
1302            total_checks=report.total_count,
1303            passed_checks=report.passed_count,
1304            manifest_path=str(manifest_path),
1305            verification_summary_path=str(summary_path),
1306        )

Drives prompt-to-product synthesis, real AI provider execution, and bounded repair loops.

ProductSynthesizer( provider_pool: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool.ProviderPoolManager] = None, acceptance_runner: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.acceptance_runner.ProductAcceptanceRunner] = None, capability_negotiator: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.capability_negotiator.CapabilityNegotiator] = None, max_repair_cycles: int = 3, ledger: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.evidence_ledger.EvidenceLedger] = None, synthesis_mode: str = 'auto', custom_backend: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.agent_execution.AgentBackend] = None) 
110    def __init__(
111        self,
112        provider_pool: Optional[ProviderPoolManager] = None,
113        acceptance_runner: Optional[ProductAcceptanceRunner] = None,
114        capability_negotiator: Optional[CapabilityNegotiator] = None,
115        max_repair_cycles: int = 3,
116        ledger: Optional[EvidenceLedger] = None,
117        synthesis_mode: str = "auto",  # "auto", "real_ai", "deterministic_baseline"
118        custom_backend: Optional[AgentBackend] = None,
119    ):
120        self.provider_pool = provider_pool or ProviderPoolManager()
121        self.acceptance_runner = acceptance_runner or ProductAcceptanceRunner()
122        self.capability_negotiator = capability_negotiator or CapabilityNegotiator()
123        self.max_repair_cycles = max_repair_cycles
124        self.ledger = ledger
125        if custom_backend is not None:
126            self.synthesis_mode = "real_ai"
127        elif synthesis_mode != "auto":
128            self.synthesis_mode = synthesis_mode
129        else:
130            self.synthesis_mode = os.environ.get("HOWLPLANE_SYNTHESIS_MODE", "auto")
131        self.custom_backend = custom_backend

def create_from_prompt( self, prompt: str, output_dir: Union[str, pathlib.Path], avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None, preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None, port: int = 8088) -> howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.engine.SynthesisResult: 
133    def create_from_prompt(
134        self,
135        prompt: str,
136        output_dir: Union[str, Path],
137        avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None,
138        preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None,
139        port: int = 8088,
140    ) -> SynthesisResult:
141        """
142        End-to-end entrypoint: natural language prompt -> runnable verified product bundle.
143        """
144        t0 = time.time()
145        out_path = Path(output_dir).resolve()
146        out_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
147
148        # 1. Natural Language -> Structured ProductSpec
149        synthesizer = NaturalLanguageSynthesizer()
150        spec = synthesizer.synthesize(prompt)
151        spec.default_port = port
152
153        # Save product specification
154        spec_path = out_path / "product_spec.yaml"
155        spec.save_to_file(spec_path)
156
157        # 2. Capability Negotiation with HowlFrame
158        neg_res = self.capability_negotiator.negotiate(spec)
159        if not neg_res.is_feasible:
160            elapsed = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
161            return SynthesisResult(
162                product_name=spec.name,
163                product_spec=spec,
164                success=False,
165                status="PRODUCT_BLOCKED",
166                negotiation=neg_res,
167                framework_gaps=neg_res.framework_gaps,
168                duration_seconds=elapsed,
169                error_message=f"HowlFrame framework gaps block product: {neg_res.framework_gaps[0].required_behavior}",
170            )
171
172        # 3. Provider Selection with Fallback. Full product synthesis is a broad,
173        # non-mechanical task and is never local-eligible (#58 Phase 9): gate via a
174        # medium-risk probe task so `local_ollama` is excluded even when AVAILABLE,
175        # keeping campaigns finite once cloud providers are exhausted.
176        synthesis_task_probe = TaskSpec(
177            task_id=f"SYNTH-{spec.name.upper()}",
178            repository=spec.name,
179            objective=f"Synthesize {spec.title} HowlFrame product",
180            task_class="feature",
181            risk_level="medium",
182        )
183        candidates = self.provider_pool.select_candidates(
184            task_category="code_heavy",
185            avoid_provider=avoid_provider,
186            preferred_agent=preferred_agent,
187            task=synthesis_task_probe,
188        )
189        if not candidates and not self.custom_backend:
190            # Local Ollama has no subscription quota and is never eligible for full
191            # product synthesis (see probe task above), so it must not keep this
192            # perpetually "not exhausted" -- gate on cloud providers specifically.
193            if self.provider_pool.is_all_cloud_exhausted() and self.synthesis_mode != "deterministic_baseline":
194                return self._exhausted_result(spec, neg_res, t0, "All configured providers are currently exhausted or unavailable")
195            candidates = ["deterministic_baseline"]
196
197        if not candidates and self.custom_backend:
198            candidates = ["fake_agent"]
199
200        # 4. Attempt synthesis with provider fallback
201        selected_provider: Optional[str] = None
202        synthesis_prompt = self._build_synthesis_prompt(spec, out_path)
203
204        if self.synthesis_mode == "deterministic_baseline" or candidates == ["deterministic_baseline"]:
205            selected_provider = candidates[0] if candidates else "deterministic_baseline"
206            self._synthesize_product_files(out_path, spec, repair_iteration=0)
207        else:
208            for candidate in candidates:
209                backend = self.custom_backend or AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(candidate)
210                task_obj = TaskSpec(
211                    task_id=f"SYNTH-{spec.name.upper()}",
212                    repository=spec.name,
213                    objective=f"Synthesize {spec.title} HowlFrame product",
214                    task_class="feature",
215                    risk_level="medium",
216                    recommended_reasoning_tier="tier_2",
217                    actual_agent=candidate,
218                )
219
220                # Invoke backend
221                impl_res = backend.execute(
222                    task=task_obj,
223                    cwd=out_path,
224                    role="implementation",
225                    prompt_override=synthesis_prompt,
226                    timeout_seconds=30,
227                )
228
229                # Check for provider exhaustion / rate limit
230                exhaustion_event = self.provider_pool.detect_exhaustion(candidate, impl_res, task_id=task_obj.task_id)
231                if exhaustion_event:
232                    # Quota or availability failure -> advance to next provider
233                    continue
234
235                # Candidate succeeded or is non-exhausted
236                selected_provider = candidate
237                break
238
239        if not selected_provider:
240            return self._exhausted_result(spec, neg_res, t0, "All candidate providers failed due to exhaustion or unavailability")
241
242        # Ensure required files are present; if backend did not write files directly (e.g. baseline mode / test fixture),
243        # initialize files from deterministic generator
244        if not (out_path / "app" / "backend.howl").exists() or not (out_path / "scripts" / "build.sh").exists():
245            self._synthesize_product_files(out_path, spec, repair_iteration=0)
246
247        # 5. Bounded Verification and Repair Loop
248        repair_count = 0
249        last_acceptance: Optional[ProductAcceptanceReport] = None
250        last_reconciliation: Optional[ReconciliationResult] = None
251        last_err: Optional[str] = None
252        active_provider = selected_provider
253        review_role_map: Dict[str, str] = {}
254        review_invocations: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
255        diversity_achieved = True
256        completed_diversity = True
257
258        while repair_count <= self.max_repair_cycles:
259            # Check compile via HowlFrame compiler
260            compile_ok, compile_err = self._check_compiler(out_path, spec)
261            if not compile_ok:
262                repair_count += 1
263                last_err = f"Compiler error: {compile_err}"
264                if repair_count <= self.max_repair_cycles:
265                    active_provider, fail_res = self._attempt_repair_or_exhaustion(
266                        spec, "compilation", compile_err or "Build failed",
267                        out_path, active_provider, avoid_provider, repair_count,
268                        neg_res, last_acceptance, t0
269                    )
270                    if fail_res:
271                        return fail_res
272                continue
273
274            # Run Black-Box Acceptance Verification
275            accept_report = self.acceptance_runner.run_acceptance_suite(out_path, spec)
276            last_acceptance = accept_report
277
278            if not accept_report.all_passed:
279                repair_count += 1
280                failing_checks = [c for c in accept_report.checks if c.status != "passed"]
281                fail_details = "; ".join(f"{c.name}: {c.error_message}" for c in failing_checks)
282                last_err = f"Acceptance failure: {fail_details}"
283                if repair_count <= self.max_repair_cycles:
284                    active_provider, fail_res = self._attempt_repair_or_exhaustion(
285                        spec, "acceptance_tests", fail_details,
286                        out_path, active_provider, avoid_provider, repair_count,
287                        neg_res, last_acceptance, t0
288                    )
289                    if fail_res:
290                        return fail_res
291                continue
292
293            # Run independent multi-provider review
294            reviewer_roles = ["test-falsifier", "security-reviewer", "architecture-reviewer"]
295            review_findings, review_role_map, diversity_achieved, review_invocations, completed_diversity = (
296                self._run_independent_reviews(
297                    out_path, spec, reviewer_roles, implementing_provider=active_provider
298                )
299            )
300            reconcile_res = ReviewReconciler.reconcile(review_findings)
301            last_reconciliation = reconcile_res
302
303            # Review completion is a verification gate (#59.2 Phase 3): absence
304            # of findings is never evidence of a completed review. Every
305            # required role must have at least one completed invocation before
306            # VERIFIED_PRODUCT can be returned -- reconciliation findings alone
307            # are not enough, since a reviewer that never ran has none to report.
308            completed_roles = {inv["role"] for inv in review_invocations if inv.get("completed")}
309            missing_roles = [r for r in reviewer_roles if r not in completed_roles]
310
311            if self.synthesis_mode != "deterministic_baseline" and missing_roles:
312                repair_count += 1
313                last_err = f"Review incomplete: no completed invocation for role(s) {missing_roles}"
314                if repair_count <= self.max_repair_cycles:
315                    active_provider, fail_res = self._attempt_repair_or_exhaustion(
316                        spec, "independent_review", last_err,
317                        out_path, active_provider, avoid_provider, repair_count,
318                        neg_res, last_acceptance, t0
319                    )
320                    if fail_res:
321                        return fail_res
322                continue
323
324            if reconcile_res.unresolved_blockers > 0 and repair_count < self.max_repair_cycles:
325                repair_count += 1
326                blocker_findings = [f for f in reconcile_res.findings if f.severity in ("blocker", "high") and f.status in ("open", "confirmed", "likely")]
327                first_title = blocker_findings[0].title if blocker_findings else "Unresolved blocker finding"
328                last_err = f"Review blocker findings: {first_title}"
329                active_provider, fail_res = self._attempt_repair_or_exhaustion(
330                    spec, "independent_review", last_err,
331                    out_path, active_provider, avoid_provider, repair_count,
332                    neg_res, last_acceptance, t0
333                )
334                if fail_res:
335                    return fail_res
336                continue
337
338            # Product successfully verified!
339            bundle = self._package_product_bundle(out_path, spec, accept_report)
340            elapsed = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
341
342            if self.ledger:
343                self.ledger.append_entry(EvidenceEntry(
344                    task_id=f"SYNTH-{spec.name.upper()}",
345                    agent_id=active_provider,
346                    action="synthesis_verified",
347                    command=f"howl create '{prompt[:60]}...'",
348                    result="PASS",
349                    artifact=str(out_path),
350                    task_class="feature",
351                    risk_level="medium",
352                    reasoning_tier="tier_2",
353                    implementing_agent=active_provider,
354                    remediation_cycles=repair_count,
355                    metadata={
356                        "product_name": spec.name,
357                        "passed_checks": accept_report.passed_count,
358                        "reviewing_providers": list(review_role_map.values()),
359                        "diversity_achieved": diversity_achieved,
360                        "completed_diversity": completed_diversity,
361                    },
362                ))
363
364            return SynthesisResult(
365                product_name=spec.name,
366                product_spec=spec,
367                success=True,
368                status="VERIFIED_PRODUCT",
369                product_bundle=bundle,
370                negotiation=neg_res,
371                acceptance_report=accept_report,
372                reconciliation=reconcile_res,
373                repair_cycles=repair_count,
374                duration_seconds=elapsed,
375                implementing_provider=active_provider,
376                **self._review_evidence_kwargs(review_role_map, review_invocations, diversity_achieved, completed_diversity),
377            )
378
379        # Exhausted repair budget
380        elapsed = round(time.time() - t0, 3)
381        return SynthesisResult(
382            product_name=spec.name,
383            product_spec=spec,
384            success=False,
385            status="REPAIR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED",
386            negotiation=neg_res,
387            acceptance_report=last_acceptance,
388            reconciliation=last_reconciliation,
389            repair_cycles=repair_count,
390            duration_seconds=elapsed,
391            implementing_provider=active_provider,
392            **self._review_evidence_kwargs(review_role_map, review_invocations, diversity_achieved, completed_diversity),
393            error_message=f"Exhausted repair budget ({self.max_repair_cycles} cycles): {last_err}",
394        )
