class ProviderPoolManager: 
 421class ProviderPoolManager:
 422    """Single owner for resource readiness, capacity, and final selection."""
 423
 424    def __init__(
 425        self,
 426        registry: Optional[AgentRegistry] = None,
 427        avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None,
 428        fallback_provider: Optional[str] = None,
 429        resources: Optional[Dict[str, ProviderResourceSettings]] = None,
 430        policy: Optional[ProviderPolicySettings] = None,
 431        operating_mode: str = "connected",
 432        backend_resolver: Optional[Callable[[str], AgentBackend]] = None,
 433        state_path: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
 434        probe_on_start: bool = True,
 435        read_only: bool = False,
 436    ):
 437        self.registry = registry or AgentRegistry()
 438        self.avoid_provider = avoid_provider
 439        self.fallback_provider = fallback_provider
 440        self.policy = policy or ProviderPolicySettings()
 441        self.operating_mode = operating_mode
 442        self._backend_resolver = backend_resolver or AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend
 443        self._legacy_mode = resources is None
 444        configured = resources if resources is not None else {
 445            profile.resource_id: ProviderResourceSettings(enabled=True)
 446            for profile in self.registry.list_resources()
 447        }
 448        self.resources = self._normalize_resources(configured)
 449        self.read_only = read_only
 450        self._store = ProviderCapacityStore(state_path) if state_path else None
 451        self._provider_states: Dict[str, ProviderStatus] = (
 452            self._store.load() if self._store else {}
 453        )
 454        self._validate_configuration()
 455        self._initialize_states(probe_on_start=probe_on_start)
 456
 457    @classmethod
 458    def from_settings(
 459        cls,
 460        settings: Any,
 461        *,
 462        registry: Optional[AgentRegistry] = None,
 463        state_path: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
 464        read_only: bool = False,
 465        probe_on_start: bool = True,
 466    ) -> "ProviderPoolManager":
 467        """Builds the production pool with deterministic legacy migration."""
 468        actual_registry = registry or AgentRegistry()
 469        configured = dict(settings.providers)
 470        if not configured:
 471            if settings.operating_mode == "local_only":
 472                configured = {"local_ollama": ProviderResourceSettings(enabled=True)}
 473            else:
 474                configured = {
 475                    profile.resource_id: ProviderResourceSettings(enabled=True)
 476                    for profile in actual_registry.list_resources()
 477                }
 478        return cls(
 479            registry=actual_registry,
 480            resources=configured,
 481            policy=settings.provider_policy,
 482            operating_mode=settings.operating_mode,
 483            state_path=state_path,
 484            read_only=read_only,
 485            probe_on_start=probe_on_start,
 486        )
 487
 488    @classmethod
 489    def from_config(
 490        cls,
 491        *,
 492        read_only: bool = False,
 493        probe_on_start: bool = True,
 494    ) -> "ProviderPoolManager":
 495        """Builds a pool from canonical plus operator-local configuration."""
 496        from howlplane.control_plane.config_loader import default_loader
 497
 498        capacity_path = Path.home() / ".config" / "howlplane" / "provider_capacity.json"
 499        return cls.from_settings(
 500            default_loader.settings,
 501            state_path=capacity_path,
 502            read_only=read_only,
 503            probe_on_start=probe_on_start,
 504        )
 505
 506    def _normalize(self, resource_id: str) -> str:
 507        return AgentBackendRegistry.normalize_agent_id(resource_id)
 508
 509    def _normalize_resources(
 510        self,
 511        resources: Dict[str, ProviderResourceSettings],
 512    ) -> Dict[str, ProviderResourceSettings]:
 513        normalized: Dict[str, ProviderResourceSettings] = {}
 514        for supplied_id, resource_config in resources.items():
 515            resource_id = self._normalize(supplied_id)
 516            if resource_id in normalized:
 517                raise ProviderConfigurationError(
 518                    f"Duplicate resource definition after alias normalization: {resource_id}"
 519                )
 520            normalized[resource_id] = (
 521                resource_config
 522                if isinstance(resource_config, ProviderResourceSettings)
 523                else ProviderResourceSettings.model_validate(resource_config)
 524            )
 525        return normalized
 526
 527    def _validate_configuration(self) -> None:
 528        if self.operating_mode not in ("local_only", "connected"):
 529            raise ProviderConfigurationError(
 530                f"Invalid operating mode: {self.operating_mode}"
 531            )
 532        known = {
 533            profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id
 534            for profile in self.registry.list_resources()
 535        }
 536        unknown = sorted(set(self.resources).difference(known))
 537        if unknown:
 538            raise ProviderConfigurationError(
 539                f"Unknown configured resource ID(s): {', '.join(unknown)}"
 540            )
 541        preferences = self.policy.preferred_external + self.policy.preferred_local
 542        unknown_preferences = sorted(
 543            {self._normalize(item) for item in preferences}.difference(known)
 544        )
 545        if unknown_preferences:
 546            raise ProviderConfigurationError(
 547                "Unknown preferred resource ID(s): " + ", ".join(unknown_preferences)
 548            )
 549        for resource_id, resource_config in self.resources.items():
 550            profile = self.registry.get_resource(resource_id)
 551            if profile is None:
 552                continue
 553            if (
 554                resource_config.interface_id
 555                and resource_config.interface_id != profile.interface_id
 556            ):
 557                raise ProviderConfigurationError(
 558                    f"Invalid interface reference for resource '{resource_id}'."
 559                )
 560            if resource_config.model_id:
 561                if profile.model_id and resource_config.model_id != profile.model_id:
 562                    if not profile.model_configurable:
 563                        raise ProviderConfigurationError(
 564                            f"Invalid model reference for resource '{resource_id}'."
 565                        )
 566                elif profile.model_id is None and not profile.model_configurable:
 567                    raise ProviderConfigurationError(
 568                        f"Model identity is not configurable for resource '{resource_id}'."
 569                    )
 570
 571    def _new_status(self, profile: AgentProfile) -> ProviderStatus:
 572        identity = profile.resource_identity()
 573        return ProviderStatus(
 574            agent_id=profile.agent_id,
 575            name=profile.name,
 576            provider_id=identity.provider_id,
 577            interface_id=identity.interface_id,
 578            resource_id=identity.resource_id,
 579            model_id=identity.model_id,
 580        )
 581
 582    def _resource_identity(self, profile: AgentProfile) -> ResourceIdentity:
 583        """Returns configured/observed identity without mutating the profile."""
 584        base = profile.resource_identity()
 585        state = self._provider_states.get(base.resource_id)
 586        return ResourceIdentity(
 587            provider_id=base.provider_id,
 588            interface_id=base.interface_id,
 589            resource_id=base.resource_id,
 590            model_id=state.model_id if state is not None else base.model_id,
 591        )
 592
 593    def _initialize_states(self, *, probe_on_start: bool) -> None:
 594        known_ids: Set[str] = set()
 595        for profile in self.registry.list_resources():
 596            resource_id = profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id
 597            known_ids.add(resource_id)
 598            state = self._provider_states.get(resource_id) or self._new_status(profile)
 599            self._provider_states[resource_id] = state
 600            resource_config = self.resources.get(resource_id)
 601            if resource_config is None:
 602                self._disable_without_probe(state, "NOT_CONFIGURED")
 603                continue
 604            if not resource_config.enabled:
 605                self._disable_without_probe(state, "OPERATOR_DISABLED")
 606                continue
 607            if self._egress_forbidden(profile):
 608                self._disable_without_probe(state, "EGRESS_FORBIDDEN")
 609                continue
 610            if resource_config.model_id:
 611                state.model_id = resource_config.model_id
 612            if probe_on_start:
 613                self._apply_readiness(resource_id, profile, state)
 614        self._provider_states = {
 615            key: value for key, value in self._provider_states.items() if key in known_ids
 616        }
 617        self._persist()
 618
 619    def _disable_without_probe(self, state: ProviderStatus, reason: str) -> None:
 620        state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DISABLED
 621        state.readiness = ReadinessStatus.NOT_PROBED
 622        state.unavailable_reason = reason
 623        state.observed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 624
 625    def _egress_forbidden(self, profile: AgentProfile) -> bool:
 626        return (
 627            self.operating_mode == "local_only"
 628            and profile.locality != ResourceLocality.LOCAL.value
 629        )
 630
 631    def _apply_readiness(
 632        self,
 633        resource_id: str,
 634        profile: AgentProfile,
 635        state: ProviderStatus,
 636    ) -> BackendReadiness:
 637        backend = self._backend_resolver(resource_id)
 638        readiness = backend.probe_readiness()
 639        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 640        state.readiness = ReadinessStatus(readiness.status)
 641        state.authentication = AuthenticationStatus(readiness.authentication)
 642        state.unavailable_reason = readiness.reason
 643        state.evidence = readiness.evidence
 644        state.unattended_mutation_capable = readiness.unattended_mutation_capable
 645        state.capability_reason = readiness.capability_reason
 646        state.last_checked = now
 647        state.observed_at = now
 648        failure_states = {
 649            ReadinessStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
 650            ReadinessStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
 651            ReadinessStatus.UNREACHABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNREACHABLE,
 652            ReadinessStatus.UNAVAILABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
 653        }
 654        if readiness.status in failure_states:
 655            state.status = failure_states[readiness.status]
 656        elif readiness.status == ReadinessStatus.READY:
 657            retained = {
 658                ProviderAvailabilityStatus.SESSION_EXHAUSTED,
 659                ProviderAvailabilityStatus.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
 660                ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RATE_LIMITED,
 661            }
 662            if state.status not in retained:
 663                if self._legacy_mode or profile.locality == ResourceLocality.LOCAL.value:
 664                    state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE
 665                else:
 666                    state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN
 667        return readiness
 668
 669    def _persist(self) -> None:
 670        if self._store and not self.read_only:
 671            self._store.save(self._provider_states)
 672
 673    def get_status(self, agent_id: str) -> ProviderAvailabilityStatus:
 674        resource_id = self._normalize(agent_id)
 675        state = self._provider_states.get(resource_id)
 676        return state.status if state else ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN
 677
 678    def get_resource_status(self, resource_id: str) -> Optional[ProviderStatus]:
 679        return self._provider_states.get(self._normalize(resource_id))
 680
 681    def set_status(
 682        self,
 683        agent_id: str,
 684        status: ProviderAvailabilityStatus,
 685        event: Optional[ProviderExhaustionEvent] = None,
 686    ) -> None:
 687        resource_id = self._normalize(agent_id)
 688        state = self._provider_states.get(resource_id)
 689        if state is None:
 690            profile = self.registry.get_resource(resource_id)
 691            state = self._new_status(profile) if profile else ProviderStatus(
 692                agent_id=resource_id,
 693                name=resource_id,
 694                resource_id=resource_id,
 695            )
 696            self._provider_states[resource_id] = state
 697        state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus(status)
 698        if state.status == ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE:
 699            state.readiness = ReadinessStatus.READY
 700            state.unavailable_reason = None
 701        state.last_checked = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 702        state.observed_at = state.last_checked
 703        if event:
 704            state.exhaustion_event = event
 705        self._persist()
 706
 707    def get_all_statuses(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
 708        return {
 709            resource_id: state.status.value
 710            for resource_id, state in sorted(self._provider_states.items())
 711        }
 712
 713    def inventory(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
 714        """Returns registered, configured, readiness, and capacity distinctions."""
 715        rows = []
 716        for profile in self.registry.list_resources():
 717            resource_id = profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id
 718            resource_config = self.resources.get(resource_id)
 719            state = self._provider_states[resource_id]
 720            rows.append({
 721                "identity": self._resource_identity(profile).to_dict(),
 722                "name": profile.name,
 723                "registered": True,
 724                "configured": resource_config is not None,
 725                "enabled": bool(resource_config and resource_config.enabled),
 726                "locality": profile.locality,
 727                "economic_class": profile.economic_class,
 728                "readiness": state.readiness.value,
 729                "authentication": state.authentication.value,
 730                "unattended_mutation_capable": state.unattended_mutation_capable,
 731                "capability_reason": state.capability_reason,
 732                "capacity": state.status.value,
 733                "reason": state.unavailable_reason,
 734                "observed_at": state.observed_at,
 735                "last_success_at": state.last_success_at,
 736                "last_failure_at": state.last_failure_at,
 737                "metered_invocation_count": state.metered_invocation_count,
 738                "retry_after": state.retry_after,
 739                "reset_at": state.reset_at,
 740            })
 741        return rows
 742
 743    def has_available_providers(self) -> bool:
 744        usable = {
 745            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE,
 746            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DEGRADED,
 747            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN,
 748        }
 749        return any(state.status in usable for state in self._provider_states.values())
 750
 751    def is_all_cloud_exhausted(self) -> bool:
 752        cloud = []
 753        for profile in self.registry.list_resources():
 754            if profile.locality == ResourceLocality.LOCAL.value:
 755                continue
 756            state = self._provider_states.get(profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id)
 757            if state and state.status != ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DISABLED:
 758                cloud.append(state.status)
 759        unavailable = {
 760            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.SESSION_EXHAUSTED,
 761            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
 762            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RATE_LIMITED,
 763            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
 764            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
 765            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNREACHABLE,
 766            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
 767        }
 768        return not cloud or all(status in unavailable for status in cloud)
 769
 770    def is_all_exhausted(self) -> bool:
 771        active = [
 772            state.status
 773            for state in self._provider_states.values()
 774            if state.status != ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DISABLED
 775        ]
 776        exhausted = {
 777            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.SESSION_EXHAUSTED,
 778            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
 779            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RATE_LIMITED,
 780        }
 781        return bool(active) and all(status in exhausted for status in active)
 782
 783    def classify_failure(
 784        self,
 785        agent_id: str,
 786        result: AgentExecutionResult,
 787    ) -> ProviderFailureClass:
 788        """Retains the pool's instance classification contract."""
 789        return ProviderPoolManager.classify_result(self._normalize(agent_id), result)
 790
 791    @staticmethod
 792    def classify_result(
 793        agent_id: str,
 794        result: AgentExecutionResult,
 795    ) -> ProviderFailureClass:
 796        """Normalizes availability separately from engineering results."""
 797        if result.success:
 798            return ProviderFailureClass.UNKNOWN
 799        resource_id = AgentBackendRegistry.normalize_agent_id(agent_id)
 800        combined = "\n".join(
 801            [result.error_message or "", result.stderr or "", result.stdout or ""]
 802        ).lower()
 803        # Structural execution evidence outranks transcript text. A long agent
 804        # transcript is arbitrary third-party content that routinely contains the
 805        # very phrases these markers look for, so where the harness observed the
 806        # process directly, that observation wins (SLOPFIX-03).
 807        metadata = result.metadata or {}
 808        if metadata.get(WATCHDOG_TERMINATION_KEY) == WATCHDOG_TERMINATION_STALL:
 809            return ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED
 810        launch_outcome = metadata.get(LAUNCH_OUTCOME_KEY)
 811        if launch_outcome in (LAUNCH_OUTCOME_NOT_INSTALLED, LAUNCH_OUTCOME_SPAWN_FAILED):
 812            return ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE
 813        # A harness-sourced or budget-derived timeout is this process stopping
 814        # the provider at our own budget (either directly via harness kill or
 815        # via a harness-derived print timeout). Nothing was observed about
 816        # reachability, so it is an execution budget result, not a transport
 817        # failure. Transcript-sourced timeouts without budget derivation still
 818        # fall through to the transport branch below, where a provider genuinely
 819        # reporting that it could not reach its service is classified as
 820        # TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE and benched (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05).
 821        if (
 822            metadata.get(TIMEOUT_SOURCE_KEY) in (TIMEOUT_SOURCE_HARNESS, TIMEOUT_SOURCE_BUDGET)
 823            or metadata.get(BUDGET_DERIVED_KEY) is True
 824        ):
 825            return ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
 826        if launch_outcome != LAUNCH_OUTCOME_LAUNCHED and result.exit_code == 127:
 827            return ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE
 828
 829        # A provider's exact terminal error is stronger than evidence collected
 830        # earlier in its session. In particular, a hard capacity stop must not
 831        # be hidden by an earlier denied tool. However, arbitrary trailing prose
 832        # in stdout must NEVER override a structured denial: only authenticated
 833        # structured metadata or explicit non-zero exit stderr can outrank it.
 834        if metadata.get(TOOL_PERMISSION_KEY) == TOOL_PERMISSION_DENIED:
 835            structured_terminal = _classify_structured_terminal_hard_failure(result)
 836            if structured_terminal is not None:
 837                return structured_terminal
 838            return ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED
 839
 840        # A machine-readable error envelope is the strongest signal a provider
 841        # can give about why it stopped, and it does not depend on where the
 842        # message happens to sit in the output. Devin's quota error is a
 843        # multi-line JSON blob whose last non-empty line is "}", so the
 844        # anchored line matching below cannot see it at all, whatever patterns
 845        # are added (issues.md #15).
 846        envelope_failure = _classify_structured_error_envelope(result)
 847        if envelope_failure is not None:
 848            return envelope_failure
 849
 850        terminal_hard_failure = _classify_terminal_hard_failure(result)
 851        if terminal_hard_failure is not None:
 852            return terminal_hard_failure
 853
 854        # A provider that demonstrably started cannot be a missing executable,
 855        # whatever its session log says about commands that were not found.
 856        # Backends that stamp no markers keep the older text-based behavior, with
 857        # one correction: a timeout verdict is the more specific signal and so
 858        # outranks the substring scan. Exit 127 remains a legacy launch verdict
 859        # only when no structural launched marker contradicts it.
 860        if launch_outcome != LAUNCH_OUTCOME_LAUNCHED and (
 861            not result.timed_out and any(marker in combined for marker in (
 862                "command not found", "binary not found", "not installed",
 863            ))
 864        ):
 865            return ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE
 866        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
 867            "requires approval", "require approval", "permission denied",
 868            "requires permission", "execution permission required", "execution_permission_required",
 869            "needs approval", "approve bash execution",
 870            "workspace trust required", "trust the current workspace", "pass --trust",
 871        )):
 872            return ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED
 873        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
 874            "authentication required", "not authenticated", "login required",
 875            "unauthorized", "invalid api key",
 876        )):
 877            return ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
 878        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
 879            "429 too many requests", "rate_limit", "rate limit", "rate limited",
 880        )):
 881            return ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED
 882        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
 883            "quota exhausted", "quota exceeded", "insufficient_quota",
 884            "credits exhausted", "insufficient funds", "resource exhausted",
 885        )):
 886            return ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
 887        session_patterns = EXHAUSTION_PATTERNS.get(resource_id, []) + [
 888            "usage limit",
 889            "session limit",
 890            "individual quota reached",
 891            "quota reached",
 892            "upgrade your subscription",
 893            "out of capacity",
 894        ]
 895        if any(marker in combined for marker in session_patterns):
 896            return ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT
 897        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
 898            "malformed", "invalid json", "invalid yaml", "parse error",
 899        )):
 900            return ProviderFailureClass.MALFORMED_OUTPUT
 901        if result.timed_out or any(marker in combined for marker in (
 902            "connection refused", "transport unavailable", "network unreachable",
 903            "timed out", "timeout waiting for response", "request timed out",
 904            "connection timed out", "gateway timeout", "read timeout",
 905            "operation timed out", "deadline exceeded", "timeout after",
 906        )):
 907            return ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE
 908        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
 909            "provider unavailable", "service unavailable", "overloaded_error", "outage",
 910        )):
 911            return ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE
 912        return ProviderFailureClass.ENGINEERING_FAILURE
 913
 914    def record_result(
 915        self,
 916        agent_id: str,
 917        result: AgentExecutionResult,
 918        task_id: Optional[str] = None,
 919        role: Optional[str] = None,
 920    ) -> ProviderFailureClass:
 921        """Updates shared state only when the observed result warrants it."""
 922        resource_id = self._normalize(agent_id)
 923        state = self._provider_states.get(resource_id)
 924        if state is None:
 925            raise KeyError(f"Unknown resource '{resource_id}'.")
 926        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
 927        profile = self.registry.get_resource(resource_id)
 928        if (
 929            profile is not None
 930            and profile.economic_class == EconomicClass.METERED_API.value
 931        ):
 932            state.metered_invocation_count += 1
 933            self._persist()
 934        if result.success:
 935            state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE
 936            state.normalized_failure_class = None
 937            state.unavailable_reason = None
 938            state.exhaustion_event = None
 939            state.success_count += 1
 940            state.total_duration_seconds += result.duration_seconds
 941            state.last_success_at = now.isoformat()
 942            state.last_checked = now.isoformat()
 943            state.observed_at = now.isoformat()
 944            state.retry_after = None
 945            if role and role in state.role_exclusions:
 946                state.role_exclusions.pop(role, None)
 947            self._persist()
 948            return ProviderFailureClass.UNKNOWN
 949
 950        failure_class = self.classify_failure(resource_id, result)
 951        metadata = result.metadata or {}
 952
 953        state.consecutive_failures += 1
 954        state.last_failure_at = now.isoformat()
 955        state.last_checked = now.isoformat()
 956        state.observed_at = now.isoformat()
 957        state.normalized_failure_class = failure_class.value
 958        state.unavailable_reason = failure_class.value
 959
 960        if failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED:
 961            target_role = role or "unknown"
 962            state.role_exclusions[target_role] = failure_class.value
 963            if self._is_review_role(target_role):
 964                state.role_exclusions["review"] = failure_class.value
 965            self._persist()
 966            return failure_class
 967
 968        # EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED previously stayed out of this map to avoid
 969        # penalizing a healthy resource for our own harness deadline. The live
 970        # incident showed repeatedly burning ~10-minute slots on the same provider
 971        # while another was available, so a bounded DEGRADED cooldown is recorded
 972        # instead. DEGRADED still leaves the provider eligible, just deprioritized,
 973        # and expires after the normal transient cooldown.
 974        availability_map = {
 975            ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DEGRADED,
 976            ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
 977            ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.SESSION_EXHAUSTED,
 978            ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RATE_LIMITED,
 979            ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
 980            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
 981            ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNREACHABLE,
 982            ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
 983            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
 984        }
 985        if failure_class in availability_map:
 986            state.status = availability_map[failure_class]
 987            # Every capacity condition expires. QUOTA_EXHAUSTED was absent from
 988            # this set, so a quota event had no `retry_after` at all and the
 989            # resource stayed unavailable until someone called reset_resource --
 990            # a single historical quota event permanently removing a provider
 991            # from the pool. It now expires on its own, longer clock: a quota is
 992            # billed over a day or a week, so re-probing it on the transient
 993            # cooldown would spend attempts proving what is already known
 994            # (issues.md #15).
 995            transient = {
 996                ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED,
 997                ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE,
 998                ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
 999                ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED,
1000            }
1001            cooldown = None
1002            if failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT:
1003                cooldown = getattr(
1004                    self.policy, "session_cooldown_seconds", None
1005                ) or 14400
1006            elif failure_class in transient:
1007                cooldown = self.policy.cooldown_seconds
1008            elif failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED:
1009                cooldown = getattr(
1010                    self.policy, "quota_cooldown_seconds", None
1011                ) or self.policy.cooldown_seconds
1012            explicit_retry_seconds = metadata.get(PROVIDER_RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS_KEY)
1013            if isinstance(explicit_retry_seconds, int) and explicit_retry_seconds >= 0:
1014                state.retry_after = (now + timedelta(seconds=explicit_retry_seconds)).isoformat()
1015            elif cooldown:
1016                state.retry_after = (now + timedelta(seconds=cooldown)).isoformat()
1017            state.exhaustion_event = ProviderExhaustionEvent(
1018                agent_id=resource_id,
1019                failure_type={
1020                    ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT: "session_limit",
1021                    ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED: "rate_limit",
1022                    ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: "quota_exhausted",
1023                    ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: "authentication_required",
1024                    ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED: "stalled",
1025                }.get(failure_class, "unavailable"),
1026                raw_error=(result.stderr or result.error_message or failure_class.value).strip(),
1027                task_id=task_id,
1028            )
1029            self._persist()
1030        return failure_class
1031
1032    def detect_exhaustion(
1033        self,
1034        agent_id: str,
1035        result: AgentExecutionResult,
1036        task_id: Optional[str] = None,
1037        role: Optional[str] = None,
1038    ) -> Optional[ProviderExhaustionEvent]:
1039        """Compatibility wrapper returning events only for availability failures."""
1040        resource_id = self._normalize(agent_id)
1041        if resource_id in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS:
1042            reason = (result.error_message or "").upper()
1043            if reason == "RESOURCE_CONSTRAINED":
1044                event = ProviderExhaustionEvent(
1045                    agent_id=resource_id,
1046                    failure_type="unavailable",
1047                    raw_error=result.stderr or reason,
1048                    task_id=task_id,
1049                )
1050                self.set_status(
1051                    resource_id,
1052                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RESOURCE_CONSTRAINED,
1053                    event,
1054                )
1055                return event
1056        failure_class = self.record_result(agent_id, result, task_id=task_id, role=role)
1057        availability_classes = {
1058            ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
1059            ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT,
1060            ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED,
1061            ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED,
1062            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
1063            ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE,
1064            ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
1065        }
1066        if failure_class not in availability_classes:
1067            return None
1068        return self._provider_states[self._normalize(agent_id)].exhaustion_event
1069
1070    def reset_resource(self, resource_id: str, *, reprobe: bool = True) -> ProviderStatus:
1071        """Clears only current availability state for one configured resource."""
1072        normalized = self._normalize(resource_id)
1073        profile = self.registry.get_resource(normalized)
1074        config = self.resources.get(normalized)
1075        if profile is None or config is None:
1076            raise ProviderConfigurationError(f"Resource '{resource_id}' is not configured.")
1077        if not config.enabled:
1078            raise ProviderConfigurationError(f"Resource '{resource_id}' is operator disabled.")
1079        state = self._provider_states[normalized]
1080        state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN
1081        state.normalized_failure_class = None
1082        state.exhaustion_event = None
1083        state.retry_after = None
1084        state.reset_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
1085        state.unavailable_reason = None
1086        state.role_exclusions.clear()
1087        if reprobe and not self._egress_forbidden(profile):
1088            self._apply_readiness(normalized, profile, state)
1089        self._persist()
1090        return state
1091
1092    def reset_transient_exhaustion(self) -> None:
1093        """Compatibility reset using bounded non-generative readiness probes."""
1094        for resource_id, resource_config in self.resources.items():
1095            if resource_config.enabled:
1096                profile = self.registry.get_resource(resource_id)
1097                if profile and not self._egress_forbidden(profile):
1098                    self.reset_resource(resource_id, reprobe=True)
1099
1100    def _task_forbids_egress(self, task: TaskSpec) -> bool:
1101        if task.metadata.get("allow_egress") is False:
1102            return True
1103        combined = " ".join(task.constraints).lower()
1104        return "no egress" in combined or "zero external" in combined
1105
1106    def _required_capabilities(self, task: TaskSpec, role: str) -> List[str]:
1107        required = set(task.metadata.get("required_resource_capabilities", []))
1108        if role in ("implementation", "remediation"):
1109            required.update({"file_editing", "repository_access"})
1110        elif self._is_review_role(role):
1111            required.add("code_review")
1112        else:
1113            required.add("code_generation")
1114        if "terminal_execution" in task.allowed_tools:
1115            required.add("command_execution")
1116        return sorted(required)
1117
1118    @staticmethod
1119    def _is_review_role(role: str) -> bool:
1120        return (
1121            role == "review"
1122            or role.endswith("-reviewer")
1123            or role == "test-falsifier"
1124        )
1125
1126    @staticmethod
1127    def _has_capability(profile: AgentProfile, capability: str) -> bool:
1128        facts = {
1129            "repository_access": profile.supports_repository_access,
1130            "command_execution": profile.supports_command_execution,
1131            "structured_output": profile.supports_structured_output,
1132            "tool_calling": profile.supports_tool_calling,
1133        }
1134        return facts.get(capability, capability in profile.capabilities)
1135
1136    @staticmethod
1137    def _capacity_exclusion(status: ProviderAvailabilityStatus) -> Optional[str]:
1138        blocked = {
1139            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RATE_LIMITED,
1140            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.SESSION_EXHAUSTED,
1141            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
1142            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
1143            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
1144            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNREACHABLE,
1145            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
1146            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RESOURCE_CONSTRAINED,
1147        }
1148        return status.value if status in blocked else None
1149
1150    def check_capacity_exclusion(
1151        self,
1152        resource_id: str,
1153        role: Optional[str] = None,
1154    ) -> Optional[str]:
1155        """Returns the capacity block or role exclusion reason for a resource, if any."""
1156        normalized = self._normalize(resource_id)
1157        state = self._provider_states.get(normalized)
1158        if state is None:
1159            return "UNKNOWN_RESOURCE"
1160        general = self._capacity_exclusion(state.status)
1161        if general:
1162            return general
1163        if role:
1164            if role in state.role_exclusions:
1165                return f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions[role]}"
1166            if self._is_review_role(role) and "review" in state.role_exclusions:
1167                return f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions['review']}"
1168        return None
1169
1170    def _recover_capacity_if_due(
1171        self,
1172        resource_id: str,
1173        profile: AgentProfile,
1174        state: ProviderStatus,
1175    ) -> None:
1176        """Performs at most one safe re-probe after an observed cooldown."""
1177        if not state.retry_after:
1178            return
1179        try:
1180            due = datetime.fromisoformat(state.retry_after)
1181        except ValueError:
1182            return
1183        if datetime.now(timezone.utc) < due:
1184            return
1185        state.retry_after = None
1186        state.exhaustion_event = None
1187        state.normalized_failure_class = None
1188        state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN
1189        if self.read_only:
1190            state.readiness = ReadinessStatus.NOT_PROBED
1191            return
1192        self._apply_readiness(resource_id, profile, state)
1193        self._persist()
1194
1195    def _recommend(
1196        self,
1197        task: TaskSpec,
1198        role: str,
1199        candidates: List[AgentProfile],
1200    ) -> CognitiveRecommendation:
1201        from howlplane.control_plane.router import TaskRouter
1202
1203        preferences = [
1204            self._normalize(item)
1205            for item in self.policy.preferred_external + self.policy.preferred_local
1206        ]
1207        return TaskRouter(self.registry).recommend_resource(
1208            task,
1209            candidates,
1210            role=role,
1211            operator_preferences=preferences,
1212        )
1213
1214    def _ranking_key(
1215        self,
1216        profile: AgentProfile,
1217        recommendation: CognitiveRecommendation,
1218        avoid_resource_id: Optional[str],
1219    ) -> Tuple[int, int, int, int, str]:
1220        economic = EconomicClass(profile.economic_class or EconomicClass.UNKNOWN)
1221        if self.policy.subscription_first:
1222            economic_rank = {
1223                EconomicClass.SUBSCRIPTION: 0,
1224                EconomicClass.LOCAL: 1,
1225                EconomicClass.UNKNOWN: 2,
1226                EconomicClass.METERED_API: 3,
1227            }[economic]
1228        elif self.policy.external_before_local:
1229            economic_rank = 1 if economic == EconomicClass.LOCAL else 0
1230        else:
1231            economic_rank = 0
1232        state = self._provider_states[profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id]
1233        capacity_rank = {
1234            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE: 0,
1235            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DEGRADED: 1,
1236            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN: 2,
1237        }.get(state.status, 3)
1238        cognitive_rank = 0 if profile.resource_id == recommendation.resource_id else 1
1239        avoid_rank = 1 if profile.resource_id == avoid_resource_id else 0
1240        return (
1241            economic_rank,
1242            capacity_rank if self.policy.prefer_existing_capacity else 0,
1243            cognitive_rank,
1244            avoid_rank,
1245            profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id,
1246        )
1247
1248    def select_resource(
1249        self,
1250        task: TaskSpec,
1251        *,
1252        role: str,
1253        explicit_resource_id: Optional[str] = None,
1254        avoid_resource_id: Optional[str] = None,
1255        exclude_resource_ids: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None,
1256    ) -> ResourceSelectionDecision:
1257        """Applies hard filtering, economics, recommendation, and stable tie break.
1258
1259        ``avoid_resource_id`` is a soft preference that only demotes a resource in
1260        the ranking. ``exclude_resource_ids`` is a hard prohibition, used by
1261        bounded failover so a resource whose cooldown elapsed mid-attempt cannot
1262        be re-offered and dead-end the loop.
1263        """
1264        required = self._required_capabilities(task, role)
1265        excluded_ids = {
1266            self._normalize(item) for item in (exclude_resource_ids or []) if item
1267        }
1268        registered = [
1269            self._resource_identity(profile) for profile in self.registry.list_resources()
1270        ]
1271        exclusions: List[ResourceExclusion] = []
1272        candidates: List[AgentProfile] = []
1273        task_forbids_egress = self._task_forbids_egress(task)
1274
1275        def exclude(profile: AgentProfile, reason: str, stage: str, detail=None):
1276            exclusions.append(ResourceExclusion(
1277                resource_id=profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id,
1278                reason=reason,
1279                stage=stage,
1280                detail=detail,
1281            ))
1282
1283        for profile in self.registry.list_resources():
1284            resource_id = profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id
1285            resource_config = self.resources.get(resource_id)
1286            state = self._provider_states[resource_id]
1287            if resource_config is None:
1288                exclude(profile, "NOT_CONFIGURED", "operator_permission")
1289                continue
1290            if not resource_config.enabled:
1291                exclude(profile, "OPERATOR_DISABLED", "operator_permission")
1292                continue
1293            if self._egress_forbidden(profile):
1294                exclude(profile, "EGRESS_FORBIDDEN", "egress_policy")
1295                continue
1296            if task_forbids_egress and profile.locality != ResourceLocality.LOCAL.value:
1297                exclude(profile, "TASK_EGRESS_FORBIDDEN", "egress_policy")
1298                continue
1299            self._recover_capacity_if_due(resource_id, profile, state)
1300            if state.readiness in {
1301                ReadinessStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
1302                ReadinessStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
1303                ReadinessStatus.UNREACHABLE,
1304                ReadinessStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
1305            }:
1306                exclude(profile, state.readiness.value, "runtime_readiness")
1307                continue
1308            if role not in profile.roles and not (
1309                self._is_review_role(role) and "review" in profile.roles
1310            ):
1311                exclude(profile, "ROLE_NOT_SUPPORTED", "capability")
1312                continue
1313            missing = [cap for cap in required if not self._has_capability(profile, cap)]
1314            if missing:
1315                exclude(
1316                    profile,
1317                    "MISSING_REQUIRED_CAPABILITY",
1318                    "capability",
1319                    ",".join(missing),
1320                )
1321                continue
1322            if role in LOCAL_INELIGIBLE_REVIEWER_ROLES and profile.locality == ResourceLocality.LOCAL.value:
1323                exclude(profile, "LOCAL_REVIEW_AUTHORITY_FORBIDDEN", "authority")
1324                continue
1325            capacity_reason = self._capacity_exclusion(state.status)
1326            if capacity_reason:
1327                exclude(profile, capacity_reason, "capacity")
1328                continue
1329            if role in state.role_exclusions:
1330                exclude(profile, f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions[role]}", "capacity")
1331                continue
1332            if self._is_review_role(role) and "review" in state.role_exclusions:
1333                exclude(profile, f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions['review']}", "capacity")
1334                continue
1335            if resource_id in excluded_ids:
1336                exclude(profile, "ALREADY_ATTEMPTED", "failover_policy")
1337                continue
1338            economics = EconomicClass(profile.economic_class or EconomicClass.UNKNOWN)
1339            if economics == EconomicClass.METERED_API and not self.policy.allow_paid_api:
1340                exclude(profile, "PAID_API_FORBIDDEN", "economic_policy")
1341                continue
1342            if (
1343                economics == EconomicClass.METERED_API
1344                and self.policy.max_metered_invocations is not None
1345                and state.metered_invocation_count
1346                >= self.policy.max_metered_invocations
1347            ):
1348                exclude(profile, "METERED_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED", "economic_policy")
1349                continue
1350            candidates.append(profile)
1351
1352        recommendation = self._recommend(task, role, candidates)
1353        avoid_id = self._normalize(avoid_resource_id) if avoid_resource_id else None
1354        candidates.sort(key=lambda profile: self._ranking_key(profile, recommendation, avoid_id))
1355        supplied_explicit = explicit_resource_id or task.preferred_agent
1356        explicit_id = self._normalize(supplied_explicit) if supplied_explicit else None
1357        selected: Optional[AgentProfile] = None
1358        if explicit_id:
1359            selected = next(
1360                (profile for profile in candidates if profile.resource_id == explicit_id),
1361                None,
1362            )
1363            if selected is None:
1364                candidates = []
1365        elif candidates:
1366            selected = candidates[0]
1367
1368        status = (
1369            ResourceSelectionStatus.SELECTED
1370            if selected is not None
1371            else ResourceSelectionStatus.BLOCKED
1372        )
1373        identities = [self._resource_identity(profile) for profile in candidates]
1374        selected_identity = self._resource_identity(selected) if selected else None
1375        if selected_identity is not None:
1376            identities = [selected_identity] + [
1377                identity for identity in identities
1378                if identity.resource_id != selected_identity.resource_id
1379            ]
1380        return ResourceSelectionDecision(
1381            task_class=task.task_class,
1382            role=role,
1383            required_capabilities=required,
1384            status=status,
1385            registered_resources=registered,
1386            eligible_resources=identities,
1387            exclusions=exclusions,
1388            selected=selected_identity,
1389            selection_policy=self.policy.strategy,
1390            economic_policy=self.policy.model_dump(),
1391            cognitive_recommendation=recommendation,
1392            capacity_before=self.get_all_statuses(),
1393            explicit_override=explicit_id is not None,
1394            blocked_reason=(
1395                None if selected is not None else "NO_ELIGIBLE_AI_RESOURCE"
1396            ),
1397        )
1398
1399    def select_candidates(
1400        self,
1401        task_category: str = "code_heavy",
1402        avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None,
1403        preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None,
1404        task: Optional[TaskSpec] = None,
1405        role: str = "implementation",
1406    ) -> List[str]:
1407        """Compatibility API returning the new pipeline's ordered candidates.
1408
1409        `role` is the role the candidates are actually for. It used to be
1410        hardcoded to "implementation", so reviewer failover picked its fallback
1411        pool using implementation capability requirements rather than the review
1412        role's -- the wrong question for the candidate it was choosing.
1413        """
1414        if task is None or self._legacy_mode:
1415            preference = TASK_SUITABILITY_PREFERENCES.get(
1416                task_category,
1417                TASK_SUITABILITY_PREFERENCES["code_heavy"],
1418            )
1419            result = []
1420            for agent_id in preference:
1421                normalized = self._normalize(agent_id)
1422                if (
1423                    task is not None
1424                    and normalized in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS
1425                    and not is_task_local_eligible(task)
1426                ):
1427                    continue
1428                if self.get_status(normalized) in {
1429                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE,
1430                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN,
1431                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DEGRADED,
1432                }:
1433                    result.append(normalized)
1434            if preferred_agent:
1435                preferred = self._normalize(preferred_agent)
1436                if preferred in result:
1437                    result.remove(preferred)
1438                    result.insert(0, preferred)
1439            if avoid_provider:
1440                avoided = self._normalize(avoid_provider)
1441                if avoided in result:
1442                    result.remove(avoided)
1443                    result.append(avoided)
1444            return list(dict.fromkeys(result))
1445        decision = self.select_resource(
1446            task,
1447            role=role,
1448            explicit_resource_id=preferred_agent,
1449            avoid_resource_id=avoid_provider,
1450        )
1451        return [identity.resource_id for identity in decision.eligible_resources]
1452
1453    def select_reviewers(
1454        self,
1455        implementing_agent_id: str,
1456        required_roles: List[str],
1457        allow_same_provider: bool = False,
1458        task: Optional[TaskSpec] = None,
1459    ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], bool]:
1460        """Selects role-capable reviewers and reports identity diversity honestly."""
1461        implementation_id = self._normalize(implementing_agent_id)
1462        if self._legacy_mode:
1463            available = [
1464                profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id
1465                for profile in self.registry.list_resources()
1466                if self.get_status(profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id)
1467                == ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE
1468            ]
1469            distinct = [item for item in available if item != implementation_id]
1470            mapping: Dict[str, str] = {}
1471            diversity = True
1472            for index, role in enumerate(required_roles):
1473                role_candidates = distinct
1474                if role in LOCAL_INELIGIBLE_REVIEWER_ROLES:
1475                    role_candidates = [
1476                        item for item in role_candidates if item not in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS
1477                    ]
1478                if role_candidates:
1479                    mapping[role] = role_candidates[index % len(role_candidates)]
1480                else:
1481                    mapping[role] = implementation_id
1482                    diversity = False
1483            return mapping, diversity
1484        implementation = self.registry.get_resource(implementation_id)
1485        review_task = task or TaskSpec(
1486            task_id="REVIEW-SELECTION",
1487            repository="unknown",
1488            objective="Review an implementation diff",
1489            task_class="other",
1490            risk_level="medium",
1491        )
1492        mapping: Dict[str, str] = {}
1493        diversity = True
1494        used: Set[str] = set()
1495        for role in required_roles:
1496            decision = self.select_resource(
1497                review_task,
1498                role=role,
1499                avoid_resource_id=implementation_id,
1500            )
1501            eligible = [
1502                self.registry.get_resource(identity.resource_id)
1503                for identity in decision.eligible_resources
1504            ]
1505            eligible = [profile for profile in eligible if profile is not None]
1506            distinct = [
1507                profile for profile in eligible
1508                if profile.resource_id != implementation_id
1509                and implementation is not None
1510                and profile.provider_id != implementation.provider_id
1511            ]
1512            choices = distinct or [
1513                profile for profile in eligible if profile.resource_id != implementation_id
1514            ]
1515            if choices:
1516                unused = [profile for profile in choices if profile.resource_id not in used]
1517                chosen = (unused or choices)[0]
1518                mapping[role] = chosen.resource_id or chosen.agent_id
1519                used.add(chosen.resource_id or chosen.agent_id)
1520                if chosen not in distinct:
1521                    diversity = False
1522            elif implementation is not None:
1523                mapping[role] = implementation_id
1524                diversity = False
1525            elif allow_same_provider and decision.selected:
1526                mapping[role] = decision.selected.resource_id
1527                diversity = False
1528        return mapping, diversity

Single owner for resource readiness, capacity, and final selection.

424    def __init__(
425        self,

@classmethod
def from_settings( cls, settings: Any, *, registry: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.agent_registry.AgentRegistry] = None, state_path: Union[str, pathlib.Path, NoneType] = None, read_only: bool = False, probe_on_start: bool = True) -> howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool.ProviderPoolManager: 
457    @classmethod
458    def from_settings(
459        cls,
460        settings: Any,
461        *,
462        registry: Optional[AgentRegistry] = None,
463        state_path: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
464        read_only: bool = False,
465        probe_on_start: bool = True,
466    ) -> "ProviderPoolManager":
467        """Builds the production pool with deterministic legacy migration."""
468        actual_registry = registry or AgentRegistry()
469        configured = dict(settings.providers)
470        if not configured:
471            if settings.operating_mode == "local_only":
472                configured = {"local_ollama": ProviderResourceSettings(enabled=True)}
473            else:
474                configured = {
475                    profile.resource_id: ProviderResourceSettings(enabled=True)
476                    for profile in actual_registry.list_resources()
477                }
478        return cls(
479            registry=actual_registry,
480            resources=configured,
481            policy=settings.provider_policy,
482            operating_mode=settings.operating_mode,
483            state_path=state_path,
484            read_only=read_only,
485            probe_on_start=probe_on_start,
486        )

def get_status( self, agent_id: str) -> howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool.ProviderAvailabilityStatus: 
673    def get_status(self, agent_id: str) -> ProviderAvailabilityStatus:
674        resource_id = self._normalize(agent_id)
675        state = self._provider_states.get(resource_id)
676        return state.status if state else ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN
def get_resource_status( self, resource_id: str) -> Optional[howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool.ProviderStatus]: 
678    def get_resource_status(self, resource_id: str) -> Optional[ProviderStatus]:
679        return self._provider_states.get(self._normalize(resource_id))
def set_status( self, agent_id: str, status: howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool.ProviderAvailabilityStatus, event: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool.ProviderExhaustionEvent] = None) -> None: 
681    def set_status(
682        self,
683        agent_id: str,
684        status: ProviderAvailabilityStatus,
685        event: Optional[ProviderExhaustionEvent] = None,
686    ) -> None:
687        resource_id = self._normalize(agent_id)
688        state = self._provider_states.get(resource_id)
689        if state is None:
690            profile = self.registry.get_resource(resource_id)
691            state = self._new_status(profile) if profile else ProviderStatus(
692                agent_id=resource_id,
693                name=resource_id,
694                resource_id=resource_id,
695            )
696            self._provider_states[resource_id] = state
697        state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus(status)
698        if state.status == ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE:
699            state.readiness = ReadinessStatus.READY
700            state.unavailable_reason = None
701        state.last_checked = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
702        state.observed_at = state.last_checked
703        if event:
704            state.exhaustion_event = event
705        self._persist()
def get_all_statuses(self) -> Dict[str, str]: 
707    def get_all_statuses(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
708        return {
709            resource_id: state.status.value
710            for resource_id, state in sorted(self._provider_states.items())
711        }
def inventory(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:

731                "capability_reason": state.capability_reason,
732                "capacity": state.status.value,
733                "reason": state.unavailable_reason,
734                "observed_at": state.observed_at,
735                "last_success_at": state.last_success_at,
736                "last_failure_at": state.last_failure_at,
737                "metered_invocation_count": state.metered_invocation_count,
738                "retry_after": state.retry_after,
739                "reset_at": state.reset_at,

def is_all_cloud_exhausted(self) -> bool: 
751    def is_all_cloud_exhausted(self) -> bool:
752        cloud = []
753        for profile in self.registry.list_resources():
754            if profile.locality == ResourceLocality.LOCAL.value:
755                continue
756            state = self._provider_states.get(profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id)
757            if state and state.status != ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DISABLED:
758                cloud.append(state.status)
759        unavailable = {
760            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.SESSION_EXHAUSTED,
761            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
762            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RATE_LIMITED,
763            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
764            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
765            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNREACHABLE,
766            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
767        }
768        return not cloud or all(status in unavailable for status in cloud)
def is_all_exhausted(self) -> bool: 
770    def is_all_exhausted(self) -> bool:
771        active = [
772            state.status
773            for state in self._provider_states.values()
774            if state.status != ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DISABLED
775        ]
776        exhausted = {
777            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.SESSION_EXHAUSTED,
778            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
779            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RATE_LIMITED,
780        }
781        return bool(active) and all(status in exhausted for status in active)

@staticmethod
def classify_result( agent_id: str, result: howlplane.control_plane.agent_execution.AgentExecutionResult) -> howlplane.control_plane.resource_models.ProviderFailureClass: 
791    @staticmethod
792    def classify_result(
793        agent_id: str,
794        result: AgentExecutionResult,
795    ) -> ProviderFailureClass:
796        """Normalizes availability separately from engineering results."""
797        if result.success:
798            return ProviderFailureClass.UNKNOWN
799        resource_id = AgentBackendRegistry.normalize_agent_id(agent_id)
800        combined = "\n".join(
801            [result.error_message or "", result.stderr or "", result.stdout or ""]
802        ).lower()
803        # Structural execution evidence outranks transcript text. A long agent
804        # transcript is arbitrary third-party content that routinely contains the
805        # very phrases these markers look for, so where the harness observed the
806        # process directly, that observation wins (SLOPFIX-03).
807        metadata = result.metadata or {}
808        if metadata.get(WATCHDOG_TERMINATION_KEY) == WATCHDOG_TERMINATION_STALL:
809            return ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED
810        launch_outcome = metadata.get(LAUNCH_OUTCOME_KEY)
811        if launch_outcome in (LAUNCH_OUTCOME_NOT_INSTALLED, LAUNCH_OUTCOME_SPAWN_FAILED):
812            return ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE
813        # A harness-sourced or budget-derived timeout is this process stopping
814        # the provider at our own budget (either directly via harness kill or
815        # via a harness-derived print timeout). Nothing was observed about
816        # reachability, so it is an execution budget result, not a transport
817        # failure. Transcript-sourced timeouts without budget derivation still
818        # fall through to the transport branch below, where a provider genuinely
819        # reporting that it could not reach its service is classified as
820        # TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE and benched (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05).
821        if (
822            metadata.get(TIMEOUT_SOURCE_KEY) in (TIMEOUT_SOURCE_HARNESS, TIMEOUT_SOURCE_BUDGET)
823            or metadata.get(BUDGET_DERIVED_KEY) is True
824        ):
825            return ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
826        if launch_outcome != LAUNCH_OUTCOME_LAUNCHED and result.exit_code == 127:
827            return ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE
828
829        # A provider's exact terminal error is stronger than evidence collected
830        # earlier in its session. In particular, a hard capacity stop must not
831        # be hidden by an earlier denied tool. However, arbitrary trailing prose
832        # in stdout must NEVER override a structured denial: only authenticated
833        # structured metadata or explicit non-zero exit stderr can outrank it.
834        if metadata.get(TOOL_PERMISSION_KEY) == TOOL_PERMISSION_DENIED:
835            structured_terminal = _classify_structured_terminal_hard_failure(result)
836            if structured_terminal is not None:
837                return structured_terminal
838            return ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED
839
840        # A machine-readable error envelope is the strongest signal a provider
841        # can give about why it stopped, and it does not depend on where the
842        # message happens to sit in the output. Devin's quota error is a
843        # multi-line JSON blob whose last non-empty line is "}", so the
844        # anchored line matching below cannot see it at all, whatever patterns
845        # are added (issues.md #15).
846        envelope_failure = _classify_structured_error_envelope(result)
847        if envelope_failure is not None:
848            return envelope_failure
849
850        terminal_hard_failure = _classify_terminal_hard_failure(result)
851        if terminal_hard_failure is not None:
852            return terminal_hard_failure
853
854        # A provider that demonstrably started cannot be a missing executable,
855        # whatever its session log says about commands that were not found.
856        # Backends that stamp no markers keep the older text-based behavior, with
857        # one correction: a timeout verdict is the more specific signal and so
858        # outranks the substring scan. Exit 127 remains a legacy launch verdict
859        # only when no structural launched marker contradicts it.
860        if launch_outcome != LAUNCH_OUTCOME_LAUNCHED and (
861            not result.timed_out and any(marker in combined for marker in (
862                "command not found", "binary not found", "not installed",
863            ))
864        ):
865            return ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE
866        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
867            "requires approval", "require approval", "permission denied",
868            "requires permission", "execution permission required", "execution_permission_required",
869            "needs approval", "approve bash execution",
870            "workspace trust required", "trust the current workspace", "pass --trust",
871        )):
872            return ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED
873        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
874            "authentication required", "not authenticated", "login required",
875            "unauthorized", "invalid api key",
876        )):
877            return ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
878        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
879            "429 too many requests", "rate_limit", "rate limit", "rate limited",
880        )):
881            return ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED
882        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
883            "quota exhausted", "quota exceeded", "insufficient_quota",
884            "credits exhausted", "insufficient funds", "resource exhausted",
885        )):
886            return ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
887        session_patterns = EXHAUSTION_PATTERNS.get(resource_id, []) + [
888            "usage limit",
889            "session limit",
890            "individual quota reached",
891            "quota reached",
892            "upgrade your subscription",
893            "out of capacity",
894        ]
895        if any(marker in combined for marker in session_patterns):
896            return ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT
897        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
898            "malformed", "invalid json", "invalid yaml", "parse error",
899        )):
900            return ProviderFailureClass.MALFORMED_OUTPUT
901        if result.timed_out or any(marker in combined for marker in (
902            "connection refused", "transport unavailable", "network unreachable",
903            "timed out", "timeout waiting for response", "request timed out",
904            "connection timed out", "gateway timeout", "read timeout",
905            "operation timed out", "deadline exceeded", "timeout after",
906        )):
907            return ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE
908        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
909            "provider unavailable", "service unavailable", "overloaded_error", "outage",
910        )):
911            return ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE
912        return ProviderFailureClass.ENGINEERING_FAILURE

Normalizes availability separately from engineering results.

def record_result( self, agent_id: str, result: howlplane.control_plane.agent_execution.AgentExecutionResult, task_id: Optional[str] = None, role: Optional[str] = None) -> howlplane.control_plane.resource_models.ProviderFailureClass: 
 914    def record_result(
 915        self,
 916        agent_id: str,
 917        result: AgentExecutionResult,
 918        task_id: Optional[str] = None,
 919        role: Optional[str] = None,
 920    ) -> ProviderFailureClass:
 921        """Updates shared state only when the observed result warrants it."""
 922        resource_id = self._normalize(agent_id)
 923        state = self._provider_states.get(resource_id)
 924        if state is None:
 925            raise KeyError(f"Unknown resource '{resource_id}'.")
 926        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
 927        profile = self.registry.get_resource(resource_id)
 928        if (
 929            profile is not None
 930            and profile.economic_class == EconomicClass.METERED_API.value
 931        ):
 932            state.metered_invocation_count += 1
 933            self._persist()
 934        if result.success:
 935            state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE
 936            state.normalized_failure_class = None
 937            state.unavailable_reason = None
 938            state.exhaustion_event = None
 939            state.success_count += 1
 940            state.total_duration_seconds += result.duration_seconds
 941            state.last_success_at = now.isoformat()
 942            state.last_checked = now.isoformat()
 943            state.observed_at = now.isoformat()
 944            state.retry_after = None
 945            if role and role in state.role_exclusions:
 946                state.role_exclusions.pop(role, None)
 947            self._persist()
 948            return ProviderFailureClass.UNKNOWN
 949
 950        failure_class = self.classify_failure(resource_id, result)
 951        metadata = result.metadata or {}
 952
 953        state.consecutive_failures += 1
 954        state.last_failure_at = now.isoformat()
 955        state.last_checked = now.isoformat()
 956        state.observed_at = now.isoformat()
 957        state.normalized_failure_class = failure_class.value
 958        state.unavailable_reason = failure_class.value
 959
 960        if failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED:
 961            target_role = role or "unknown"
 962            state.role_exclusions[target_role] = failure_class.value
 963            if self._is_review_role(target_role):
 964                state.role_exclusions["review"] = failure_class.value
 965            self._persist()
 966            return failure_class
 967
 968        # EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED previously stayed out of this map to avoid
 969        # penalizing a healthy resource for our own harness deadline. The live
 970        # incident showed repeatedly burning ~10-minute slots on the same provider
 971        # while another was available, so a bounded DEGRADED cooldown is recorded
 972        # instead. DEGRADED still leaves the provider eligible, just deprioritized,
 973        # and expires after the normal transient cooldown.
 974        availability_map = {
 975            ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DEGRADED,
 976            ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
 977            ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.SESSION_EXHAUSTED,
 978            ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RATE_LIMITED,
 979            ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
 980            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
 981            ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNREACHABLE,
 982            ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
 983            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
 984        }
 985        if failure_class in availability_map:
 986            state.status = availability_map[failure_class]
 987            # Every capacity condition expires. QUOTA_EXHAUSTED was absent from
 988            # this set, so a quota event had no `retry_after` at all and the
 989            # resource stayed unavailable until someone called reset_resource --
 990            # a single historical quota event permanently removing a provider
 991            # from the pool. It now expires on its own, longer clock: a quota is
 992            # billed over a day or a week, so re-probing it on the transient
 993            # cooldown would spend attempts proving what is already known
 994            # (issues.md #15).
 995            transient = {
 996                ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED,
 997                ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE,
 998                ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
 999                ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED,
1000            }
1001            cooldown = None
1002            if failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT:
1003                cooldown = getattr(
1004                    self.policy, "session_cooldown_seconds", None
1005                ) or 14400
1006            elif failure_class in transient:
1007                cooldown = self.policy.cooldown_seconds
1008            elif failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED:
1009                cooldown = getattr(
1010                    self.policy, "quota_cooldown_seconds", None
1011                ) or self.policy.cooldown_seconds
1012            explicit_retry_seconds = metadata.get(PROVIDER_RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS_KEY)
1013            if isinstance(explicit_retry_seconds, int) and explicit_retry_seconds >= 0:
1014                state.retry_after = (now + timedelta(seconds=explicit_retry_seconds)).isoformat()
1015            elif cooldown:
1016                state.retry_after = (now + timedelta(seconds=cooldown)).isoformat()
1017            state.exhaustion_event = ProviderExhaustionEvent(
1018                agent_id=resource_id,
1019                failure_type={
1020                    ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT: "session_limit",
1021                    ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED: "rate_limit",
1022                    ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: "quota_exhausted",
1023                    ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: "authentication_required",
1024                    ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED: "stalled",
1025                }.get(failure_class, "unavailable"),
1026                raw_error=(result.stderr or result.error_message or failure_class.value).strip(),
1027                task_id=task_id,
1028            )
1029            self._persist()
1030        return failure_class

Updates shared state only when the observed result warrants it.

def detect_exhaustion( self, agent_id: str, result: howlplane.control_plane.agent_execution.AgentExecutionResult, task_id: Optional[str] = None, role: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool.ProviderExhaustionEvent]: 
1032    def detect_exhaustion(
1033        self,
1034        agent_id: str,
1035        result: AgentExecutionResult,
1036        task_id: Optional[str] = None,
1037        role: Optional[str] = None,
1038    ) -> Optional[ProviderExhaustionEvent]:
1039        """Compatibility wrapper returning events only for availability failures."""
1040        resource_id = self._normalize(agent_id)
1041        if resource_id in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS:
1042            reason = (result.error_message or "").upper()
1043            if reason == "RESOURCE_CONSTRAINED":
1044                event = ProviderExhaustionEvent(
1045                    agent_id=resource_id,
1046                    failure_type="unavailable",
1047                    raw_error=result.stderr or reason,
1048                    task_id=task_id,
1049                )
1050                self.set_status(
1051                    resource_id,
1052                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RESOURCE_CONSTRAINED,
1053                    event,
1054                )
1055                return event
1056        failure_class = self.record_result(agent_id, result, task_id=task_id, role=role)
1057        availability_classes = {
1058            ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
1059            ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT,
1060            ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED,
1061            ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED,
1062            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
1063            ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE,
1064            ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
1065        }
1066        if failure_class not in availability_classes:
1067            return None
1068        return self._provider_states[self._normalize(agent_id)].exhaustion_event

Compatibility wrapper returning events only for availability failures.

def reset_resource( self, resource_id: str, *, reprobe: bool = True) -> howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool.ProviderStatus: 
1070    def reset_resource(self, resource_id: str, *, reprobe: bool = True) -> ProviderStatus:
1071        """Clears only current availability state for one configured resource."""
1072        normalized = self._normalize(resource_id)
1073        profile = self.registry.get_resource(normalized)
1074        config = self.resources.get(normalized)
1075        if profile is None or config is None:
1076            raise ProviderConfigurationError(f"Resource '{resource_id}' is not configured.")
1077        if not config.enabled:
1078            raise ProviderConfigurationError(f"Resource '{resource_id}' is operator disabled.")
1079        state = self._provider_states[normalized]
1080        state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN
1081        state.normalized_failure_class = None
1082        state.exhaustion_event = None
1083        state.retry_after = None
1084        state.reset_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
1085        state.unavailable_reason = None
1086        state.role_exclusions.clear()
1087        if reprobe and not self._egress_forbidden(profile):
1088            self._apply_readiness(normalized, profile, state)
1089        self._persist()
1090        return state

Clears only current availability state for one configured resource.

def reset_transient_exhaustion(self) -> None: 
1092    def reset_transient_exhaustion(self) -> None:
1093        """Compatibility reset using bounded non-generative readiness probes."""
1094        for resource_id, resource_config in self.resources.items():
1095            if resource_config.enabled:
1096                profile = self.registry.get_resource(resource_id)
1097                if profile and not self._egress_forbidden(profile):
1098                    self.reset_resource(resource_id, reprobe=True)
