def check_capacity_exclusion(self, resource_id: str, role: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]: 
1150    def check_capacity_exclusion(
1151        self,
1152        resource_id: str,
1153        role: Optional[str] = None,
1154    ) -> Optional[str]:
1155        """Returns the capacity block or role exclusion reason for a resource, if any."""
1156        normalized = self._normalize(resource_id)
1157        state = self._provider_states.get(normalized)
1158        if state is None:
1159            return "UNKNOWN_RESOURCE"
1160        general = self._capacity_exclusion(state.status)
1161        if general:
1162            return general
1163        if role:
1164            if role in state.role_exclusions:
1165                return f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions[role]}"
1166            if self._is_review_role(role) and "review" in state.role_exclusions:
1167                return f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions['review']}"
1168        return None

def select_resource( self, task: howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.TaskSpec, *, role: str, explicit_resource_id: Optional[str] = None, avoid_resource_id: Optional[str] = None, exclude_resource_ids: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None) -> howlplane.control_plane.resource_models.ResourceSelectionDecision: 
1248    def select_resource(
1249        self,
1250        task: TaskSpec,
1251        *,
1252        role: str,
1253        explicit_resource_id: Optional[str] = None,
1254        avoid_resource_id: Optional[str] = None,
1255        exclude_resource_ids: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None,
1256    ) -> ResourceSelectionDecision:
1257        """Applies hard filtering, economics, recommendation, and stable tie break.
1258
1259        ``avoid_resource_id`` is a soft preference that only demotes a resource in
1260        the ranking. ``exclude_resource_ids`` is a hard prohibition, used by
1261        bounded failover so a resource whose cooldown elapsed mid-attempt cannot
1262        be re-offered and dead-end the loop.
1263        """
1264        required = self._required_capabilities(task, role)
1265        excluded_ids = {
1266            self._normalize(item) for item in (exclude_resource_ids or []) if item
1267        }
1268        registered = [
1269            self._resource_identity(profile) for profile in self.registry.list_resources()
1270        ]
1271        exclusions: List[ResourceExclusion] = []
1272        candidates: List[AgentProfile] = []
1273        task_forbids_egress = self._task_forbids_egress(task)
1274
1275        def exclude(profile: AgentProfile, reason: str, stage: str, detail=None):
1276            exclusions.append(ResourceExclusion(
1277                resource_id=profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id,
1278                reason=reason,
1279                stage=stage,
1280                detail=detail,
1281            ))
1282
1283        for profile in self.registry.list_resources():
1284            resource_id = profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id
1285            resource_config = self.resources.get(resource_id)
1286            state = self._provider_states[resource_id]
1287            if resource_config is None:
1288                exclude(profile, "NOT_CONFIGURED", "operator_permission")
1289                continue
1290            if not resource_config.enabled:
1291                exclude(profile, "OPERATOR_DISABLED", "operator_permission")
1292                continue
1293            if self._egress_forbidden(profile):
1294                exclude(profile, "EGRESS_FORBIDDEN", "egress_policy")
1295                continue
1296            if task_forbids_egress and profile.locality != ResourceLocality.LOCAL.value:
1297                exclude(profile, "TASK_EGRESS_FORBIDDEN", "egress_policy")
1298                continue
1299            self._recover_capacity_if_due(resource_id, profile, state)
1300            if state.readiness in {
1301                ReadinessStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
1302                ReadinessStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
1303                ReadinessStatus.UNREACHABLE,
1304                ReadinessStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
1305            }:
1306                exclude(profile, state.readiness.value, "runtime_readiness")
1307                continue
1308            if role not in profile.roles and not (
1309                self._is_review_role(role) and "review" in profile.roles
1310            ):
1311                exclude(profile, "ROLE_NOT_SUPPORTED", "capability")
1312                continue
1313            missing = [cap for cap in required if not self._has_capability(profile, cap)]
1314            if missing:
1315                exclude(
1316                    profile,
1317                    "MISSING_REQUIRED_CAPABILITY",
1318                    "capability",
1319                    ",".join(missing),
1320                )
1321                continue
1322            if role in LOCAL_INELIGIBLE_REVIEWER_ROLES and profile.locality == ResourceLocality.LOCAL.value:
1323                exclude(profile, "LOCAL_REVIEW_AUTHORITY_FORBIDDEN", "authority")
1324                continue
1325            capacity_reason = self._capacity_exclusion(state.status)
1326            if capacity_reason:
1327                exclude(profile, capacity_reason, "capacity")
1328                continue
1329            if role in state.role_exclusions:
1330                exclude(profile, f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions[role]}", "capacity")
1331                continue
1332            if self._is_review_role(role) and "review" in state.role_exclusions:
1333                exclude(profile, f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions['review']}", "capacity")
1334                continue
1335            if resource_id in excluded_ids:
1336                exclude(profile, "ALREADY_ATTEMPTED", "failover_policy")
1337                continue
1338            economics = EconomicClass(profile.economic_class or EconomicClass.UNKNOWN)
1339            if economics == EconomicClass.METERED_API and not self.policy.allow_paid_api:
1340                exclude(profile, "PAID_API_FORBIDDEN", "economic_policy")
1341                continue
1342            if (
1343                economics == EconomicClass.METERED_API
1344                and self.policy.max_metered_invocations is not None
1345                and state.metered_invocation_count
1346                >= self.policy.max_metered_invocations
1347            ):
1348                exclude(profile, "METERED_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED", "economic_policy")
1349                continue
1350            candidates.append(profile)
1351
1352        recommendation = self._recommend(task, role, candidates)
1353        avoid_id = self._normalize(avoid_resource_id) if avoid_resource_id else None
1354        candidates.sort(key=lambda profile: self._ranking_key(profile, recommendation, avoid_id))
1355        supplied_explicit = explicit_resource_id or task.preferred_agent
1356        explicit_id = self._normalize(supplied_explicit) if supplied_explicit else None
1357        selected: Optional[AgentProfile] = None
1358        if explicit_id:
1359            selected = next(
1360                (profile for profile in candidates if profile.resource_id == explicit_id),
1361                None,
1362            )
1363            if selected is None:
1364                candidates = []
1365        elif candidates:
1366            selected = candidates[0]
1367
1368        status = (
1369            ResourceSelectionStatus.SELECTED
1370            if selected is not None
1371            else ResourceSelectionStatus.BLOCKED
1372        )
1373        identities = [self._resource_identity(profile) for profile in candidates]
1374        selected_identity = self._resource_identity(selected) if selected else None
1375        if selected_identity is not None:
1376            identities = [selected_identity] + [
1377                identity for identity in identities
1378                if identity.resource_id != selected_identity.resource_id
1379            ]
1380        return ResourceSelectionDecision(
1381            task_class=task.task_class,
1382            role=role,
1383            required_capabilities=required,
1384            status=status,
1385            registered_resources=registered,
1386            eligible_resources=identities,
1387            exclusions=exclusions,
1388            selected=selected_identity,
1389            selection_policy=self.policy.strategy,
1390            economic_policy=self.policy.model_dump(),
1391            cognitive_recommendation=recommendation,
1392            capacity_before=self.get_all_statuses(),
1393            explicit_override=explicit_id is not None,
1394            blocked_reason=(
1395                None if selected is not None else "NO_ELIGIBLE_AI_RESOURCE"
1396            ),
1397        )

Applies hard filtering, economics, recommendation, and stable tie break.

avoid_resource_id is a soft preference that only demotes a resource in the ranking. exclude_resource_ids is a hard prohibition, used by bounded failover so a resource whose cooldown elapsed mid-attempt cannot be re-offered and dead-end the loop.

def select_candidates( self, task_category: str = 'code_heavy', avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None, preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None, task: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.TaskSpec] = None, role: str = 'implementation') -> List[str]: 
1399    def select_candidates(
1400        self,
1401        task_category: str = "code_heavy",
1402        avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None,
1403        preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None,
1404        task: Optional[TaskSpec] = None,
1405        role: str = "implementation",
1406    ) -> List[str]:
1407        """Compatibility API returning the new pipeline's ordered candidates.
1408
1409        `role` is the role the candidates are actually for. It used to be
1410        hardcoded to "implementation", so reviewer failover picked its fallback
1411        pool using implementation capability requirements rather than the review
1412        role's -- the wrong question for the candidate it was choosing.
1413        """
1414        if task is None or self._legacy_mode:
1415            preference = TASK_SUITABILITY_PREFERENCES.get(
1416                task_category,
1417                TASK_SUITABILITY_PREFERENCES["code_heavy"],
1418            )
1419            result = []
1420            for agent_id in preference:
1421                normalized = self._normalize(agent_id)
1422                if (
1423                    task is not None
1424                    and normalized in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS
1425                    and not is_task_local_eligible(task)
1426                ):
1427                    continue
1428                if self.get_status(normalized) in {
1429                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE,
1430                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN,
1431                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DEGRADED,
1432                }:
1433                    result.append(normalized)
1434            if preferred_agent:
1435                preferred = self._normalize(preferred_agent)
1436                if preferred in result:
1437                    result.remove(preferred)
1438                    result.insert(0, preferred)
1439            if avoid_provider:
1440                avoided = self._normalize(avoid_provider)
1441                if avoided in result:
1442                    result.remove(avoided)
1443                    result.append(avoided)
1444            return list(dict.fromkeys(result))
1445        decision = self.select_resource(
1446            task,
1447            role=role,
1448            explicit_resource_id=preferred_agent,
1449            avoid_resource_id=avoid_provider,
1450        )
1451        return [identity.resource_id for identity in decision.eligible_resources]

Compatibility API returning the new pipeline's ordered candidates.

role is the role the candidates are actually for. It used to be hardcoded to "implementation", so reviewer failover picked its fallback pool using implementation capability requirements rather than the review role's -- the wrong question for the candidate it was choosing.

def select_reviewers( self, implementing_agent_id: str, required_roles: List[str], allow_same_provider: bool = False, task: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.TaskSpec] = None) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], bool]: 
1453    def select_reviewers(
1454        self,
1455        implementing_agent_id: str,
1456        required_roles: List[str],
1457        allow_same_provider: bool = False,
1458        task: Optional[TaskSpec] = None,
1459    ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], bool]:
1460        """Selects role-capable reviewers and reports identity diversity honestly."""
1461        implementation_id = self._normalize(implementing_agent_id)
1462        if self._legacy_mode:
1463            available = [
1464                profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id
1465                for profile in self.registry.list_resources()
1466                if self.get_status(profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id)
1467                == ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE
1468            ]
1469            distinct = [item for item in available if item != implementation_id]
1470            mapping: Dict[str, str] = {}
1471            diversity = True
1472            for index, role in enumerate(required_roles):
1473                role_candidates = distinct
1474                if role in LOCAL_INELIGIBLE_REVIEWER_ROLES:
1475                    role_candidates = [
1476                        item for item in role_candidates if item not in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS
1477                    ]
1478                if role_candidates:
1479                    mapping[role] = role_candidates[index % len(role_candidates)]
1480                else:
1481                    mapping[role] = implementation_id
1482                    diversity = False
1483            return mapping, diversity
1484        implementation = self.registry.get_resource(implementation_id)
1485        review_task = task or TaskSpec(
1486            task_id="REVIEW-SELECTION",
1487            repository="unknown",
1488            objective="Review an implementation diff",
1489            task_class="other",
1490            risk_level="medium",
1491        )
1492        mapping: Dict[str, str] = {}
1493        diversity = True
1494        used: Set[str] = set()
1495        for role in required_roles:
1496            decision = self.select_resource(
1497                review_task,
1498                role=role,
1499                avoid_resource_id=implementation_id,
1500            )
1501            eligible = [
1502                self.registry.get_resource(identity.resource_id)
1503                for identity in decision.eligible_resources
1504            ]
1505            eligible = [profile for profile in eligible if profile is not None]
1506            distinct = [
1507                profile for profile in eligible
1508                if profile.resource_id != implementation_id
1509                and implementation is not None
1510                and profile.provider_id != implementation.provider_id
1511            ]
1512            choices = distinct or [
1513                profile for profile in eligible if profile.resource_id != implementation_id
1514            ]
1515            if choices:
1516                unused = [profile for profile in choices if profile.resource_id not in used]
1517                chosen = (unused or choices)[0]
1518                mapping[role] = chosen.resource_id or chosen.agent_id
1519                used.add(chosen.resource_id or chosen.agent_id)
1520                if chosen not in distinct:
1521                    diversity = False
1522            elif implementation is not None:
1523                mapping[role] = implementation_id
1524                diversity = False
1525            elif allow_same_provider and decision.selected:
1526                mapping[role] = decision.selected.resource_id
1527                diversity = False
1528        return mapping, diversity

Selects role-capable reviewers and reports identity diversity honestly.
